TITLE: PREMIUM CAFE-STYLE WRAPS & ROLLS (C-500 SERIES)
CATEGORY: Cafe
CONTENT (EN): 1. WRAP STRUCTURE (LAYERING SYSTEM)

The wrap should be assembled from inside to outside in this exact structure:
Base: 8-inch or 10-inch Tortilla / Lachha Paratha
Moisture Barrier: Light layer of lettuce or cabbage
Purpose: Prevents sauce from making the wrap soggy
Main Filling: Fried Patty (C-502) / Paneer / OR Crispy Fried Chicken (C-510 ZING MASTER)
Flavor Layer: Long sliced onions + tomatoes + light sprinkle of C-509 FIRE DUST
Creamy Finish: 2 tablespoons C-503 VELVET GLAZE sauce

--------------------------------------------------

2. COOKING STEPS

Step 1: Base Heating
Warm tortilla or paratha lightly on tawa without oil or butter.
Heat for 10–15 seconds on both sides.
Base should remain soft and foldable.

Step 2: Sauce Application
Apply 1 tablespoon C-503 VELVET GLAZE sauce in center line.

Step 3: Vegetable Layer
Add shredded lettuce or cabbage over sauce.

Step 4: Filling Placement
Veg Version: Place sliced/crushed C-502 veg patty
Non-Veg Version: Place crispy fried chicken strips prepared using C-510 ZING MASTER

Step 5: Flavor Toppings
Add long sliced onions and tomatoes.
Sprinkle C-509 FIRE DUST lightly.

Step 6: Final Sauce Layer
Add 1 additional spoon of C-503 VELVET GLAZE over filling.

Step 7: Folding & Grilling
Fold bottom edge slightly upward.
Fold both sides inward.
Roll tightly.
Apply light butter on tawa or griller.
Toast for approximately 30 seconds until golden grill marks appear.

--------------------------------------------------

3. MENU VARIATIONS

Classic Veggie Wrap
Base: 8-inch Tortilla | Filling: C-502 Veg Patty (Crushed) | Seasoning: Mild C-509 FIRE DUST

Peri-Peri Paneer Wrap
Base: 8-inch Tortilla | Filling: Grilled Paneer Strips | Seasoning: Extra spicy C-509 FIRE DUST

Zing Crunchy Roll
Base: 8-inch Tortilla | Filling: C-510 ZING MASTER Fried Chicken | Special Sauce: C-503 mixed with mint

Crispy Chicken Wrap
Base: 8-inch Tortilla | Filling: C-510 Chicken Strips | Sauce: Standard C-503 VELVET GLAZE

--------------------------------------------------

4. HELPER TIPS

Tight Folding Rule: Always roll tightly. Loose wraps leak sauce while eating.
Crunch Rule: Chicken strips must be served hot and crispy.
Wrapping Presentation: Wrap half portion using butter paper or aluminum foil. Cut diagonally from center. This improves premium presentation.

--------------------------------------------------

5. TROUBLESHOOTING

Problem: Wrap tearing from bottom
Reason: Dry tortilla or excessive filling
Solution: Use fresh tortilla and avoid overfilling

Problem: Wrap feels dry
Reason: Less sauce or overcooked filling
Solution: Increase sauce quantity

Problem: Wrap becomes soggy
Reason: Wet vegetables or delayed serving
Solution: Grill immediately and serve fresh

--------------------------------------------------

6. PRESENTATION

Wrap half in butter paper or foil.
Cut diagonally.
Serve hot.
Optional: Serve with fries or dip.

Kyroz+ Systems | Accuracy. Growth. Consistency.
Crunchy Outside. Juicy Inside.

TITLE: GARLIC OIL SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Ingredients (Batch Size: 500 ml)

Refined Oil: 500 ml
Fresh Garlic (finely chopped or crushed): 200g
Salt: 1 pinch (for preservation)
2. Cooking Method (Slow-Golden Technique)

Important Rule

Garlic oil should NEVER be made on high flame.
High heat burns garlic from outside while flavor remains trapped inside.
Step 1: Cold Start
Take a pan.
Add 500 ml refined oil.
Immediately add finely chopped garlic.

Critical Rule

Garlic should be added in cold oil.
Never add garlic to already hot oil.
Step 2: Slow Cooking
Keep flame on very low heat.
Let garlic slowly cook in oil.
Garlic bubbles will gradually reduce.
Step 3: Color Check
Watch carefully.
Once garlic becomes light golden, immediately switch off the flame.

Warning

Do NOT let garlic become dark brown or black.
Burnt garlic makes the oil bitter.
Step 4: Cooling
Remove the pan from heat immediately.
Let the oil cool naturally.

Important Note

Residual pan heat will continue cooking garlic slightly.
Final golden color develops during cooling.
Step 5: Storage
Once cooled, transfer to:
glass bottle
OR
dispenser bottle
Keep fried garlic bits inside the oil.
3. Usage Guide (1-Spoon Rule)
For Hakka Noodles / Fried Rice
Add 1 tbsp garlic oil just before plating.
Toss once for aroma and shine.
For Clear Soups
Add 1/2 tsp garlic oil on top after serving.
For Dry Starters

Examples:

Crispy Corn
Veg Salt & Pepper

Add garlic oil as final finishing drizzle.

4. Troubleshooting

Oil tastes bitter

Reason: Garlic turned dark brown or black.
Fix: Switch off flame at light golden stage.

No garlic aroma

Reason: High flame / rushed cooking.
Fix:
Always use cold start
Cook slowly for 8–10 minutes

Oil became sticky

Reason:
Old oil used
OR
Moisture entered bottle
Fix:
Use fresh refined oil
Store in dry clean bottle
5. Kitchen Rule (Kyroz Master Tip)

Do NOT use garlic oil as cooking oil.

Wrong use:

Frying vegetables in it

Correct use:

Always use as finishing oil at the very end

Reason

Final-stage usage preserves:
fresh garlic aroma
premium flavor
better customer experience
CONTENT (HI): 1. सामग्री (बैच साइज़: 500 ml)

Refined Oil: 500 ml
ताजा लहसुन (बारीक कटा या crushed): 200g
नमक: 1 चुटकी (preservation के लिए)
2. बनाने की प्रक्रिया (Slow-Golden Technique)

महत्वपूर्ण नियम

Garlic oil कभी भी high flame पर नहीं बनाना चाहिए।
तेज आंच पर garlic बाहर से जल जाता है और अंदर का flavor नहीं निकलता।
स्टेप 1: Cold Start
एक pan लें।
500 ml refined oil डालें।
तुरंत बारीक कटा garlic डालें।

महत्वपूर्ण नियम

Garlic हमेशा ठंडे तेल में डालें।
गरम तेल में कभी न डालें।
स्टेप 2: Slow Cooking
Flame को बहुत धीमा रखें।
Garlic को धीरे-धीरे तेल में पकने दें।
Garlic के bubbles धीरे-धीरे कम होंगे।
स्टेप 3: Color Check
ध्यान से देखें।
जैसे ही garlic light golden हो, तुरंत गैस बंद करें।

चेतावनी

Garlic को dark brown या काला न होने दें।
जला garlic तेल को कड़वा बना देता है।
स्टेप 4: Cooling
Pan को तुरंत heat से हटा लें।
तेल को प्राकृतिक रूप से ठंडा होने दें।

महत्वपूर्ण नोट

Pan की बची हुई गर्मी garlic को थोड़ा और पकाएगी।
Final golden रंग cooling के दौरान आता है।
स्टेप 5: Storage
ठंडा होने के बाद इसे:
glass bottle
या
dispenser bottle
में भरें।
Fried garlic bits तेल के अंदर ही रहने दें।
3. उपयोग गाइड (1-Spoon Rule)
Hakka Noodles / Fried Rice
Plate में निकालने से पहले 1 tbsp garlic oil डालें।
Aroma और shine के लिए एक बार toss करें।
Clear Soups
Serve करने के बाद ऊपर 1/2 tsp garlic oil डालें।
Dry Starters

उदाहरण:

Crispy Corn
Veg Salt & Pepper

Final finishing drizzle के रूप में डालें।

4. समस्या समाधान

तेल कड़वा लग रहा है

कारण: Garlic dark brown या काला हो गया।
समाधान: Light golden stage पर गैस बंद करें।

Garlic aroma नहीं है

कारण: तेज आंच / जल्दी पकाया गया।
समाधान:
हमेशा cold start करें
8–10 मिनट धीरे पकाएं

तेल sticky हो गया

कारण:
पुराना तेल इस्तेमाल हुआ
या
Bottle में नमी चली गई
समाधान:
Fresh refined oil इस्तेमाल करें
सूखी साफ bottle में रखें
5. Kitchen Rule (Kyroz Master Tip)

Garlic oil को cooking oil की तरह इस्तेमाल न करें।

गलत उपयोग:

इसमें सब्जियां fry करना

सही उपयोग:

हमेशा finishing oil की तरह सबसे अंत में डालें।

कारण

इससे:
fresh garlic aroma
premium flavor
बेहतर customer experience मिलता है।

TITLE: HONEY CHILLI POTATO SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Potato Preparation (Crispiness Rule)

Cutting & Coating
Cut potatoes into equal finger-shaped pieces.
Soak in water for some time.
Drain properly.
Coat with:
Dry cornflour
Little maida
Salt
Double Fry Secret

First Fry

Fry potatoes until 80% cooked.
Remove and keep aside.

Second Fry (Order Time)

Refry in very hot oil until extremely crispy.

Important Rule

Potatoes should be extra crispy before adding sauce.
2. Sauce Preparation (Per Portion)
Ingredients
Refined Oil: 1 tbsp
Chopped Garlic: 1 tsp
White Sesame Seeds: 1 tsp
Water: 100 ml
Kyroz Z-105 TANGY COAT Powder: 1 tsp
Tomato Ketchup: 1 tbsp
Honey: 1 tbsp
Cornflour Slurry: 1 tbsp
Green Spring Onion (for garnish)
3. Cooking Steps
Step 1: Aroma Base
Heat oil in wok.
Add:
chopped garlic
white sesame seeds
Cook until sesame starts crackling.
Step 2: Sauce Base
Add 100 ml water.
Add:
Kyroz Z-105 TANGY COAT powder
tomato ketchup
Bring to boil.
Step 3: Glaze Formation
Add cornflour slurry.
Cook until sauce becomes:
thick
glossy
syrup-like sticky
Step 4: Honey Stage
Reduce flame.
Add 1 tbsp honey.

Important Rule

Do NOT overcook honey.
Overcooking changes flavor.
Step 5: Final Toss
Add extra crispy fried potatoes.
Toss on high flame for only 10 seconds.

Reason

Sauce should coat potatoes.
Potatoes should NOT become soft.
Step 6: Finish

Garnish with:

chopped spring onion
extra sesame seeds

Serve immediately.

4. Troubleshooting

Potatoes became soggy

Reason:
Sauce was thin
OR
Tossed too long
Fix:
Make sticky thick sauce first
Then add potatoes

Dish looks dark

Reason:
Soy sauce added
OR
Garlic burnt
Fix:
Never add soy sauce
Garlic should not burn

Not sweet enough

Reason:
Less honey
OR
Less Z-105 powder
Fix:
Add 1/2 tsp sugar
Increase honey

Sesame tastes bitter

Reason: Sesame burnt
Fix: Cook only until light golden
5. Kitchen Rules
Color Rule
Final dish should be bright reddish-orange
NOT dark like Manchurian
Serving Rule
Serve within 1 minute
Otherwise steam softens potatoes
Texture Rule
Sauce should stick like honey
It should NOT flow on the plate

TITLE: HOT & SOUR SOUP SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Essential Ingredients (Per Portion / Bowl)

Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE LIQUID: 120 ml
Plain Water: 180 ml
Finely Chopped Vegetables: 2 tbsp
Carrot
Beans
Cabbage
Mushroom
Bamboo Shoot / Paneer Cubes
Vinegar: 1/2 tsp
Red Chilli Paste or Green Chilli: 1/2 tsp (optional for extra spice)
Cornflour Slurry: 2–3 tbsp
Spring Onion: for garnish

Purpose

Z-102 Liquid → sharp soup flavor base
Vinegar → sourness
Cornflour slurry → thickness
Vegetables → texture
2. Cooking Method (3-Minute Process)
Step 1: Vegetable Sauté
Heat a little oil in wok.
Add all finely chopped vegetables.
Sauté for 20 seconds only.

Important Rule

Vegetables should remain slightly crunchy.
Do NOT overcook.
Step 2: Liquid Base
Add:
120 ml Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE LIQUID
180 ml plain water
Bring to boil.
Step 3: Sour Hit
Once boiling starts, add 1/2 tsp vinegar.
If customer wants spicy soup:
add red chilli paste
OR
chopped green chilli
Step 4: Thickening
Slowly add cornflour slurry.
Stir continuously.
Soup should become:
slightly thick
clear
glossy

Soup Rule

Hot & Sour should be thicker than clear soup.
But cleaner and lighter than Manchow.
Step 5: Final Serve
Pour into serving bowl.
Garnish with spring onion.
Serve hot.

Important Note

Fried noodles are NOT served with Hot & Sour Soup.
3. Troubleshooting

Soup too sour

Reason: Vinegar too much
Fix: Add 1/2 tsp sugar

Soup looks cloudy

Reason: Cornflour not cooked properly
Fix:
Boil on high flame for 30 seconds
Soup should turn shiny and clearer

Not spicy enough

Reason: Chilli diluted
Fix:
Add little extra chilli paste
OR
pinch of Z-102 dry powder

Flavor feels flat

Reason: Less umami / seasoning
Fix:
1/4 tsp soy sauce
OR
pinch of seasoning enhancer
4. Variation: Lemon Coriander Soup

Use same base with small changes:

Changes
Same Z-102 + water ratio
Do NOT add soy sauce
Add at finishing:
1 tbsp lemon juice
lots of fresh chopped coriander

Result

Fresh light garlicky soup
CONTENT (HI): 1. आवश्यक सामग्री (प्रति पोर्शन / बाउल)

Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE LIQUID: 120 ml
साधारण पानी: 180 ml
बारीक कटी सब्जियां: 2 tbsp
गाजर
बीन्स
पत्ता गोभी
मशरूम
Bamboo Shoot / Paneer Cubes
Vinegar: 1/2 tsp
Red Chilli Paste या Green Chilli: 1/2 tsp (extra spicy के लिए)
Cornflour Slurry: 2–3 tbsp
Spring Onion: garnish के लिए

उद्देश्य

Z-102 Liquid → sharp soup flavor base
Vinegar → खट्टापन
Cornflour slurry → thickness
Vegetables → texture
2. बनाने की प्रक्रिया (3 मिनट प्रक्रिया)
स्टेप 1: सब्जियों को Sauté करें
Wok में थोड़ा तेल गरम करें।
सभी बारीक कटी सब्जियां डालें।
केवल 20 सेकंड sauté करें।

महत्वपूर्ण नियम

सब्जियां हल्की crunchy रहनी चाहिए।
ज्यादा न पकाएं।
स्टेप 2: Liquid Base
डालें:
120 ml Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE LIQUID
180 ml साधारण पानी
उबाल आने दें।
स्टेप 3: Sour Hit
उबाल आने पर 1/2 tsp vinegar डालें।
ग्राहक extra spicy चाहे तो:
red chilli paste
या
chopped green chilli डालें।
स्टेप 4: Thickening
धीरे-धीरे cornflour slurry डालें।
लगातार चलाते रहें।
Soup होना चाहिए:
हल्का thick
clear
glossy

Soup Rule

Hot & Sour clear soup से thick होना चाहिए।
लेकिन Manchow से हल्का और cleaner होना चाहिए।
स्टेप 5: Final Serve
Serving bowl में निकालें।
Spring onion garnish करें।
गरमा-गरम serve करें।

महत्वपूर्ण नोट

Hot & Sour Soup के साथ fried noodles नहीं दिए जाते।
3. समस्या समाधान

Soup ज्यादा खट्टा है

कारण: Vinegar ज्यादा
समाधान: 1/2 tsp चीनी डालें।

Soup cloudy दिख रहा है

कारण: Cornflour सही नहीं पका।
समाधान:
30 सेकंड high flame पर उबालें
Soup shiny और clear होना चाहिए।

पर्याप्त spicy नहीं

कारण: Chilli dilute हो गई।
समाधान:
extra chilli paste
या
pinch Z-102 dry powder डालें।

Flavor flat लग रहा है

कारण: Umami / seasoning कम
समाधान:
1/4 tsp soy sauce
या
थोड़ा seasoning enhancer
4. Variation: Lemon Coriander Soup

इसी base से छोटे बदलाव के साथ बनाएं:

बदलाव
वही Z-102 + पानी ratio
Soy sauce न डालें
अंत में डालें:
1 tbsp lemon juice
खूब सारा fresh chopped coriander

परिणाम

Fresh, हल्का garlicky soup

TITLE: MANCHOW SOUP SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Essential Ingredients (Per Portion / Bowl)

Kyroz Z-101 DARK MASTER Liquid: 100 ml
Plain Water: 200 ml
Finely Chopped Vegetables: 2 tbsp
Carrot
Cabbage
Beans
Capsicum
Finely Chopped Garlic: 1 tsp
Finely Chopped Ginger: 1/2 tsp
Finely Chopped Coriander Stems: 1 tsp
Cornflour Slurry: 2–3 tbsp
Black Pepper: 1 pinch
Vinegar: 1 drop
Fried Noodles: topping
Spring Onion: garnish

Purpose

DARK MASTER → soup flavor base
Garlic + ginger → aroma
Coriander stems → premium restaurant flavor
Cornflour → thickness
2. Cooking Method (3-Minute Process)
Step 1: Aromatic Base
Heat a little oil in a wok/pan.
Add:
chopped garlic
chopped ginger
chopped coriander stems
Sauté until garlic becomes light golden brown.

Important Rule

Slight burnt garlic aroma is signature flavor.
But do NOT burn completely.
Step 2: Vegetable Toss
Add all chopped vegetables.
Stir fry on high flame for 10–15 seconds only.

Rule

Vegetables should remain crunchy.
Step 3: Liquid Base
Add:
100 ml Kyroz Z-101 DARK MASTER Liquid
200 ml plain water
Bring to boil.
Step 4: Thickening
Slowly add cornflour slurry.
Stir continuously.
Soup should become:
slightly thick
coating consistency
glossy
Step 5: Final Flavor Hit

Add:

1 pinch black pepper
1 drop vinegar

This gives fresh finishing punch.

Step 6: Serving
Pour soup into serving bowl.
Top generously with:
fried noodles
spring onion

Serve immediately.

3. Troubleshooting

Soup tastes bland

Reason: Too much water / less master liquid
Fix:
Add 1/2 tsp Z-101 dry powder

Soup looks too dark

Reason: Base too concentrated
Fix:
Add little plain water
adjust seasoning

Fried noodles became soft

Reason: Added too early
Fix:
Add noodles only at serving time
OR
serve separately

Missing restaurant aroma

Reason: Garlic + coriander stems not sautéed properly
Fix:
cook garlic till golden
4. Premium Tip

For premium 5-star finish (optional):
Add at the end:

1/2 tsp butter
OR
1 drop sesame oil

Benefit

Better shine
Rich aroma
Restaurant-style finish
CONTENT (HI): 1. आवश्यक सामग्री (प्रति पोर्शन / बाउल)

Kyroz Z-101 DARK MASTER Liquid: 100 ml
साधारण पानी: 200 ml
बारीक कटी सब्जियां: 2 tbsp
गाजर
पत्ता गोभी
बीन्स
शिमला मिर्च
बारीक कटा लहसुन: 1 tsp
बारीक कटा अदरक: 1/2 tsp
बारीक कटी धनिया डंडी: 1 tsp
Cornflour Slurry: 2–3 tbsp
Black Pepper: 1 चुटकी
Vinegar: 1 बूंद
Fried Noodles: topping
Spring Onion: garnish

उद्देश्य

DARK MASTER → soup flavor base
Garlic + ginger → aroma
धनिया डंडी → premium restaurant flavor
Cornflour → thickness
2. बनाने की प्रक्रिया (3 मिनट प्रक्रिया)
स्टेप 1: Aromatic Base
Wok/pan में थोड़ा तेल गरम करें।
डालें:
chopped garlic
chopped ginger
chopped coriander stems
Garlic को हल्का golden brown होने तक sauté करें।

महत्वपूर्ण नियम

हल्का burnt garlic aroma signature flavor है।
लेकिन पूरी तरह न जलाएं।
स्टेप 2: Vegetable Toss
सभी chopped vegetables डालें।
High flame पर केवल 10–15 सेकंड stir fry करें।

नियम

सब्जियां crunchy रहनी चाहिए।
स्टेप 3: Liquid Base
डालें:
100 ml Kyroz Z-101 DARK MASTER Liquid
200 ml साधारण पानी
उबाल आने दें।
स्टेप 4: Thickening
धीरे-धीरे cornflour slurry डालें।
लगातार चलाते रहें।
Soup होना चाहिए:
हल्का thick
coating consistency
glossy
स्टेप 5: Final Flavor Hit

डालें:

1 चुटकी black pepper
1 बूंद vinegar

इससे fresh finishing punch मिलता है।

स्टेप 6: Serving
Serving bowl में निकालें।
ऊपर अच्छी मात्रा में डालें:
fried noodles
spring onion

तुरंत serve करें।

3. समस्या समाधान

Soup फीका लग रहा है

कारण: पानी ज्यादा / master liquid कम
समाधान:
1/2 tsp Z-101 dry powder डालें।

Soup बहुत dark दिख रहा है

कारण: Base ज्यादा concentrated है।
समाधान:
थोड़ा plain water डालें
seasoning adjust करें।

Fried noodles नरम हो गए

कारण: जल्दी डाल दिए गए।
समाधान:
केवल serving time पर डालें
या
अलग serve करें।

Restaurant जैसी aroma नहीं है

कारण: Garlic + coriander stems सही नहीं भुने।
समाधान:
Garlic को golden तक पकाएं।
4. Premium Tip

5-star finish के लिए (वैकल्पिक):
अंत में डालें:

1/2 tsp butter
या
1 बूंद sesame oil

फायदा

Better shine
Rich aroma
Restaurant-style finish

TITLE: UNIVERSAL CRISPY FRY SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Morning Preparation (Pre-Marination)

Protein Preparation

Cut into cubes as needed:

Chicken
Paneer
Mushroom
Marination (Per 1 kg Protein)

Add:

1 tbsp Kyroz Z-103 RED FIRE BATCH Paste
Light salt

Mix well and refrigerate.

Benefit

Makes protein flavorful from inside.
Prevents bland taste after frying.
2. Batter Preparation (Coating Mix)
Ingredients
Kyroz Z-106 ARMOUR BASE Powder: 200g
Egg: 1 piece (skip for veg items)
Chilled Water: 100–150 ml
Method
Take a mixing bowl.
Add:
Z-106 powder
egg (if required)
Slowly add chilled water.
Mix until thick batter forms.

Consistency Rule

Batter should be thick enough to coat your finger with a heavy layer.
If batter flows like water → add more powder.
3. Universal Frying Chart
Chicken Lollipop

Coating: Thick batter

Frying Method

First Fry: 5 minutes on medium flame
Second Fry: 30 seconds on high flame

Result

Crispy outside
Fully cooked inside
Spicy Chicken Fry

Coating: Thick batter

Method

Same double fry process
Paneer / Mushroom

Coating: Medium batter

Method

Single fry
High flame
Around 2 minutes
Veg Manchurian Balls

Method

Dry dusting only
Do NOT make wet batter
Direct powder coating and fry
4. Speed Checklist for Helper

✔ Dry Check

Protein should be dry before dipping into batter.

✔ Dip

Coat evenly from all sides.

✔ Drop Rule

Drop pieces one by one.
Do NOT overcrowd.

✔ Final Crunch Rule

Before serving, do flash fry for 10 seconds in very hot oil.
5. Troubleshooting

Coating became soggy

Reason:
Protein was wet
OR
Oil was cold
Fix:
Dry protein properly
Heat oil until very hot

Coating came off while frying

Reason: Batter too thin
Fix: Add more Z-106 powder

Outside cooked, inside raw

Reason: Oil too hot
Fix:
First fry on medium flame
Slow inside cooking is necessary
CONTENT (HI): 1. सुबह की तैयारी (Pre-Marination)

Protein तैयारी

आवश्यकतानुसार cubes में काटें:

Chicken
Paneer
Mushroom
मेरिनेशन (प्रति 1 किलो Protein)

डालें:

1 tbsp Kyroz Z-103 RED FIRE BATCH Paste
हल्का नमक

अच्छी तरह मिलाकर फ्रिज में रखें।

फायदा

Protein अंदर से flavorful बनता है।
Fry होने के बाद फीका स्वाद नहीं आता।
2. Batter तैयारी (Coating Mix)
सामग्री
Kyroz Z-106 ARMOUR BASE Powder: 200g
अंडा: 1 (veg items के लिए skip करें)
ठंडा पानी: 100–150 ml
बनाने की विधि
Mixing bowl लें।
डालें:
Z-106 powder
egg (यदि आवश्यक हो)
धीरे-धीरे chilled water डालें।
Thick batter बनने तक मिलाएं।

Consistency Rule

Batter इतना thick होना चाहिए कि उंगली पर मोटी layer चिपके।
अगर पानी जैसा बह रहा हो → और powder डालें।
3. Universal Frying Chart
Chicken Lollipop

Coating: Thick batter

Frying Method

पहला fry: 5 मिनट medium flame
दूसरा fry: 30 सेकंड high flame

Result

बाहर crispy
अंदर पूरी तरह cooked
Spicy Chicken Fry

Coating: Thick batter

Method

वही double fry process
Paneer / Mushroom

Coating: Medium batter

Method

Single fry
High flame
लगभग 2 मिनट
Veg Manchurian Balls

Method

केवल dry dusting
Wet batter न बनाएं
Direct powder coating करके fry करें
4. Helper Speed Checklist

✔ Dry Check

Batter में डालने से पहले protein सूखा होना चाहिए।

✔ Dip

हर तरफ बराबर coating करें।

✔ Drop Rule

Pieces एक-एक करके डालें।
एक साथ ज्यादा न डालें।

✔ Final Crunch Rule

Serve करने से पहले 10 सेकंड flash fry करें।
5. समस्या समाधान

Coating soggy हो गई

कारण:
Protein गीला था
या
तेल ठंडा था
समाधान:
Protein अच्छी तरह सुखाएं
तेल अच्छी तरह गरम करें

Coating fry में उतर गई

कारण: Batter पतला था
समाधान: और Z-106 powder डालें

बाहर पक गया, अंदर कच्चा

कारण: तेल बहुत गरम था
समाधान:
पहला fry medium flame पर करें
अंदर धीरे पकना जरूरी है

TITLE: UNIVERSAL CHILLI BASE SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Morning Base Preparation (5 Litre Batch)

Prepare this master chilli base every morning in fixed measurements.

Ingredients
Oil: 150 ml
Chopped Garlic: 150g
Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE Powder: 150g (1 scoop)
Water: 4.5 litres
Soy Sauce: 50 ml
Red Chilli Sauce: 250 ml
Green Chilli Sauce: 150 ml
Vinegar: 120 ml
Tomato Ketchup: 40 ml
Preparation Steps
Heat 150 ml oil in a large pan.
Add 150g chopped garlic.
Cook lightly.

Important Rule

Do NOT brown the garlic.
Only remove raw smell.
Add 150g Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE powder.
Stir for 5–8 seconds only.
Add:
4.5 litres water
soy sauce
red chilli sauce
green chilli sauce
vinegar
ketchup
Bring to one boil.
Store for service use.
2. Order Time Cooking Chart
Required Items
Cube-cut onion
Cube-cut capsicum
Fried protein:
Paneer
Chicken
Mushroom
Soya Chaap
Cornflour slurry
Oil
Step 1: Vegetable Toss
Heat oil in wok.
Add onion + capsicum.
Stir fry for 20 seconds only.

Rule

Vegetables must remain crunchy.
Step 2: Choose Style

Dry Chilli

Add 100 ml chilli base (half ladle)

Gravy Chilli

Add 300 ml chilli base (1.5 ladle)

Bring to boil.

Step 3: Thickening
Add cornflour slurry.
Cook until sauce becomes:
thick
glossy
shiny
Step 4: Final Toss
Add fried protein.
Toss on high flame.
3. Quick Guide by Variant
Chilli Paneer
Use lightly batter-fried paneer cubes.
Chilli Chicken
Use fried boneless chicken chunks.
Chilli Mushroom
Use batter-fried mushroom halves.
Chilli Soya Chaap
Use fried chaap pieces.
4. Dry vs Gravy Rule

Dry Style

Sauce should only coat the protein.
No extra liquid should remain.

Gravy Style

Sauce should remain flowing in the plate/bowl.
5. Troubleshooting

Dish tastes bland

Reason: Base weak / vegetables too much
Fix:
Add 1 pinch Z-102 dry powder

Too spicy

Reason: Too much green chilli
Fix:
Add 1 spoon butter
OR
add ketchup

Sauce not sticking

Reason: Less slurry / too much liquid
Fix:
Add more cornflour slurry
cook on high flame

Color too dark

Reason: Too much soy sauce
Fix:
Add warm water
little red chilli sauce
CONTENT (HI): 1. सुबह का बेस प्रिपरेशन (5 लीटर बैच)

यह master chilli base हर सुबह fixed measurement में तैयार करें।

सामग्री
तेल: 150 ml
बारीक कटा लहसुन: 150g
Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE Powder: 150g (1 scoop)
पानी: 4.5 लीटर
Soy Sauce: 50 ml
Red Chilli Sauce: 250 ml
Green Chilli Sauce: 150 ml
Vinegar: 120 ml
Tomato Ketchup: 40 ml
बनाने की प्रक्रिया
बड़े pan में 150 ml तेल गरम करें।
150g chopped garlic डालें।
हल्का पकाएं।

मह महत्वपूर्ण नियम

Garlic को brown न करें।
केवल कच्ची smell हटानी है।
150g Kyroz Z-102 powder डालें।
केवल 5–8 सेकंड चलाएं।
अब डालें:
4.5 लीटर पानी
soy sauce
red chilli sauce
green chilli sauce
vinegar
ketchup
एक उबाल आने दें।
सर्विस के लिए स्टोर करें।
2. ऑर्डर टाइम कुकिंग चार्ट
आवश्यक सामग्री
Cube-cut प्याज
Cube-cut शिमला मिर्च
Fried protein:
Paneer
Chicken
Mushroom
Soya Chaap
Cornflour slurry
तेल
स्टेप 1: Vegetable Toss
Wok में तेल गरम करें।
प्याज + शिमला मिर्च डालें।
केवल 20 सेकंड stir fry करें।

नियम

सब्जियां crunchy रहनी चाहिए।
स्टेप 2: स्टाइल चुनें

Dry Chilli

100 ml chilli base (आधा ladle)

Gravy Chilli

300 ml chilli base (1.5 ladle)

उबाल आने दें।

स्टेप 3: Thickening
Cornflour slurry डालें।
तब तक पकाएं जब तक sauce:
thick
glossy
shiny न हो जाए।
स्टेप 4: Final Toss
Fried protein डालें।
High flame पर toss करें।
3. Variant अनुसार Quick Guide
Chilli Paneer
हल्का batter-fried paneer cubes
Chilli Chicken
Fried boneless chicken chunks
Chilli Mushroom
Batter-fried mushroom halves
Chilli Soya Chaap
Fried chaap pieces
4. Dry vs Gravy Rule

Dry Style

Sauce केवल protein पर coat होना चाहिए।
Extra liquid नहीं रहना चाहिए।

Gravy Style

Sauce plate/bowl में flowing रहनी चाहिए।
5. समस्या समाधान

Dish फीकी है

कारण: Base weak / सब्जियां ज्यादा
समाधान:
1 pinch Z-102 dry powder डालें।

बहुत तीखी है

कारण: Green chilli ज्यादा
समाधान:
1 चम्मच butter
या
ketchup डालें।

Sauce चिपक नहीं रहा

कारण: Slurry कम / liquid ज्यादा
समाधान:
और cornflour slurry डालें
high flame पर पकाएं।

रंग ज्यादा dark है

कारण: Soy sauce ज्यादा
समाधान:
गरम पानी
थोड़ा red chilli sauce डालें।

2. Morning Preparation
Noodles Preparation
Boil noodles until 80–90% cooked.
Drain immediately.
Wash with cold water.
Apply a little oil and toss.

Important Rule

This prevents sticking.
Keeps noodles separate during wok tossing.
Rice Preparation
Cook rice until grains are separate.
Cool completely.
Store in trays.

Rule

Never use hot rice.
Hot rice becomes sticky in wok.
White Base Preparation

Keep ready:

Chopped garlic
White pepper
Spring onion
Kyroz N-Core Powder
Garlic oil

6. Troubleshooting

Noodles sticky

Reason:
Overboiled
OR
No oil applied
Fix:
Boil only 80–90%
always oil coat

Rice mushy

Reason: Fresh hot rice
Fix:
use cold separated rice

White dish turning brown

Reason:
Garlic browned
OR
soy sauce contamination
Fix:
Keep garlic light
avoid soy sauce

Flavor bland

Reason: Less N-Core
Fix:
Add extra pinch

TITLE: UNIVERSAL MANCHURIAN SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Morning Base Preparation (5 Litre Batch)

Prepare this master Manchurian base every morning.

Ingredients
Oil: 150 ml
Chopped Garlic: 150g
Chopped Ginger: 80g
Kyroz Z-101 DARK MASTER Powder: 150g (1 scoop)
Water: 4.5 litres
Soy Sauce: 100 ml
Vinegar: 100 ml
Black Pepper Powder: 10g
Tomato Ketchup: 50 ml
Preparation Steps
Heat 150 ml oil in a large pan.
Add:
chopped garlic
chopped ginger
Lightly sauté.

Important Rule

Do NOT burn garlic or ginger.
Only remove raw smell.
Add 150g Kyroz Z-101 DARK MASTER powder.
Stir for 5–8 seconds only.
Add:
4.5 litres water
soy sauce
vinegar
black pepper
ketchup
Bring to one boil.
Store for service use.
2. Order Time Cooking Chart
Required Items
Fried Manchurian balls / fried protein
Cornflour slurry
Oil

Optional vegetables:

Onion
Capsicum
Spring onion
Step 1: Base Heating
Heat a wok.
Add little oil.
Step 2: Choose Style

Dry Manchurian

Add 100 ml master base (half ladle)

Gravy Manchurian

Add 300 ml master base (1.5 ladle)

Bring to boil.

Step 3: Thickening
Slowly add cornflour slurry.
Stir continuously.
Sauce should become:
thick
glossy
shiny
Step 4: Final Toss
Add:
fried Manchurian balls
OR
fried chicken / gobi / mushroom / chaap
Toss quickly on high flame.

Ingredients

Capsicum

Boiled Noodles: 180–200g

5. Schezwan Dry / Gravy Dishes
Ingredients
Fried paneer / chicken / mushroom / chaap
Cube-cut onion
Cube-cut capsicum
Schezwan paste
Water
Cornflour slurry
Oil
Dry Style Method
Heat oil in wok.
Add onion + capsicum.
Toss for 20 seconds.
Add Schezwan paste + little water.
Bring to boil.
Add cornflour slurry (small amount if needed).
Add fried protein.
Toss quickly.

Rule

Sauce should only coat the pieces.
Gravy Style Method
Follow same process.
Add extra water.
Add more slurry for thick glossy gravy.

Rule

Gravy should remain flowing.
6. Helper Advice

Heat Rule

Schezwan dishes must always be cooked on very high flame.

Speed Rule

Fast tossing only.
Slow cooking ruins texture.

Spice Rule

Schezwan dishes are naturally spicy.
Ask customer spice preference if needed.

Finish Rule

Add 1 tsp chilli oil at the end for premium aroma and shine.

Fix:
Add extra Schezwan paste

Dish too oily

Reason: Too much chilli oil
Fix:
Reduce finishing oil

Dark burnt taste

Reason:
Garlic burnt
OR
slow cooking
Fix:
Quick high flame toss only

TITLE: KFC-STYLE CRISPY CHICKEN (C-510 ZING MASTER)
CATEGORY: Cafe
CONTENT (EN): 1. MARINATION STANDARD (24-HOUR PROCESS)

Item: Chicken Cuts
Specification: Popcorn, Strips, Wings, or Leg Pieces (1 kg)
Notes: Fresh and properly cleaned

Item: Marinade Powder
Specification: C-510 ZING MASTER (40g)
Notes: Measure accurately

Item: Water
Specification: 50ml to 60ml
Notes: For dissolving seasoning; if chicken is already wet, avoid extra water

Item: Marination Time
Specification: 24 Hours (Mandatory)
Notes: Keep inside refrigerator (Chiller Zone)

Marination Method:
For 1 kg chicken, mix 40g C-510 ZING MASTER in 50ml water to create a thick paste.
Apply evenly over all chicken pieces and mix thoroughly.
Store in an airtight container and refrigerate for 24 hours.
This ensures the seasoning penetrates deep inside the chicken, including near the bone.

--------------------------------------------------

2. DRY COATING STATION SETUP

Set up these two containers:
Tub 1 (Dry Mix): Refined Flour (Maida) + 1 spoon C-509 FIRE DUST
Tub 2 (Chilled Water): Ice-cold water

--------------------------------------------------

3. STEP-BY-STEP COOKING METHOD

Step 1: First Coating
Remove marinated chicken from refrigerator.
Place it in dry flour.
Lightly coat using gentle hand movement.

Step 2: Water Dip
Dip coated chicken in cold water for 2–3 seconds.

Step 3: Second Coating
Return chicken to dry flour.
Toss gently 10–12 times to create crispy flakes.

Step 4: Shake
Shake off extra flour.

Step 5: Frying
Immediately place in hot oil.

--------------------------------------------------

4. FRYING TEMPERATURE & TIME

CRITICAL RULE: Oil must be fully preheated.

Chicken Popcorn:
Temperature: 180°C
Time: 3–4 minutes
Check: Golden brown and floating

Chicken Strips:
Temperature: 180°C
Time: 4–5 minutes
Check: Crispy texture

Chicken Wings:
Temperature: 170°C
Time: 6–7 minutes
Check: Fully cooked

Chicken Leg Piece:
Temperature: 160°C
Time: 10–12 minutes
Check: Deep internal cooking

--------------------------------------------------

5. HELPER TIPS

No Extra Salt: C-510 already contains balanced salt and spice.
Ice Cold Water Only: Normal water will ruin coating.
Avoid Overcrowding: Do not fry too many pieces together.

--------------------------------------------------

6. TROUBLESHOOTING

Problem: Crunch too hard
Reason: Pressed too hard in flour
Solution: Use gentle coating

Problem: Coating falling off
Reason: Water not cold enough
Solution: Use chilled water and shake properly

Problem: Raw inside
Reason: Oil too hot
Solution: Fry slowly at 160°C

--------------------------------------------------

7. PRESENTATION

After frying, place chicken on strainer for 1 minute.
Sprinkle C-509 FIRE DUST on top.
Serve in bucket or plate.
CONTENT (HI): 1. मैरिनेशन स्टैंडर्ड (24 घंटे प्रक्रिया)

आइटम: चिकन कट्स
विवरण: पॉपकॉर्न, स्ट्रिप्स, विंग्स या लेग पीस (1 किलो)
नोट: ताज़ा और साफ

आइटम: मैरिनेड पाउडर
विवरण: C-510 ZING MASTER (40 ग्राम)
नोट: सही मात्रा लें

आइटम: पानी
विवरण: 50–60 ml
नोट: मसाला घोलने के लिए

आइटम: मैरिनेशन समय
विवरण: 24 घंटे (अनिवार्य)
नोट: फ्रिज के चिलर में रखें

मैरिनेशन विधि:
1 किलो चिकन के लिए 40 ग्राम C-510 ZING MASTER को 50 ml पानी में मिलाकर गाढ़ा पेस्ट बनाएं।
इस पेस्ट को चिकन के सभी पीस पर अच्छे से लगाएं।
एयरटाइट कंटेनर में बंद करके 24 घंटे फ्रिज में रखें।
इससे मसाला अंदर तक अच्छी तरह पहुंचता है।

TITLE: MASTER CAFE-STYLE BURGER ASSEMBLY
CATEGORY: Cafe
CONTENT (EN): 1. THE 6-LAYER ASSEMBLY (BURGER SYSTEM)

The burger should be assembled from bottom to top in this exact sequence:
Bottom Bun: Apply C-503 VELVET GLAZE (Base sauce layer)
Layer 02 (Bottom Vegetables): A light layer of shredded lettuce or cabbage
Layer 03 (Cheese - Optional): 1 cheese slice (if requested by customer)
Layer 04 (Main Patty): Hot and crispy patty made using C-502 GRILL DUST
Layer 05 (Top Toppings): 2 slices tomato + 2 slices onion/cucumber
Top Bun: Apply C-503 VELVET GLAZE (Classic or spicy variant)

--------------------------------------------------

2. COOKING STEPS

Step 1: Bun Toasting
Cut burger bun into two halves.
Apply light butter and toast inner side on tawa or griddle for 15–20 seconds.
Bun should remain soft, not over toasted.

Step 2: Base Sauce
Apply 1 small spoon of C-503 VELVET GLAZE evenly on bottom bun.

Step 3: Vegetable Layer
Place shredded lettuce or cabbage over sauce.
This prevents bun from becoming soggy.

Step 4: Patty & Cheese
Place freshly fried hot patty.
If cheese burger, place cheese slice immediately over hot patty so it melts slightly.

Step 5: Top Toppings
Add tomato and onion slices over patty.

Step 6: Top Sauce & Closing
Apply 1 spoon sauce inside top bun.
Close burger.
Press lightly and wrap.

--------------------------------------------------

3. MENU VARIATIONS

Classic Aloo Tikki Burger:
Patty: Standard Aloo Patty
Sauce: Mayo + Ketchup + Premix

Crispy Veggie Crunch Burger:
Patty: Mix Veg Patty + Crunchy Coating
Sauce: Mayo + Ketchup + Premix

Tandoori Paneer Burger:
Patty: Fried Paneer Slab
Sauce: Mayo + Premix + Chilli Powder

Spicy Chicken Zinger:
Patty: Chicken Mince Patty
Sauce: Mayo + Chilli Sauce + Premix

--------------------------------------------------

4. HELPER TIPS

The Crunch Rule: Always fry patty when order arrives. Pre-fried patties become soft.
Sauce Balance: Spread sauce evenly till bun edges.
Vegetable Freshness: Cut tomatoes and onions fresh and store chilled. Cold crunchy vegetables improve taste.

--------------------------------------------------

5. TROUBLESHOOTING

Problem: Burger slipping apart
Reason: Too much sauce or wet tomato
Solution: Dry tomato slices and use controlled sauce quantity

Problem: Bottom bun soggy
Reason: Hot patty placed directly on bun
Solution: Always add lettuce/cabbage barrier

Problem: Bun dry and hard
Reason: Old bun or over toasted
Solution: Use fresh buns and light warming only

--------------------------------------------------

6. PRESENTATION

Wrap burger properly in burger wrap paper.
Serve hot.
Optional: Add fries or dip alongside.

TITLE: MASTER PIZZA ASSEMBLY & BAKING (C-500 SERIES)
CATEGORY: Cafe
CONTENT (EN): 1. RAW MATERIAL MEASUREMENT (PER 10-INCH MEDIUM PIZZA)

Pizza Base: C-501 DOUGH MASTER prepared 10-inch pizza base
Pizza Sauce: C-506 MARINARA CORE sauce | Quantity: 50g
Cheese: Mozzarella + Cheddar diced blend | Quantity: 80g–100g
Vegetables: Capsicum, Onion, Sweet Corn, Mushroom | Quantity: 40g
Seasoning: C-509 FIRE DUST | For final topping

--------------------------------------------------

2. PIZZA ASSEMBLY STEPS

Step 1: Base Docking
Take the prepared pizza base.
If the base is not pre-baked, prick small holes across the surface using a fork.
This prevents the pizza from puffing in the center during baking.

Step 2: Sauce Layering
Add 50g pizza sauce in the center.
Spread evenly in circular motion.
Leave approximately 1/2 inch crust edge uncovered.

Step 3: First Cheese Layer
Add 30% of total cheese over the sauce.
This acts as a locking layer and helps toppings stay in place.

Step 4: Toppings Placement
Spread vegetables evenly across the pizza.
Do not overload one section.

Step 5: Final Cheese Layer
Add remaining 70% cheese evenly over toppings.
Toppings should be lightly covered.

--------------------------------------------------

3. BAKING STANDARDS

CRITICAL RULE: Preheat oven at least 15 minutes before baking. Cold oven will produce hard pizza.

Commercial Deck Oven:
Top Temperature: 280°C
Bottom Temperature: 260°C

Conveyor Pizza Oven:
Temperature: 250°C
Speed: 5 to 5.5 minutes

Baking Time: 5 to 6 minutes
Bake until: Cheese develops light brown spots and Crust becomes golden brown

--------------------------------------------------

4. HELPER TIPS

No Soggy Base: Ensure vegetables are dry. Wet vegetables can make pizza soggy.
Golden Edge Finish: After baking, lightly brush butter or olive oil on crust edges. Improves shine and premium appearance.
Cutting Rule: Cut immediately after baking using pizza cutter. Cut into 4 or 6 equal slices. Late cutting causes cheese stretching issues.

--------------------------------------------------

5. TROUBLESHOOTING

Problem: Cheese burned but base raw
Reason: Top heat too high
Solution: Reduce top heat by 10–20°C and increase bottom heat

Problem: Pizza puffed in center
Reason: Base not docked properly
Solution: Always prick holes before baking

Problem: Cheese melted but no stretch
Reason: Low oven temperature or underbaked
Solution: Maintain 260°C+ and bake till brown spots appear

--------------------------------------------------

6. PRESENTATION

Place pizza in pizza box or wooden platter.
Provide 1 small pouch of C-509 FIRE DUST alongside.
Serve hot.

Kyroz+ Systems | Accuracy. Consistency. Growth.
Perfect Crust. Perfect Melt.

TITLE: PREMIUM CAFE-STYLE WRAPS & ROLLS (C-500 SERIES)
CATEGORY: Cafe
CONTENT (EN): 1. WRAP STRUCTURE (LAYERING SYSTEM)

The wrap should be assembled from inside to outside in this exact structure:
Base: 8-inch or 10-inch Tortilla / Lachha Paratha
Moisture Barrier: Light layer of lettuce or cabbage
Purpose: Prevents sauce from making the wrap soggy
Main Filling: Fried Patty (C-502) / Paneer / OR Crispy Fried Chicken (C-510 ZING MASTER)
Flavor Layer: Long sliced onions + tomatoes + light sprinkle of C-509 FIRE DUST
Creamy Finish: 2 tablespoons C-503 VELVET GLAZE sauce

--------------------------------------------------

2. COOKING STEPS

Step 1: Base Heating
Warm tortilla or paratha lightly on tawa without oil or butter.
Heat for 10–15 seconds on both sides.
Base should remain soft and foldable.

Step 2: Sauce Application
Apply 1 tablespoon C-503 VELVET GLAZE sauce in center line.

Step 3: Vegetable Layer
Add shredded lettuce or cabbage over sauce.

Step 4: Filling Placement
Veg Version: Place sliced/crushed C-502 veg patty
Non-Veg Version: Place crispy fried chicken strips prepared using C-510 ZING MASTER

Step 5: Flavor Toppings
Add long sliced onions and tomatoes.
Sprinkle C-509 FIRE DUST lightly.

Step 6: Final Sauce Layer
Add 1 additional spoon of C-503 VELVET GLAZE over filling.

Step 7: Folding & Grilling
Fold bottom edge slightly upward.
Fold both sides inward.
Roll tightly.
Apply light butter on tawa or griller.
Toast for approximately 30 seconds until golden grill marks appear.

--------------------------------------------------

3. MENU VARIATIONS

Classic Veggie Wrap
Base: 8-inch Tortilla | Filling: C-502 Veg Patty (Crushed) | Seasoning: Mild C-509 FIRE DUST

Peri-Peri Paneer Wrap
Base: 8-inch Tortilla | Filling: Grilled Paneer Strips | Seasoning: Extra spicy C-509 FIRE DUST

Zing Crunchy Roll
Base: 8-inch Tortilla | Filling: C-510 ZING MASTER Fried Chicken | Special Sauce: C-503 mixed with mint

Crispy Chicken Wrap
Base: 8-inch Tortilla | Filling: C-510 Chicken Strips | Sauce: Standard C-503 VELVET GLAZE

--------------------------------------------------

4. HELPER TIPS

Tight Folding Rule: Always roll tightly. Loose wraps leak sauce while eating.
Crunch Rule: Chicken strips must be served hot and crispy.
Wrapping Presentation: Wrap half portion using butter paper or aluminum foil. Cut diagonally from center. This improves premium presentation.

--------------------------------------------------

5. TROUBLESHOOTING

Problem: Wrap tearing from bottom
Reason: Dry tortilla or excessive filling
Solution: Use fresh tortilla and avoid overfilling

Problem: Wrap feels dry
Reason: Less sauce or overcooked filling
Solution: Increase sauce quantity

Problem: Wrap becomes soggy
Reason: Wet vegetables or delayed serving
Solution: Grill immediately and serve fresh

--------------------------------------------------

6. PRESENTATION

Wrap half in butter paper or foil.
Cut diagonally.
Serve hot.
Optional: Serve with fries or dip.

2. कुकिंग स्टेप्स

TITLE: GARLIC OIL SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Ingredients (Batch Size: 500 ml)

Refined Oil: 500 ml
Fresh Garlic (finely chopped or crushed): 200g
Salt: 1 pinch (for preservation)
2. Cooking Method (Slow-Golden Technique)

Important Rule

Garlic oil should NEVER be made on high flame.
High heat burns garlic from outside while flavor remains trapped inside.
Step 1: Cold Start
Take a pan.
Add 500 ml refined oil.
Immediately add finely chopped garlic.

Critical Rule

Garlic should be added in cold oil.
Never add garlic to already hot oil.
Step 2: Slow Cooking
Keep flame on very low heat.
Let garlic slowly cook in oil.
Garlic bubbles will gradually reduce.
Step 3: Color Check
Watch carefully.
Once garlic becomes light golden, immediately switch off the flame.

Warning

Do NOT let garlic become dark brown or black.
Burnt garlic makes the oil bitter.
Step 4: Cooling
Remove the pan from heat immediately.
Let the oil cool naturally.

Important Note

Residual pan heat will continue cooking garlic slightly.
Final golden color develops during cooling.
Step 5: Storage
Once cooled, transfer to:
glass bottle
OR
dispenser bottle
Keep fried garlic bits inside the oil.
3. Usage Guide (1-Spoon Rule)
For Hakka Noodles / Fried Rice
Add 1 tbsp garlic oil just before plating.
Toss once for aroma and shine.
For Clear Soups
Add 1/2 tsp garlic oil on top after serving.
For Dry Starters

Examples:

Crispy Corn
Veg Salt & Pepper

Add garlic oil as final finishing drizzle.

4. Troubleshooting

Oil tastes bitter

Reason: Garlic turned dark brown or black.
Fix: Switch off flame at light golden stage.

No garlic aroma

Reason: High flame / rushed cooking.
Fix:
Always use cold start
Cook slowly for 8–10 minutes

Oil became sticky

Reason:
Old oil used
OR
Moisture entered bottle
Fix:
Use fresh refined oil
Store in dry clean bottle
5. Kitchen Rule (Kyroz Master Tip)

Do NOT use garlic oil as cooking oil.

Wrong use:

Frying vegetables in it

Correct use:

Always use as finishing oil at the very end

Reason

Final-stage usage preserves:
fresh garlic aroma
premium flavor
better customer experience
CONTENT (HI): 1. सामग्री (बैच साइज़: 500 ml)

Refined Oil: 500 ml
ताजा लहसुन (बारीक कटा या crushed): 200g
नमक: 1 चुटकी (preservation के लिए)
2. बनाने की प्रक्रिया (Slow-Golden Technique)

महत्वपूर्ण नियम

Garlic oil कभी भी high flame पर नहीं बनाना चाहिए।
तेज आंच पर garlic बाहर से जल जाता है और अंदर का flavor नहीं निकलता।
स्टेप 1: Cold Start
एक pan लें।
500 ml refined oil डालें।
तुरंत बारीक कटा garlic डालें।

महत्वपूर्ण नियम

Garlic हमेशा ठंडे तेल में डालें।
गरम तेल में कभी न डालें।
स्टेप 2: Slow Cooking
Flame को बहुत धीमा रखें।
Garlic को धीरे-धीरे तेल में पकने दें।
Garlic के bubbles धीरे-धीरे कम होंगे।
स्टेप 3: Color Check
ध्यान से देखें।
जैसे ही garlic light golden हो, तुरंत गैस बंद करें।

चेतावनी

Garlic को dark brown या काला न होने दें।
जला garlic तेल को कड़वा बना देता है।
स्टेप 4: Cooling
Pan को तुरंत heat से हटा लें।
तेल को प्राकृतिक रूप से ठंडा होने दें।

महत्वपूर्ण नोट

Pan की बची हुई गर्मी garlic को थोड़ा और पकाएगी।
Final golden रंग cooling के दौरान आता है।
स्टेप 5: Storage
ठंडा होने के बाद इसे:
glass bottle
या
dispenser bottle
में भरें।
Fried garlic bits तेल के अंदर ही रहने दें।
3. उपयोग गाइड (1-Spoon Rule)
Hakka Noodles / Fried Rice
Plate में निकालने से पहले 1 tbsp garlic oil डालें।
Aroma और shine के लिए एक बार toss करें।
Clear Soups
Serve करने के बाद ऊपर 1/2 tsp garlic oil डालें।
Dry Starters

उदाहरण:

Crispy Corn
Veg Salt & Pepper

Final finishing drizzle के रूप में डालें।

4. समस्या समाधान

तेल कड़वा लग रहा है

कारण: Garlic dark brown या काला हो गया।
समाधान: Light golden stage पर गैस बंद करें।

Garlic aroma नहीं है

कारण: तेज आंच / जल्दी पकाया गया।
समाधान:
हमेशा cold start करें
8–10 मिनट धीरे पकाएं

तेल sticky हो गया

कारण:
पुराना तेल इस्तेमाल हुआ
या
Bottle में नमी चली गई
समाधान:
Fresh refined oil इस्तेमाल करें
सूखी साफ bottle में रखें
5. Kitchen Rule (Kyroz Master Tip)

Garlic oil को cooking oil की तरह इस्तेमाल न करें।

गलत उपयोग:

इसमें सब्जियां fry करना

सही उपयोग:

हमेशा finishing oil की तरह सबसे अंत में डालें।

कारण

इससे:
fresh garlic aroma
premium flavor
बेहतर customer experience मिलता है।

TITLE: HONEY CHILLI POTATO SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Potato Preparation (Crispiness Rule)

Cutting & Coating
Cut potatoes into equal finger-shaped pieces.
Soak in water for some time.
Drain properly.
Coat with:
Dry cornflour
Little maida
Salt
Double Fry Secret

First Fry

Fry potatoes until 80% cooked.
Remove and keep aside.

Second Fry (Order Time)

Refry in very hot oil until extremely crispy.

Important Rule

Potatoes should be extra crispy before adding sauce.
2. Sauce Preparation (Per Portion)
Ingredients
Refined Oil: 1 tbsp
Chopped Garlic: 1 tsp
White Sesame Seeds: 1 tsp
Water: 100 ml
Kyroz Z-105 TANGY COAT Powder: 1 tsp
Tomato Ketchup: 1 tbsp
Honey: 1 tbsp
Cornflour Slurry: 1 tbsp
Green Spring Onion (for garnish)
3. Cooking Steps
Step 1: Aroma Base
Heat oil in wok.
Add:
chopped garlic
white sesame seeds
Cook until sesame starts crackling.
Step 2: Sauce Base
Add 100 ml water.
Add:
Kyroz Z-105 TANGY COAT powder
tomato ketchup
Bring to boil.
Step 3: Glaze Formation
Add cornflour slurry.
Cook until sauce becomes:
thick
glossy
syrup-like sticky
Step 4: Honey Stage
Reduce flame.
Add 1 tbsp honey.

Important Rule

Do NOT overcook honey.
Overcooking changes flavor.
Step 5: Final Toss
Add extra crispy fried potatoes.
Toss on high flame for only 10 seconds.

Reason

Sauce should coat potatoes.
Potatoes should NOT become soft.
Step 6: Finish

Garnish with:

chopped spring onion
extra sesame seeds

Serve immediately.

4. Troubleshooting

Potatoes became soggy

Reason:
Sauce was thin
OR
Tossed too long
Fix:
Make sticky thick sauce first
Then add potatoes

Dish looks dark

Reason:
Soy sauce added
OR
Garlic burnt
Fix:
Never add soy sauce
Garlic should not burn

Not sweet enough

Reason:
Less honey
OR
Less Z-105 powder
Fix:
Add 1/2 tsp sugar
Increase honey

Sesame tastes bitter

Reason: Sesame burnt
Fix: Cook only until light golden
5. Kitchen Rules
Color Rule
Final dish should be bright reddish-orange
NOT dark like Manchurian
Serving Rule
Serve within 1 minute
Otherwise steam softens potatoes
Texture Rule
Sauce should stick like honey
It should NOT flow on the plate
CONTENT (HI): 1. आलू की तैयारी (Crispiness Rule)

Cutting & Coating
आलू को बराबर finger shape में काटें।
कुछ समय पानी में भिगोएं।
अच्छी तरह पानी निकालें।
Coat करें:
Dry cornflour
थोड़ा maida
नमक
Double Fry Secret

पहला Fry

आलू को 80% पकने तक fry करें।
निकालकर अलग रखें।

दूसरा Fry (Order Time)

बहुत गरम तेल में दोबारा fry करें जब तक extra crispy न हो जाए।

महत्वपूर्ण नियम

Sauce डालने से पहले आलू बहुत crispy होने चाहिए।
2. Sauce तैयारी (प्रति पोर्शन)
सामग्री
Refined Oil: 1 tbsp
Chopped Garlic: 1 tsp
White Sesame Seeds: 1 tsp
पानी: 100 ml
Kyroz Z-105 TANGY COAT Powder: 1 tsp
Tomato Ketchup: 1 tbsp

हरा spring onion (garnish)
3. बनाने की प्रक्रिया

Sesame चटकने तक पकाएं।

tomato ketchup
उबाल आने दें।
स्टेप 3: Glaze बनाना
Cornflour slurry डालें।
तब तक पकाएं जब तक sauce:
thick
glossy
syrup जैसी sticky न हो जाए।
स्टेप 4: Honey Stage
Flame धीमी करें।
1 tbsp honey डालें।

महत्वपूर्ण नियम

Honey को ज्यादा न पकाएं।
ज्यादा पकाने से flavor बदल जाता है।

आलू soft नहीं होने चाहिए।
स्टेप 6: Finish

Garnish करें:

chopped spring onion

पहले sticky thick sauce बनाएं

Soy sauce डाला गया
या
Garlic जल गया
समाधान:
Soy sauce कभी न डालें
Garlic न जलाएं

पर्याप्त मीठा नहीं है

कारण:
Honey कम
या
Z-105 powder कम
समाधान:
1/2 tsp चीनी डालें
Honey बढ़ाएं

Sesame कड़वा लग रहा है

कारण: Sesame जल गया
समाधान: केवल हल्का golden होने तक पकाएं
5. Kitchen Rules
Color Rule
Final dish bright reddish-orange होनी चाहिए
Manchurian जैसी dark नहीं
Serving Rule
1 मिनट के अंदर serve करें
नहीं तो steam से आलू soft हो जाएंगे
Texture Rule
Sauce honey की तरह chipakna चाहिए
Plate में बहना नहीं चाहिए

TITLE: HOT & SOUR SOUP SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Essential Ingredients (Per Portion / Bowl)

Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE LIQUID: 120 ml
Plain Water: 180 ml
Finely Chopped Vegetables: 2 tbsp
Carrot
Beans
Cabbage
Mushroom
Bamboo Shoot / Paneer Cubes
Vinegar: 1/2 tsp
Red Chilli Paste or Green Chilli: 1/2 tsp (optional for extra spice)
Cornflour Slurry: 2–3 tbsp
Spring Onion: for garnish

Purpose

Z-102 Liquid → sharp soup flavor base
Vinegar → sourness
Cornflour slurry → thickness
Vegetables → texture
2. Cooking Method (3-Minute Process)
Step 1: Vegetable Sauté
Heat a little oil in wok.
Add all finely chopped vegetables.
Sauté for 20 seconds only.

Important Rule

Vegetables should remain slightly crunchy.
Do NOT overcook.
Step 2: Liquid Base
Add:
120 ml Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE LIQUID
180 ml plain water
Bring to boil.
Step 3: Sour Hit
Once boiling starts, add 1/2 tsp vinegar.
If customer wants spicy soup:
add red chilli paste
OR
chopped green chilli
Step 4: Thickening
Slowly add cornflour slurry.
Stir continuously.
Soup should become:
slightly thick
clear
glossy

Soup Rule

Hot & Sour should be thicker than clear soup.
But cleaner and lighter than Manchow.
Step 5: Final Serve
Pour into serving bowl.
Garnish with spring onion.
Serve hot.

Important Note

Fried noodles are NOT served with Hot & Sour Soup.
3. Troubleshooting

Soup too sour

Reason: Vinegar too much
Fix: Add 1/2 tsp sugar

Soup looks cloudy

Reason: Cornflour not cooked properly
Fix:
Boil on high flame for 30 seconds
Soup should turn shiny and clearer

Not spicy enough

Reason: Chilli diluted
Fix:
Add little extra chilli paste
OR
pinch of Z-102 dry powder

Flavor feels flat

Reason: Less umami / seasoning
Fix:
1/4 tsp soy sauce
OR
pinch of seasoning enhancer
4. Variation: Lemon Coriander Soup

Use same base with small changes:

Changes
Same Z-102 + water ratio
Do NOT add soy sauce
Add at finishing:
1 tbsp lemon juice
lots of fresh chopped coriander

Result

Fresh light garlicky soup
CONTENT (HI): 1. आवश्यक सामग्री (प्रति पोर्शन / बाउल)

Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE LIQUID: 120 ml
साधारण पानी: 180 ml
बारीक कटी सब्जियां: 2 tbsp
गाजर
बीन्स
पत्ता गोभी
मशरूम
Bamboo Shoot / Paneer Cubes
Vinegar: 1/2 tsp
Red Chilli Paste या Green Chilli: 1/2 tsp (extra spicy के लिए)
Cornflour Slurry: 2–3 tbsp
Spring Onion: garnish के लिए

उद्देश्य

Z-102 Liquid → sharp soup flavor base
Vinegar → खट्टापन
Cornflour slurry → thickness
Vegetables → texture
2. बनाने की प्रक्रिया (3 मिनट प्रक्रिया)
स्टेप 1: सब्जियों को Sauté करें
Wok में थोड़ा तेल गरम करें।
सभी बारीक कटी सब्जियां डालें।
केवल 20 सेकंड sauté करें।

महत्वपूर्ण नियम

सब्जियां हल्की crunchy रहनी चाहिए।
ज्यादा न पकाएं।
स्टेप 2: Liquid Base
डालें:
120 ml Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE LIQUID
180 ml साधारण पानी
उबाल आने दें।
स्टेप 3: Sour Hit
उबाल आने पर 1/2 tsp vinegar डालें।
ग्राहक extra spicy चाहे तो:
red chilli paste
या
chopped green chilli डालें।
स्टेप 4: Thickening
धीरे-धीरे cornflour slurry डालें।
लगातार चलाते रहें।
Soup होना चाहिए:
हल्का thick
clear
glossy

Soup Rule

Hot & Sour clear soup से thick होना चाहिए।
लेकिन Manchow से हल्का और cleaner होना चाहिए।
स्टेप 5: Final Serve
Serving bowl में निकालें।
Spring onion garnish करें।
गरमा-गरम serve करें।

महत्वपूर्ण नोट

Hot & Sour Soup के साथ fried noodles नहीं दिए जाते।
3. समस्या समाधान

Soup ज्यादा खट्टा है

कारण: Vinegar ज्यादा
समाधान: 1/2 tsp चीनी डालें।

Soup cloudy दिख रहा है

कारण: Cornflour सही नहीं पका।
समाधान:
30 सेकंड high flame पर उबालें
Soup shiny और clear होना चाहिए।

पर्याप्त spicy नहीं

कारण: Chilli dilute हो गई।
समाधान:
extra chilli paste
या
pinch Z-102 dry powder डालें।

Flavor flat लग रहा है

कारण: Umami / seasoning कम
समाधान:
1/4 tsp soy sauce
या
थोड़ा seasoning enhancer
4. Variation: Lemon Coriander Soup

इसी base से छोटे बदलाव के साथ बनाएं:

बदलाव
वही Z-102 + पानी ratio
Soy sauce न डालें
अंत में डालें:
1 tbsp lemon juice
खूब सारा fresh chopped coriander

परिणाम

Fresh, हल्का garlicky soup

TITLE: MANCHOW SOUP SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Essential Ingredients (Per Portion / Bowl)

Kyroz Z-101 DARK MASTER Liquid: 100 ml
Plain Water: 200 ml
Finely Chopped Vegetables: 2 tbsp
Carrot
Cabbage
Beans
Capsicum
Finely Chopped Garlic: 1 tsp
Finely Chopped Ginger: 1/2 tsp
Finely Chopped Coriander Stems: 1 tsp
Cornflour Slurry: 2–3 tbsp
Black Pepper: 1 pinch
Vinegar: 1 drop
Fried Noodles: topping
Spring Onion: garnish

Purpose

DARK MASTER → soup flavor base
Garlic + ginger → aroma
Coriander stems → premium restaurant flavor
Cornflour → thickness
2. Cooking Method (3-Minute Process)
Step 1: Aromatic Base
Heat a little oil in a wok/pan.
Add:
chopped garlic
chopped ginger
chopped coriander stems
Sauté until garlic becomes light golden brown.

Important Rule

Slight burnt garlic aroma is signature flavor.
But do NOT burn completely.
Step 2: Vegetable Toss
Add all chopped vegetables.
Stir fry on high flame for 10–15 seconds only.

Rule

Vegetables should remain crunchy.
Step 3: Liquid Base
Add:
100 ml Kyroz Z-101 DARK MASTER Liquid
200 ml plain water
Bring to boil.
Step 4: Thickening
Slowly add cornflour slurry.
Stir continuously.
Soup should become:
slightly thick
coating consistency
glossy
Step 5: Final Flavor Hit

Add:

1 pinch black pepper
1 drop vinegar

This gives fresh finishing punch.

Step 6: Serving
Pour soup into serving bowl.
Top generously with:
fried noodles
spring onion

Serve immediately.

3. Troubleshooting

Soup tastes bland

Reason: Too much water / less master liquid
Fix:

Soup looks too dark

Reason: Base too concentrated
Fix:
Add little plain water
adjust seasoning

Fried noodles became soft

Reason: Added too early
Fix:
Add noodles only at serving time
OR
serve separately

Missing restaurant aroma

Reason: Garlic + coriander stems not sautéed properly
Fix:
cook garlic till golden

OR

Benefit

TITLE: UNIVERSAL CRISPY FRY SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Morning Preparation (Pre-Marination)

Protein Preparation

Cut into cubes as needed:

Chicken
Paneer
Mushroom
Marination (Per 1 kg Protein)

Add:

Light salt

Mix well and refrigerate.

Benefit

Prevents bland taste after frying.
2. Batter Preparation (Coating Mix)
Ingredients
Kyroz Z-106 ARMOUR BASE Powder: 200g
Egg: 1 piece (skip for veg items)
Chilled Water: 100–150 ml
Method
Take a mixing bowl.
Add:
Z-106 powder
egg (if required)
Slowly add chilled water.
Mix until thick batter forms.

Consistency Rule

Batter should be thick enough to coat your finger with a heavy layer.
If batter flows like water → add more powder.
3. Universal Frying Chart
Chicken Lollipop

Coating: Thick batter

Frying Method

Second Fry: 30 seconds on high flame

Result

Fully cooked inside

Coating: Thick batter

Method

Coating: Medium batter

Method

High flame

Method

Do NOT make wet batter
Direct powder coating and fry
4. Speed Checklist for Helper

✔ Dry Check

Protein should be dry before dipping into batter.

✔ Dip

Coat evenly from all sides.

✔ Drop Rule

Drop pieces one by one.
Do NOT overcrowd.

✔ Final Crunch Rule

Before serving, do flash fry for 10 seconds in very hot oil.
5. Troubleshooting

Coating became soggy

Protein was wet
OR
Oil was cold

Heat oil until very hot

Coating came off while frying

Fix: Add more Z-106 powder

Outside cooked, inside raw

Reason: Oil too hot
Fix:
First fry on medium flame
Slow inside cooking is necessary

TITLE: UNIVERSAL CHILLI BASE SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Morning Base Preparation (5 Litre Batch)

Prepare this master chilli base every morning in fixed measurements.

Ingredients
Oil: 150 ml
Chopped Garlic: 150g
Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE Powder: 150g (1 scoop)
Water: 4.5 litres
Soy Sauce: 50 ml
Red Chilli Sauce: 250 ml
Green Chilli Sauce: 150 ml
Vinegar: 120 ml
Tomato Ketchup: 40 ml
Preparation Steps
Heat 150 ml oil in a large pan.
Add 150g chopped garlic.
Cook lightly.

Important Rule

Do NOT brown the garlic.
Only remove raw smell.
Add 150g Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE powder.
Stir for 5–8 seconds only.
Add:
4.5 litres water
soy sauce
red chilli sauce
green chilli sauce
vinegar
ketchup
Bring to one boil.
Store for service use.
2. Order Time Cooking Chart
Required Items
Cube-cut onion
Cube-cut capsicum
Fried protein:
Paneer
Chicken
Mushroom
Soya Chaap
Cornflour slurry
Oil
Step 1: Vegetable Toss
Heat oil in wok.
Add onion + capsicum.
Stir fry for 20 seconds only.

Rule

Vegetables must remain crunchy.
Step 2: Choose Style

Dry Chilli

Add 100 ml chilli base (half ladle)

Gravy Chilli

Add 300 ml chilli base (1.5 ladle)

Bring to boil.

Step 3: Thickening
Add cornflour slurry.
Cook until sauce becomes:
thick
glossy
shiny
Step 4: Final Toss
Add fried protein.
Toss on high flame.
3. Quick Guide by Variant
Chilli Paneer
Use lightly batter-fried paneer cubes.
Chilli Chicken
Use fried boneless chicken chunks.
Chilli Mushroom
Use batter-fried mushroom halves.
Chilli Soya Chaap
Use fried chaap pieces.
4. Dry vs Gravy Rule

Dry Style

Sauce should only coat the protein.
No extra liquid should remain.

Gravy Style

Sauce should remain flowing in the plate/bowl.
5. Troubleshooting

Dish tastes bland

Reason: Base weak / vegetables too much

Too spicy

Reason: Too much green chilli
Fix:

OR
add ketchup

Sauce not sticking

Reason: Less slurry / too much liquid
Fix:
Add more cornflour slurry
cook on high flame

Color too dark

Reason: Too much soy sauce
Fix:
Add warm water
little red chilli sauce

Important Rule

3. Schezwan Noodles (Per Portion)
Ingredients
Oil: 1 tbsp
Chopped Garlic: 1 tsp
Julienne Vegetables:
Cabbage
Carrot
Capsicum
Spring Onion
Boiled Noodles: 180–200g
Schezwan Paste: 1–1.5 tbsp
Garlic Oil / Chilli Oil: 1 tsp
Cooking Steps
Heat wok on very high flame.
Add oil.
Add chopped garlic.
Toss for 5–10 seconds only.
Add vegetables.
Stir fry on high flame for 15–20 seconds.
Add boiled noodles.
Add:
Schezwan paste
Garlic oil or chilli oil

4. Schezwan Fried Rice (Per Portion)

Chopped garlic
Schezwan paste
Chilli oil
Steps

Same wok toss process:

High flame
Fast toss
No overcooking
5. Schezwan Dry / Gravy Dishes
Ingredients
Fried paneer / chicken / mushroom / chaap
Cube-cut onion
Cube-cut capsicum
Schezwan paste
Water
Cornflour slurry
Oil
Dry Style Method
Heat oil in wok.
Add onion + capsicum.
Toss for 20 seconds.
Add Schezwan paste + little water.
Bring to boil.
Add cornflour slurry (small amount if needed).
Add fried protein.
Toss quickly.

Rule

Sauce should only coat the pieces.
Gravy Style Method
Follow same process.
Add extra water.
Add more slurry for thick glossy gravy.

Rule

Gravy should remain flowing.
6. Helper Advice

Heat Rule

Schezwan dishes must always be cooked on very high flame.

Speed Rule

Fast tossing only.
Slow cooking ruins texture.

Spice Rule

Schezwan dishes are naturally spicy.
Ask customer spice preference if needed.

Finish Rule

Add 1 tsp chilli oil at the end for premium aroma and shine.

slow cooking

TITLE: KFC-STYLE CRISPY CHICKEN (C-510 ZING MASTER)
CATEGORY: Cafe
CONTENT (EN): 1. MARINATION STANDARD (24-HOUR PROCESS)

Item: Chicken Cuts
Specification: Popcorn, Strips, Wings, or Leg Pieces (1 kg)
Notes: Fresh and properly cleaned

Item: Marinade Powder
Specification: C-510 ZING MASTER (40g)
Notes: Measure accurately

Item: Water
Specification: 50ml to 60ml
Notes: For dissolving seasoning; if chicken is already wet, avoid extra water

Item: Marination Time
Specification: 24 Hours (Mandatory)
Notes: Keep inside refrigerator (Chiller Zone)

Marination Method:
For 1 kg chicken, mix 40g C-510 ZING MASTER in 50ml water to create a thick paste.
Apply evenly over all chicken pieces and mix thoroughly.
Store in an airtight container and refrigerate for 24 hours.
This ensures the seasoning penetrates deep inside the chicken, including near the bone.

--------------------------------------------------

2. DRY COATING STATION SETUP

Set up these two containers:
Tub 1 (Dry Mix): Refined Flour (Maida) + 1 spoon C-509 FIRE DUST
Tub 2 (Chilled Water): Ice-cold water

--------------------------------------------------

3. STEP-BY-STEP COOKING METHOD

Step 1: First Coating
Remove marinated chicken from refrigerator.
Place it in dry flour.
Lightly coat using gentle hand movement.

Step 2: Water Dip
Dip coated chicken in cold water for 2–3 seconds.

Step 3: Second Coating
Return chicken to dry flour.
Toss gently 10–12 times to create crispy flakes.

Step 4: Shake
Shake off extra flour.

Step 5: Frying
Immediately place in hot oil.

--------------------------------------------------

4. FRYING TEMPERATURE & TIME

CRITICAL RULE: Oil must be fully preheated.

Chicken Popcorn:
Temperature: 180°C
Time: 3–4 minutes
Check: Golden brown and floating

Chicken Strips:
Temperature: 180°C
Time: 4–5 minutes
Check: Crispy texture

Chicken Wings:
Temperature: 170°C
Time: 6–7 minutes
Check: Fully cooked

Chicken Leg Piece:
Temperature: 160°C
Time: 10–12 minutes
Check: Deep internal cooking

--------------------------------------------------

5. HELPER TIPS

No Extra Salt: C-510 already contains balanced salt and spice.
Ice Cold Water Only: Normal water will ruin coating.
Avoid Overcrowding: Do not fry too many pieces together.

--------------------------------------------------

6. TROUBLESHOOTING

Problem: Crunch too hard
Reason: Pressed too hard in flour
Solution: Use gentle coating

Problem: Coating falling off
Reason: Water not cold enough
Solution: Use chilled water and shake properly

Problem: Raw inside
Reason: Oil too hot
Solution: Fry slowly at 160°C

--------------------------------------------------

7. PRESENTATION

After frying, place chicken on strainer for 1 minute.
Sprinkle C-509 FIRE DUST on top.
Serve in bucket or plate.
CONTENT (HI): 1. मैरिनेशन स्टैंडर्ड (24 घंटे प्रक्रिया)

आइटम: चिकन कट्स
विवरण: पॉपकॉर्न, स्ट्रिप्स, विंग्स या लेग पीस (1 किलो)
नोट: ताज़ा और साफ

आइटम: मैरिनेड पाउडर
विवरण: C-510 ZING MASTER (40 ग्राम)
नोट: सही मात्रा लें

आइटम: पानी
विवरण: 50–60 ml
नोट: मसाला घोलने के लिए

आइटम: मैरिनेशन समय
विवरण: 24 घंटे (अनिवार्य)
नोट: फ्रिज के चिलर में रखें

मैरिनेशन विधि:
1 किलो चिकन के लिए 40 ग्राम C-510 ZING MASTER को 50 ml पानी में मिलाकर गाढ़ा पेस्ट बनाएं।
इस पेस्ट को चिकन के सभी पीस पर अच्छे से लगाएं।
एयरटाइट कंटेनर में बंद करके 24 घंटे फ्रिज में रखें।
इससे मसाला अंदर तक अच्छी तरह पहुंचता है।

--------------------------------------------------

2. ड्राई कोटिंग सेटअप

दो कंटेनर तैयार करें:
टब 1 (ड्राई मिक्स): मैदा + 1 चम्मच C-509 FIRE DUST
टब 2 (ठंडा पानी): बर्फ जैसा ठंडा पानी

--------------------------------------------------

3. कुकिंग प्रोसेस

स्टेप 1: पहली कोटिंग
मैरिनेटेड चिकन को फ्रिज से निकालें।
मैदे में डालें।
हल्के हाथ से कोट करें।

स्टेप 2: पानी डिप
2–3 सेकंड ठंडे पानी में डुबोएं।

स्टेप 3: दूसरी कोटिंग
फिर मैदे में डालें।
10–12 बार हल्के हाथ से घुमाएं।

स्टेप 4: झटकें
अतिरिक्त मैदा हटा दें।

स्टेप 5: फ्राई करें
तुरंत गरम तेल में डालें।

--------------------------------------------------

4. फ्राइंग तापमान और समय

महत्वपूर्ण नियम: तेल पूरी तरह गरम होना चाहिए।

चिकन पॉपकॉर्न:
तापमान: 180°C
समय: 3–4 मिनट
चेक: गोल्डन ब्राउन

चिकन स्ट्रिप्स:
तापमान: 180°C
समय: 4–5 मिनट
चेक: क्रिस्पी

चिकन विंग्स:
तापमान: 170°C
समय: 6–7 मिनट
चेक: पूरी तरह पका

चिकन लेग पीस:
तापमान: 160°C
समय: 10–12 मिनट
चेक: अंदर तक पका हुआ

--------------------------------------------------

5. हेल्पर टिप्स

अतिरिक्त नमक न डालें: मसाले में सब बैलेंस है।
सिर्फ ठंडा पानी इस्तेमाल करें: नॉर्मल पानी कोटिंग खराब करेगा।
बहुत सारे पीस साथ में न डालें: तेल का तापमान गिर जाएगा।

--------------------------------------------------

6. समस्याएं और समाधान

समस्या: बहुत हार्ड क्रंच
कारण: बहुत जोर से दबाया
समाधान: हल्के हाथ से कोट करें

कारण: पानी पर्याप्त ठंडा नहीं
समाधान: ठंडा पानी इस्तेमाल करें

समस्या: अंदर से कच्चा
कारण: तेल ज्यादा गरम
समाधान: 160°C पर धीरे पकाएं

--------------------------------------------------

7. सर्विंग

फ्राई होने के बाद 1 मिनट स्ट्रेनर पर रखें।
ऊपर से C-509 FIRE DUST छिड़कें।
बकेट या प्लेट में सर्व करें।

TITLE: MASTER CAFE-STYLE BURGER ASSEMBLY
CATEGORY: Cafe
CONTENT (EN): 1. THE 6-LAYER ASSEMBLY (BURGER SYSTEM)

The burger should be assembled from bottom to top in this exact sequence:
Bottom Bun: Apply C-503 VELVET GLAZE (Base sauce layer)
Layer 02 (Bottom Vegetables): A light layer of shredded lettuce or cabbage
Layer 03 (Cheese - Optional): 1 cheese slice (if requested by customer)
Layer 04 (Main Patty): Hot and crispy patty made using C-502 GRILL DUST
Layer 05 (Top Toppings): 2 slices tomato + 2 slices onion/cucumber
Top Bun: Apply C-503 VELVET GLAZE (Classic or spicy variant)

--------------------------------------------------

2. COOKING STEPS

Step 1: Bun Toasting
Cut burger bun into two halves.
Apply light butter and toast inner side on tawa or griddle for 15–20 seconds.
Bun should remain soft, not over toasted.

Step 2: Base Sauce
Apply 1 small spoon of C-503 VELVET GLAZE evenly on bottom bun.

Step 3: Vegetable Layer
Place shredded lettuce or cabbage over sauce.
This prevents bun from becoming soggy.

Step 4: Patty & Cheese
Place freshly fried hot patty.
If cheese burger, place cheese slice immediately over hot patty so it melts slightly.

Step 5: Top Toppings
Add tomato and onion slices over patty.

Step 6: Top Sauce & Closing
Apply 1 spoon sauce inside top bun.
Close burger.
Press lightly and wrap.

--------------------------------------------------

3. MENU VARIATIONS

Classic Aloo Tikki Burger:
Patty: Standard Aloo Patty
Sauce: Mayo + Ketchup + Premix

Crispy Veggie Crunch Burger:
Patty: Mix Veg Patty + Crunchy Coating
Sauce: Mayo + Ketchup + Premix

Tandoori Paneer Burger:
Patty: Fried Paneer Slab
Sauce: Mayo + Premix + Chilli Powder

Spicy Chicken Zinger:
Patty: Chicken Mince Patty
Sauce: Mayo + Chilli Sauce + Premix

--------------------------------------------------

4. HELPER TIPS

The Crunch Rule: Always fry patty when order arrives. Pre-fried patties become soft.
Sauce Balance: Spread sauce evenly till bun edges.
Vegetable Freshness: Cut tomatoes and onions fresh and store chilled. Cold crunchy vegetables improve taste.

--------------------------------------------------

5. TROUBLESHOOTING

Problem: Burger slipping apart
Reason: Too much sauce or wet tomato
Solution: Dry tomato slices and use controlled sauce quantity

Problem: Bottom bun soggy
Reason: Hot patty placed directly on bun
Solution: Always add lettuce/cabbage barrier

Problem: Bun dry and hard
Reason: Old bun or over toasted
Solution: Use fresh buns and light warming only

--------------------------------------------------

6. PRESENTATION

Wrap burger properly in burger wrap paper.
Serve hot.
Optional: Add fries or dip alongside.

CONTENT (HI): 1. 6-लेयर बर्गर असेंबली सिस्टम

बर्गर को नीचे से ऊपर इस क्रम में बनाना है:
बॉटम बन: C-503 VELVET GLAZE सॉस लगाएं
लेयर 2: हल्की लेट्यूस या पत्ता गोभी
लेयर 3: 1 चीज स्लाइस (यदि ग्राहक मांगे)
लेयर 4: गरम और क्रिस्पी पैटी
लेयर 5: 2 टमाटर स्लाइस + 2 प्याज/खीरा स्लाइस
टॉप बन: C-503 VELVET GLAZE सॉस

--------------------------------------------------

2. कुकिंग स्टेप्स

स्टेप 1: बन टोस्टिंग
बर्गर बन को दो हिस्सों में काटें।
हल्का बटर लगाकर 15–20 सेकंड सेकें।
बन नरम रहना चाहिए।

ऊपर लेट्यूस या पत्ता गोभी रखें।

स्टेप 5: टॉप टॉपिंग्स
टमाटर और प्याज रखें।

स्टेप 6: बंद करें
ऊपर वाले बन पर सॉस लगाएं।
बर्गर बंद करें।
हल्का प्रेस करें।

मिक्स वेज पैटी

सॉस: मेयो + चिली सॉस + प्रीमिक्स

TITLE: MASTER PIZZA ASSEMBLY & BAKING (C-500 SERIES)
CATEGORY: Cafe
CONTENT (EN): 1. RAW MATERIAL MEASUREMENT (PER 10-INCH MEDIUM PIZZA)

Pizza Base: C-501 DOUGH MASTER prepared 10-inch pizza base
Pizza Sauce: C-506 MARINARA CORE sauce | Quantity: 50g
Cheese: Mozzarella + Cheddar diced blend | Quantity: 80g–100g
Vegetables: Capsicum, Onion, Sweet Corn, Mushroom | Quantity: 40g
Seasoning: C-509 FIRE DUST | For final topping

--------------------------------------------------

2. PIZZA ASSEMBLY STEPS

Step 1: Base Docking
Take the prepared pizza base.
If the base is not pre-baked, prick small holes across the surface using a fork.
This prevents the pizza from puffing in the center during baking.

Step 2: Sauce Layering
Add 50g pizza sauce in the center.
Spread evenly in circular motion.
Leave approximately 1/2 inch crust edge uncovered.

Step 3: First Cheese Layer
Add 30% of total cheese over the sauce.
This acts as a locking layer and helps toppings stay in place.

Step 4: Toppings Placement
Spread vegetables evenly across the pizza.
Do not overload one section.

Step 5: Final Cheese Layer
Add remaining 70% cheese evenly over toppings.
Toppings should be lightly covered.

--------------------------------------------------

3. BAKING STANDARDS

CRITICAL RULE: Preheat oven at least 15 minutes before baking. Cold oven will produce hard pizza.

Commercial Deck Oven:
Top Temperature: 280°C
Bottom Temperature: 260°C

Conveyor Pizza Oven:
Temperature: 250°C
Speed: 5 to 5.5 minutes

Baking Time: 5 to 6 minutes
Bake until: Cheese develops light brown spots and Crust becomes golden brown

--------------------------------------------------

4. HELPER TIPS

No Soggy Base: Ensure vegetables are dry. Wet vegetables can make pizza soggy.
Golden Edge Finish: After baking, lightly brush butter or olive oil on crust edges. Improves shine and premium appearance.
Cutting Rule: Cut immediately after baking using pizza cutter. Cut into 4 or 6 equal slices. Late cutting causes cheese stretching issues.

--------------------------------------------------

5. TROUBLESHOOTING

Problem: Cheese burned but base raw
Reason: Top heat too high
Solution: Reduce top heat by 10–20°C and increase bottom heat

Problem: Pizza puffed in center
Reason: Base not docked properly
Solution: Always prick holes before baking

Problem: Cheese melted but no stretch
Reason: Low oven temperature or underbaked
Solution: Maintain 260°C+ and bake till brown spots appear

--------------------------------------------------

6. PRESENTATION

Place pizza in pizza box or wooden platter.
Provide 1 small pouch of C-509 FIRE DUST alongside.
Serve hot.

Kyroz+ Systems | Accuracy. Consistency. Growth.
Perfect Crust. Perfect Melt.

TITLE: PREMIUM CAFE-STYLE WRAPS & ROLLS (C-500 SERIES)
CATEGORY: Cafe
CONTENT (EN): 1. WRAP STRUCTURE (LAYERING SYSTEM)

The wrap should be assembled from inside to outside in this exact structure:
Base: 8-inch or 10-inch Tortilla / Lachha Paratha
Moisture Barrier: Light layer of lettuce or cabbage
Purpose: Prevents sauce from making the wrap soggy
Main Filling: Fried Patty (C-502) / Paneer / OR Crispy Fried Chicken (C-510 ZING MASTER)
Flavor Layer: Long sliced onions + tomatoes + light sprinkle of C-509 FIRE DUST
Creamy Finish: 2 tablespoons C-503 VELVET GLAZE sauce

--------------------------------------------------

2. COOKING STEPS

Step 1: Base Heating
Warm tortilla or paratha lightly on tawa without oil or butter.
Heat for 10–15 seconds on both sides.
Base should remain soft and foldable.

Step 2: Sauce Application
Apply 1 tablespoon C-503 VELVET GLAZE sauce in center line.

Step 3: Vegetable Layer
Add shredded lettuce or cabbage over sauce.

Step 4: Filling Placement
Veg Version: Place sliced/crushed C-502 veg patty
Non-Veg Version: Place crispy fried chicken strips prepared using C-510 ZING MASTER

Step 5: Flavor Toppings
Add long sliced onions and tomatoes.
Sprinkle C-509 FIRE DUST lightly.

Step 6: Final Sauce Layer
Add 1 additional spoon of C-503 VELVET GLAZE over filling.

Step 7: Folding & Grilling
Fold bottom edge slightly upward.
Fold both sides inward.
Roll tightly.
Apply light butter on tawa or griller.
Toast for approximately 30 seconds until golden grill marks appear.

--------------------------------------------------

3. MENU VARIATIONS

Classic Veggie Wrap
Base: 8-inch Tortilla | Filling: C-502 Veg Patty (Crushed) | Seasoning: Mild C-509 FIRE DUST

Peri-Peri Paneer Wrap
Base: 8-inch Tortilla | Filling: Grilled Paneer Strips | Seasoning: Extra spicy C-509 FIRE DUST

Zing Crunchy Roll
Base: 8-inch Tortilla | Filling: C-510 ZING MASTER Fried Chicken | Special Sauce: C-503 mixed with mint

Crispy Chicken Wrap
Base: 8-inch Tortilla | Filling: C-510 Chicken Strips | Sauce: Standard C-503 VELVET GLAZE

--------------------------------------------------

4. HELPER TIPS

Tight Folding Rule: Always roll tightly. Loose wraps leak sauce while eating.
Crunch Rule: Chicken strips must be served hot and crispy.
Wrapping Presentation: Wrap half portion using butter paper or aluminum foil. Cut diagonally from center. This improves premium presentation.

--------------------------------------------------

5. TROUBLESHOOTING

Problem: Wrap tearing from bottom
Reason: Dry tortilla or excessive filling
Solution: Use fresh tortilla and avoid overfilling

Problem: Wrap feels dry
Reason: Less sauce or overcooked filling
Solution: Increase sauce quantity

Problem: Wrap becomes soggy
Reason: Wet vegetables or delayed serving
Solution: Grill immediately and serve fresh

--------------------------------------------------

6. PRESENTATION

Wrap half in butter paper or foil.
Cut diagonally.
Serve hot.
Optional: Serve with fries or dip.

TITLE: GARLIC OIL SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Ingredients (Batch Size: 500 ml)

Refined Oil: 500 ml
Fresh Garlic (finely chopped or crushed): 200g
Salt: 1 pinch (for preservation)
2. Cooking Method (Slow-Golden Technique)

Important Rule

Garlic oil should NEVER be made on high flame.
High heat burns garlic from outside while flavor remains trapped inside.
Step 1: Cold Start
Take a pan.
Add 500 ml refined oil.
Immediately add finely chopped garlic.

Critical Rule

Garlic should be added in cold oil.
Never add garlic to already hot oil.
Step 2: Slow Cooking
Keep flame on very low heat.
Let garlic slowly cook in oil.
Garlic bubbles will gradually reduce.
Step 3: Color Check
Watch carefully.
Once garlic becomes light golden, immediately switch off the flame.

Warning

Do NOT let garlic become dark brown or black.
Burnt garlic makes the oil bitter.
Step 4: Cooling
Remove the pan from heat immediately.
Let the oil cool naturally.

Important Note

Residual pan heat will continue cooking garlic slightly.
Final golden color develops during cooling.
Step 5: Storage
Once cooled, transfer to:
glass bottle
OR
dispenser bottle
Keep fried garlic bits inside the oil.
3. Usage Guide (1-Spoon Rule)
For Hakka Noodles / Fried Rice
Add 1 tbsp garlic oil just before plating.
Toss once for aroma and shine.
For Clear Soups
Add 1/2 tsp garlic oil on top after serving.
For Dry Starters

Examples:

Crispy Corn
Veg Salt & Pepper

Add garlic oil as final finishing drizzle.

4. Troubleshooting

Oil tastes bitter

Reason: Garlic turned dark brown or black.
Fix: Switch off flame at light golden stage.

No garlic aroma

Reason: High flame / rushed cooking.
Fix:
Always use cold start
Cook slowly for 8–10 minutes

Oil became sticky

Reason:
Old oil used
OR
Moisture entered bottle
Fix:
Use fresh refined oil
Store in dry clean bottle
5. Kitchen Rule (Kyroz Master Tip)

Do NOT use garlic oil as cooking oil.

Wrong use:

Frying vegetables in it

Correct use:

Always use as finishing oil at the very end

Reason

Final-stage usage preserves:
fresh garlic aroma
premium flavor
better customer experience
CONTENT (HI): 1. सामग्री (बैच साइज़: 500 ml)

Refined Oil: 500 ml
ताजा लहसुन (बारीक कटा या crushed): 200g
नमक: 1 चुटकी (preservation के लिए)
2. बनाने की प्रक्रिया (Slow-Golden Technique)

महत्वपूर्ण नियम

Garlic oil कभी भी high flame पर नहीं बनाना चाहिए।
तेज आंच पर garlic बाहर से जल जाता है और अंदर का flavor नहीं निकलता।
स्टेप 1: Cold Start
एक pan लें।
500 ml refined oil डालें।
तुरंत बारीक कटा garlic डालें।

महत्वपूर्ण नियम

Garlic हमेशा ठंडे तेल में डालें।
गरम तेल में कभी न डालें।
स्टेप 2: Slow Cooking
Flame को बहुत धीमा रखें।
Garlic को धीरे-धीरे तेल में पकने दें।
Garlic के bubbles धीरे-धीरे कम होंगे।
स्टेप 3: Color Check
ध्यान से देखें।
जैसे ही garlic light golden हो, तुरंत गैस बंद करें।

चेतावनी

Garlic को dark brown या काला न होने दें।
जला garlic तेल को कड़वा बना देता है।
स्टेप 4: Cooling
Pan को तुरंत heat से हटा लें।
तेल को प्राकृतिक रूप से ठंडा होने दें।

महत्वपूर्ण नोट

Pan की बची हुई गर्मी garlic को थोड़ा और पकाएगी।
Final golden रंग cooling के दौरान आता है।
स्टेप 5: Storage
ठंडा होने के बाद इसे:
glass bottle
या
dispenser bottle
में भरें।
Fried garlic bits तेल के अंदर ही रहने दें।
3. उपयोग गाइड (1-Spoon Rule)
Hakka Noodles / Fried Rice
Plate में निकालने से पहले 1 tbsp garlic oil डालें।
Aroma और shine के लिए एक बार toss करें।
Clear Soups
Serve करने के बाद ऊपर 1/2 tsp garlic oil डालें।
Dry Starters

उदाहरण:

Crispy Corn
Veg Salt & Pepper

Final finishing drizzle के रूप में डालें।

4. समस्या समाधान

तेल कड़वा लग रहा है

कारण: Garlic dark brown या काला हो गया।
समाधान: Light golden stage पर गैस बंद करें।

Garlic aroma नहीं है

कारण: तेज आंच / जल्दी पकाया गया।
समाधान:
हमेशा cold start करें
8–10 मिनट धीरे पकाएं

तेल sticky हो गया

कारण:
पुराना तेल इस्तेमाल हुआ
या
Bottle में नमी चली गई
समाधान:
Fresh refined oil इस्तेमाल करें
सूखी साफ bottle में रखें
5. Kitchen Rule (Kyroz Master Tip)

Garlic oil को cooking oil की तरह इस्तेमाल न करें।

गलत उपयोग:

इसमें सब्जियां fry करना

सही उपयोग:

हमेशा finishing oil की तरह सबसे अंत में डालें।

कारण

इससे:
fresh garlic aroma
premium flavor
बेहतर customer experience मिलता है।

TITLE: HONEY CHILLI POTATO SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Potato Preparation (Crispiness Rule)

Cutting & Coating
Cut potatoes into equal finger-shaped pieces.
Soak in water for some time.
Drain properly.
Coat with:
Dry cornflour
Little maida
Salt
Double Fry Secret

First Fry

Fry potatoes until 80% cooked.
Remove and keep aside.

Second Fry (Order Time)

Refry in very hot oil until extremely crispy.

Important Rule

Potatoes should be extra crispy before adding sauce.
2. Sauce Preparation (Per Portion)
Ingredients
Refined Oil: 1 tbsp
Chopped Garlic: 1 tsp
White Sesame Seeds: 1 tsp
Water: 100 ml
Kyroz Z-105 TANGY COAT Powder: 1 tsp
Tomato Ketchup: 1 tbsp
Honey: 1 tbsp
Cornflour Slurry: 1 tbsp
Green Spring Onion (for garnish)
3. Cooking Steps
Step 1: Aroma Base
Heat oil in wok.
Add:
chopped garlic
white sesame seeds
Cook until sesame starts crackling.
Step 2: Sauce Base
Add 100 ml water.
Add:
Kyroz Z-105 TANGY COAT powder
tomato ketchup
Bring to boil.
Step 3: Glaze Formation
Add cornflour slurry.
Cook until sauce becomes:
thick
glossy
syrup-like sticky
Step 4: Honey Stage
Reduce flame.
Add 1 tbsp honey.

Important Rule

Do NOT overcook honey.
Overcooking changes flavor.
Step 5: Final Toss
Add extra crispy fried potatoes.
Toss on high flame for only 10 seconds.

Reason

Sauce should coat potatoes.
Potatoes should NOT become soft.
Step 6: Finish

Garnish with:

chopped spring onion
extra sesame seeds

Serve immediately.

4. Troubleshooting

Potatoes became soggy

Reason:
Sauce was thin
OR
Tossed too long
Fix:
Make sticky thick sauce first
Then add potatoes

Dish looks dark

Reason:
Soy sauce added
OR
Garlic burnt
Fix:
Never add soy sauce
Garlic should not burn

Not sweet enough

Reason:
Less honey
OR
Less Z-105 powder
Fix:
Add 1/2 tsp sugar
Increase honey

Sesame tastes bitter

Reason: Sesame burnt
Fix: Cook only until light golden
5. Kitchen Rules
Color Rule
Final dish should be bright reddish-orange
NOT dark like Manchurian
Serving Rule
Serve within 1 minute
Otherwise steam softens potatoes
Texture Rule
Sauce should stick like honey
It should NOT flow on the plate
