TITLE: HOT & SOUR SOUP SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Essential Ingredients (Per Portion / Bowl)

Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE LIQUID: 120 ml
Plain Water: 180 ml
Finely Chopped Vegetables: 2 tbsp
Carrot
Beans
Cabbage
Mushroom
Bamboo Shoot / Paneer Cubes
Vinegar: 1/2 tsp
Red Chilli Paste or Green Chilli: 1/2 tsp (optional for extra spice)
Cornflour Slurry: 2–3 tbsp
Spring Onion: for garnish

Purpose

Z-102 Liquid → sharp soup flavor base
Vinegar → sourness
Cornflour slurry → thickness
Vegetables → texture
2. Cooking Method (3-Minute Process)
Step 1: Vegetable Sauté
Heat a little oil in wok.
Add all finely chopped vegetables.
Sauté for 20 seconds only.

Important Rule

Vegetables should remain slightly crunchy.
Do NOT overcook.
Step 2: Liquid Base
Add:
120 ml Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE LIQUID
180 ml plain water
Bring to boil.
Step 3: Sour Hit
Once boiling starts, add 1/2 tsp vinegar.
If customer wants spicy soup:
add red chilli paste
OR
chopped green chilli
Step 4: Thickening
Slowly add cornflour slurry.
Stir continuously.
Soup should become:
slightly thick
clear
glossy

Soup Rule

Hot & Sour should be thicker than clear soup.
But cleaner and lighter than Manchow.
Step 5: Final Serve
Pour into serving bowl.
Garnish with spring onion.
Serve hot.

Important Note

Fried noodles are NOT served with Hot & Sour Soup.
3. Troubleshooting

Soup too sour

Reason: Vinegar too much
Fix: Add 1/2 tsp sugar

Soup looks cloudy

Reason: Cornflour not cooked properly
Fix:
Boil on high flame for 30 seconds
Soup should turn shiny and clearer

Not spicy enough

Reason: Chilli diluted
Fix:
Add little extra chilli paste
OR
pinch of Z-102 dry powder

Flavor feels flat

Reason: Less umami / seasoning
Fix:
1/4 tsp soy sauce
OR
pinch of seasoning enhancer
4. Variation: Lemon Coriander Soup

Use same base with small changes:

Changes
Same Z-102 + water ratio
Do NOT add soy sauce
Add at finishing:
1 tbsp lemon juice
lots of fresh chopped coriander

Result

Fresh light garlicky soup
CONTENT (HI): 1. आवश्यक सामग्री (प्रति पोर्शन / बाउल)

Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE LIQUID: 120 ml
साधारण पानी: 180 ml
बारीक कटी सब्जियां: 2 tbsp
गाजर
बीन्स
पत्ता गोभी
मशरूम
Bamboo Shoot / Paneer Cubes
Vinegar: 1/2 tsp
Red Chilli Paste या Green Chilli: 1/2 tsp (extra spicy के लिए)
Cornflour Slurry: 2–3 tbsp
Spring Onion: garnish के लिए

उद्देश्य

Z-102 Liquid → sharp soup flavor base
Vinegar → खट्टापन
Cornflour slurry → thickness
Vegetables → texture
2. बनाने की प्रक्रिया (3 मिनट प्रक्रिया)
स्टेप 1: सब्जियों को Sauté करें
Wok में थोड़ा तेल गरम करें।
सभी बारीक कटी सब्जियां डालें।
केवल 20 सेकंड sauté करें।

महत्वपूर्ण नियम

सब्जियां हल्की crunchy रहनी चाहिए।
ज्यादा न पकाएं।
स्टेप 2: Liquid Base
डालें:
120 ml Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE LIQUID
180 ml साधारण पानी
उबाल आने दें।
स्टेप 3: Sour Hit
उबाल आने पर 1/2 tsp vinegar डालें।
ग्राहक extra spicy चाहे तो:
red chilli paste
या
chopped green chilli डालें।
स्टेप 4: Thickening
धीरे-धीरे cornflour slurry डालें।
लगातार चलाते रहें।
Soup होना चाहिए:
हल्का thick
clear
glossy

Soup Rule

Hot & Sour clear soup से thick होना चाहिए।
लेकिन Manchow से हल्का और cleaner होना चाहिए।
स्टेप 5: Final Serve
Serving bowl में निकालें।
Spring onion garnish करें।
गरमा-गरम serve करें।

महत्वपूर्ण नोट

Hot & Sour Soup के साथ fried noodles नहीं दिए जाते।
3. समस्या समाधान

Soup ज्यादा खट्टा है

कारण: Vinegar ज्यादा
समाधान: 1/2 tsp चीनी डालें।

Soup cloudy दिख रहा है

कारण: Cornflour सही नहीं पका।
समाधान:
30 सेकंड high flame पर उबालें
Soup shiny और clear होना चाहिए।

पर्याप्त spicy नहीं

कारण: Chilli dilute हो गई।
समाधान:
extra chilli paste
या
pinch Z-102 dry powder डालें।

Flavor flat लग रहा है

कारण: Umami / seasoning कम
समाधान:
1/4 tsp soy sauce
या
थोड़ा seasoning enhancer
4. Variation: Lemon Coriander Soup

इसी base से छोटे बदलाव के साथ बनाएं:

बदलाव
वही Z-102 + पानी ratio
Soy sauce न डालें
अंत में डालें:
1 tbsp lemon juice
खूब सारा fresh chopped coriander

परिणाम

Fresh, हल्का garlicky soup

TITLE: MANCHOW SOUP SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Essential Ingredients (Per Portion / Bowl)

Kyroz Z-101 DARK MASTER Liquid: 100 ml
Plain Water: 200 ml
Finely Chopped Vegetables: 2 tbsp
Carrot
Cabbage
Beans
Capsicum
Finely Chopped Garlic: 1 tsp
Finely Chopped Ginger: 1/2 tsp
Finely Chopped Coriander Stems: 1 tsp
Cornflour Slurry: 2–3 tbsp
Black Pepper: 1 pinch
Vinegar: 1 drop
Fried Noodles: topping
Spring Onion: garnish

Purpose

DARK MASTER → soup flavor base
Garlic + ginger → aroma
Coriander stems → premium restaurant flavor
Cornflour → thickness
2. Cooking Method (3-Minute Process)
Step 1: Aromatic Base
Heat a little oil in a wok/pan.
Add:
chopped garlic
chopped ginger
chopped coriander stems
Sauté until garlic becomes light golden brown.

Important Rule

Slight burnt garlic aroma is signature flavor.
But do NOT burn completely.
Step 2: Vegetable Toss
Add all chopped vegetables.
Stir fry on high flame for 10–15 seconds only.

Rule

Vegetables should remain crunchy.
Step 3: Liquid Base
Add:
100 ml Kyroz Z-101 DARK MASTER Liquid
200 ml plain water
Bring to boil.
Step 4: Thickening
Slowly add cornflour slurry.
Stir continuously.
Soup should become:
slightly thick
coating consistency
glossy
Step 5: Final Flavor Hit

Add:

1 pinch black pepper
1 drop vinegar

This gives fresh finishing punch.

Step 6: Serving
Pour soup into serving bowl.
Top generously with:
fried noodles
spring onion

Serve immediately.

3. Troubleshooting

Soup tastes bland

Reason: Too much water / less master liquid
Fix:
Add 1/2 tsp Z-101 dry powder

Soup looks too dark

Reason: Base too concentrated
Fix:
Add little plain water
adjust seasoning

Fried noodles became soft

Reason: Added too early
Fix:
Add noodles only at serving time
OR
serve separately

Missing restaurant aroma

Reason: Garlic + coriander stems not sautéed properly
Fix:
cook garlic till golden
4. Premium Tip

For premium 5-star finish (optional):
Add at the end:

1/2 tsp butter
OR
1 drop sesame oil

Benefit

Better shine
Rich aroma
Restaurant-style finish

TITLE: UNIVERSAL CRISPY FRY SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Morning Preparation (Pre-Marination)

Protein Preparation

Cut into cubes as needed:

Chicken
Paneer
Mushroom
Marination (Per 1 kg Protein)

Add:

1 tbsp Kyroz Z-103 RED FIRE BATCH Paste
Light salt

Mix well and refrigerate.

Benefit

Makes protein flavorful from inside.
Prevents bland taste after frying.
2. Batter Preparation (Coating Mix)
Ingredients
Kyroz Z-106 ARMOUR BASE Powder: 200g
Egg: 1 piece (skip for veg items)
Chilled Water: 100–150 ml
Method
Take a mixing bowl.
Add:
Z-106 powder
egg (if required)
Slowly add chilled water.
Mix until thick batter forms.

Consistency Rule

Batter should be thick enough to coat your finger with a heavy layer.
If batter flows like water → add more powder.
3. Universal Frying Chart
Chicken Lollipop

Frying Method

Second Fry: 30 seconds on high flame

Result

Fully cooked inside

Method

Same double fry process
Paneer / Mushroom

Coating: Medium batter

Method

Single fry
High flame
Around 2 minutes
Veg Manchurian Balls

Method

Dry dusting only
Do NOT make wet batter
Direct powder coating and fry
4. Speed Checklist for Helper

✔ Dry Check

Protein should be dry before dipping into batter.

✔ Dip

Coat evenly from all sides.

✔ Drop Rule

Drop pieces one by one.
Do NOT overcrowd.

✔ Final Crunch Rule

Before serving, do flash fry for 10 seconds in very hot oil.
5. Troubleshooting

Coating became soggy

Reason:
Protein was wet
OR
Oil was cold
Fix:
Dry protein properly
Heat oil until very hot

Coating came off while frying

Fix: Add more Z-106 powder

Outside cooked, inside raw

Reason: Oil too hot
Fix:
First fry on medium flame
Slow inside cooking is necessary

TITLE: UNIVERSAL CHILLI BASE SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Morning Base Preparation (5 Litre Batch)

Prepare this master chilli base every morning in fixed measurements.

Ingredients
Oil: 150 ml
Chopped Garlic: 150g
Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE Powder: 150g (1 scoop)
Water: 4.5 litres
Soy Sauce: 50 ml
Red Chilli Sauce: 250 ml
Green Chilli Sauce: 150 ml
Vinegar: 120 ml
Tomato Ketchup: 40 ml
Preparation Steps
Heat 150 ml oil in a large pan.
Add 150g chopped garlic.
Cook lightly.

Important Rule

Do NOT brown the garlic.
Only remove raw smell.
Add 150g Kyroz Z-102 CRYSTAL GLAZE powder.
Stir for 5–8 seconds only.
Add:
4.5 litres water
soy sauce
red chilli sauce
green chilli sauce
vinegar
ketchup
Bring to one boil.
Store for service use.
2. Order Time Cooking Chart
Required Items
Cube-cut onion
Cube-cut capsicum
Fried protein:
Paneer

Gravy Style

TITLE: HAKKA NOODLES & WHITE DISHES SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Covered Dishes

Veg Hakka Noodles
Chicken Hakka Noodles
Paneer Hakka Noodles
Veg Fried Rice
Chicken Fried Rice
Paneer Fried Rice
White Sauce Chinese Dishes / White Garlic Style
2. Morning Preparation
Noodles Preparation
Boil noodles until 80–90% cooked.
Drain immediately.
Wash with cold water.
Apply a little oil and toss.

Important Rule

This prevents sticking.
Keeps noodles separate during wok tossing.
Rice Preparation
Cook rice until grains are separate.
Cool completely.
Store in trays.

Rule

Never use hot rice.
Hot rice becomes sticky in wok.
White Base Preparation

Keep ready:

Chopped garlic
White pepper
Spring onion
Kyroz N-Core Powder
Garlic oil
3. Hakka Noodles Cooking (Per Portion)
Ingredients
Oil: 1 tbsp
Chopped Garlic: 1 tsp
Julienne Vegetables:
Cabbage
Carrot
Capsicum
Spring Onion
Boiled Noodles: 180–200g
Kyroz N-Core Powder: 1 tsp
Garlic Oil: 1 tsp
Cooking Steps
Heat wok on very high flame.
Add oil.
Add chopped garlic.
Toss for 5–10 seconds only.
Add vegetables.
Toss on high flame for 15–20 seconds.
Add noodles.
Add:
N-Core powder
Garlic oil
Toss rapidly.
Serve immediately.
4. Fried Rice Cooking (Per Portion)
Ingredients
Cooked cold rice: 180–200g
Same vegetables
Garlic
N-Core powder
Garlic oil
Steps

Same wok toss method as noodles:

High flame
Quick toss
No overcooking
5. White Garlic / White Chinese Dish SOP
Ingredients
Oil
Chopped garlic
White pepper
Water
Cornflour slurry
Fried paneer / chicken / mushroom
Spring onion
N-Core powder
Method
Heat oil.
Add chopped garlic.
Lightly cook (do NOT brown).
Add water.
Add N-Core powder.
Add little white pepper.
Add cornflour slurry.
Make glossy white sauce.
Add fried protein.
Toss lightly.
Finish with spring onion.
6. Troubleshooting

Noodles sticky

Reason:
Overboiled
OR
No oil applied
Fix:
Boil only 80–90%
always oil coat

Rice mushy

Reason: Fresh hot rice
Fix:
use cold separated rice

White dish turning brown

Reason:
Garlic browned
OR
soy sauce contamination
Fix:
Keep garlic light
avoid soy sauce

Flavor bland

Reason: Less N-Core
Fix:
Add extra pinch
7. Kitchen Golden Rule

Chinese wok cooking = FAST cooking

Rules:

Very high flame
Fast tossing
No waiting

Reason
This preserves:

crunch
smoky wok aroma
restaurant texture

TITLE: UNIVERSAL MANCHURIAN SOP
CATEGORY: Chinese
CONTENT (EN): 1. Morning Base Preparation (5 Litre Batch)

Prepare this master Manchurian base every morning.

Ingredients
Oil: 150 ml
Chopped Garlic: 150g
Chopped Ginger: 80g
Kyroz Z-101 DARK MASTER Powder: 150g (1 scoop)
Water: 4.5 litres
Soy Sauce: 100 ml
Vinegar: 100 ml
Black Pepper Powder: 10g
Tomato Ketchup: 50 ml
Preparation Steps
Heat 150 ml oil in a large pan.
Add:
chopped garlic
chopped ginger
Lightly sauté.

Important Rule

Do NOT burn garlic or ginger.
Only remove raw smell.
Add 150g Kyroz Z-101 DARK MASTER powder.
Stir for 5–8 seconds only.
Add:
4.5 litres water
soy sauce
vinegar
black pepper
ketchup
Bring to one boil.
Store for service use.
2. Order Time Cooking Chart
Required Items
Fried Manchurian balls / fried protein
Cornflour slurry
Oil

Optional vegetables:

Onion
Capsicum
Spring onion
Step 1: Base Heating
Heat a wok.
Add little oil.
Step 2: Choose Style

Dry Manchurian

Add 100 ml master base (half ladle)

Gravy Manchurian

Add 300 ml master base (1.5 ladle)

Bring to boil.

Step 3: Thickening
Slowly add cornflour slurry.
Stir continuously.
Sauce should become:
thick
glossy
shiny
Step 4: Final Toss
Add:
fried Manchurian balls
OR
fried chicken / gobi / mushroom / chaap
Toss quickly on high flame.

TITLE: SCHEZWAN DISHES SOP

Required Base
Kyroz Schezwan Paste (S-Paste)
Master Chilli Oil
Chopped Garlic
Spring Onion
Boiled Noodles / Cooked Rice
Fried protein (Paneer / Chicken / Mushroom / Chaap)

Important Rule

Schezwan paste should be ready before service.
Use fixed ladle measurement for consistency.
3. Schezwan Noodles (Per Portion)
Ingredients
Oil: 1 tbsp
Chopped Garlic: 1 tsp
Julienne Vegetables:
Cabbage
Carrot
Capsicum
Spring Onion
Boiled Noodles: 180–200g
Schezwan Paste: 1–1.5 tbsp
Garlic Oil / Chilli Oil: 1 tsp
Cooking Steps
Heat wok on very high flame.
Add oil.
Add chopped garlic.
Toss for 5–10 seconds only.
Add vegetables.
Stir fry on high flame for 15–20 seconds.
Add boiled noodles.
Add:
Schezwan paste
Garlic oil or chilli oil
Toss rapidly.
Serve immediately.
4. Schezwan Fried Rice (Per Portion)
Ingredients

Chopped garlic
Schezwan paste
Chilli oil
Steps

High flame
Fast toss
No overcooking
5. Schezwan Dry / Gravy Dishes
Ingredients
Fried paneer / chicken / mushroom / chaap
Cube-cut onion
Cube-cut capsicum
Schezwan paste
Water
Cornflour slurry
Oil
Dry Style Method
Heat oil in wok.
Add onion + capsicum.
Toss for 20 seconds.
Add Schezwan paste + little water.
Bring to boil.
Add cornflour slurry (small amount if needed).
Add fried protein.
Toss quickly.

Rule

Sauce should only coat the pieces.
Gravy Style Method
Follow same process.
Add extra water.
Add more slurry for thick glossy gravy.

Rule

Gravy should remain flowing.
6. Helper Advice

Heat Rule

Schezwan dishes must always be cooked on very high flame.

Speed Rule

Fast tossing only.
Slow cooking ruins texture.

Spice Rule

Schezwan dishes are naturally spicy.
Ask customer spice preference if needed.

Finish Rule

Add 1 tsp chilli oil at the end for premium aroma and shine.
7. Troubleshooting

Dish too spicy

Reason: Too much Schezwan paste
Fix:
Add little ketchup
little butter

Dish bland

Reason: Less paste
Fix:
Add extra Schezwan paste

Dish too oily

Reason: Too much chilli oil
Fix:
Reduce finishing oil

Dark burnt taste

Reason:
Garlic burnt
OR
slow cooking
Fix:
Quick high flame toss only

TITLE: KFC-STYLE CRISPY CHICKEN (C-510 ZING MASTER)
CATEGORY: Cafe
CONTENT (EN): 1. MARINATION STANDARD (24-HOUR PROCESS)

Item: Chicken Cuts
Specification: Popcorn, Strips, Wings, or Leg Pieces (1 kg)
Notes: Fresh and properly cleaned

Item: Marinade Powder
Specification: C-510 ZING MASTER (40g)
Notes: Measure accurately

Item: Water
Specification: 50ml to 60ml
Notes: For dissolving seasoning; if chicken is already wet, avoid extra water

Item: Marination Time
Specification: 24 Hours (Mandatory)
Notes: Keep inside refrigerator (Chiller Zone)

Marination Method:
For 1 kg chicken, mix 40g C-510 ZING MASTER in 50ml water to create a thick paste.
Apply evenly over all chicken pieces and mix thoroughly.
Store in an airtight container and refrigerate for 24 hours.
This ensures the seasoning penetrates deep inside the chicken, including near the bone.

--------------------------------------------------

2. DRY COATING STATION SETUP

Set up these two containers:
Tub 1 (Dry Mix): Refined Flour (Maida) + 1 spoon C-509 FIRE DUST
Tub 2 (Chilled Water): Ice-cold water

--------------------------------------------------

3. STEP-BY-STEP COOKING METHOD

Step 1: First Coating
Remove marinated chicken from refrigerator.
Place it in dry flour.
Lightly coat using gentle hand movement.

Step 2: Water Dip
Dip coated chicken in cold water for 2–3 seconds.

Step 3: Second Coating
Return chicken to dry flour.
Toss gently 10–12 times to create crispy flakes.

Step 4: Shake
Shake off extra flour.

Step 5: Frying
Immediately place in hot oil.

--------------------------------------------------

4. FRYING TEMPERATURE & TIME

CRITICAL RULE: Oil must be fully preheated.

Chicken Popcorn:
Temperature: 180°C
Time: 3–4 minutes
Check: Golden brown and floating

Chicken Strips:
Temperature: 180°C
Time: 4–5 minutes
Check: Crispy texture

Chicken Wings:
Temperature: 170°C
Time: 6–7 minutes
Check: Fully cooked

Chicken Leg Piece:
Temperature: 160°C
Time: 10–12 minutes
Check: Deep internal cooking

--------------------------------------------------

5. HELPER TIPS

No Extra Salt: C-510 already contains balanced salt and spice.
Ice Cold Water Only: Normal water will ruin coating.
Avoid Overcrowding: Do not fry too many pieces together.

--------------------------------------------------

6. TROUBLESHOOTING

Problem: Crunch too hard
Reason: Pressed too hard in flour
Solution: Use gentle coating

Problem: Coating falling off
Reason: Water not cold enough
Solution: Use chilled water and shake properly

Problem: Raw inside
Reason: Oil too hot
Solution: Fry slowly at 160°C

--------------------------------------------------

7. PRESENTATION

After frying, place chicken on strainer for 1 minute.
Sprinkle C-509 FIRE DUST on top.
Serve in bucket or plate.
CONTENT (HI): 1. मैरिनेशन स्टैंडर्ड (24 घंटे प्रक्रिया)

आइटम: चिकन कट्स
विवरण: पॉपकॉर्न, स्ट्रिप्स, विंग्स या लेग पीस (1 किलो)
नोट: ताज़ा और साफ

आइटम: मैरिनेड पाउडर
विवरण: C-510 ZING MASTER (40 ग्राम)
नोट: सही मात्रा लें

आइटम: पानी
विवरण: 50–60 ml
नोट: मसाला घोलने के लिए

आइटम: मैरिनेशन समय
विवरण: 24 घंटे (अनिवार्य)
नोट: फ्रिज के चिलर में रखें

मैरिनेशन विधि:
1 किलो चिकन के लिए 40 ग्राम C-510 ZING MASTER को 50 ml पानी में मिलाकर गाढ़ा पेस्ट बनाएं।
इस पेस्ट को चिकन के सभी पीस पर अच्छे से लगाएं।
एयरटाइट कंटेनर में बंद करके 24 घंटे फ्रिज में रखें।
इससे मसाला अंदर तक अच्छी तरह पहुंचता है।

--------------------------------------------------

2. ड्राई कोटिंग सेटअप

दो कंटेनर तैयार करें:
टब 1 (ड्राई मिक्स): मैदा + 1 चम्मच C-509 FIRE DUST
टब 2 (ठंडा पानी): बर्फ जैसा ठंडा पानी

--------------------------------------------------

3. कुकिंग प्रोसेस

स्टेप 1: पहली कोटिंग
मैरिनेटेड चिकन को फ्रिज से निकालें।
मैदे में डालें।
हल्के हाथ से कोट करें।

स्टेप 2: पानी डिप
2–3 सेकंड ठंडे पानी में डुबोएं।

स्टेप 3: दूसरी कोटिंग
फिर मैदे में डालें।
10–12 बार हल्के हाथ से घुमाएं।

स्टेप 4: झटकें
अतिरिक्त मैदा हटा दें।

स्टेप 5: फ्राई करें
तुरंत गरम तेल में डालें।

--------------------------------------------------

4. फ्राइंग तापमान और समय

महत्वपूर्ण नियम: तेल पूरी तरह गरम होना चाहिए।

चिकन पॉपकॉर्न:
तापमान: 180°C
समय: 3–4 मिनट
चेक: गोल्डन ब्राउन

चिकन स्ट्रिप्स:
तापमान: 180°C
समय: 4–5 मिनट
चेक: क्रिस्पी

चिकन विंग्स:
तापमान: 170°C
समय: 6–7 मिनट
चेक: पूरी तरह पका

चिकन लेग पीस:
तापमान: 160°C
समय: 10–12 मिनट
चेक: अंदर तक पका हुआ

--------------------------------------------------

5. हेल्पर टिप्स

अतिरिक्त नमक न डालें: मसाले में सब बैलेंस है।
सिर्फ ठंडा पानी इस्तेमाल करें: नॉर्मल पानी कोटिंग खराब करेगा।
बहुत सारे पीस साथ में न डालें: तेल का तापमान गिर जाएगा।

--------------------------------------------------

6. समस्याएं और समाधान

समस्या: बहुत हार्ड क्रंच
कारण: बहुत जोर से दबाया
समाधान: हल्के हाथ से कोट करें

समस्या: कोटिंग उतर रही है
कारण: पानी पर्याप्त ठंडा नहीं
समाधान: ठंडा पानी इस्तेमाल करें

समस्या: अंदर से कच्चा
कारण: तेल ज्यादा गरम
समाधान: 160°C पर धीरे पकाएं

--------------------------------------------------

7. सर्विंग

फ्राई होने के बाद 1 मिनट स्ट्रेनर पर रखें।
ऊपर से C-509 FIRE DUST छिड़कें।
बकेट या प्लेट में सर्व करें।

TITLE: MASTER CAFE-STYLE BURGER ASSEMBLY
CATEGORY: Cafe Dishes
CONTENT (EN): KYROZ+ | STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE (SOP)

PRODUCT: MASTER CAFE-STYLE BURGER ASSEMBLY


==================================================
1. THE 6-LAYER ASSEMBLY
BURGER ASSEMBLY SYSTEM
==================================================

Assemble the burger from bottom to top strictly in the following sequence:

BOTTOM BUN:
• Apply C-503 VELVET GLAZE as the base sauce layer.

LAYER 02 — BOTTOM VEGETABLES:
• Lightly shredded Lettuce or Cabbage.

LAYER 03 — CHEESE (OPTIONAL):
• 1 Cheese Slice, only when ordered.

LAYER 04 — THE HERO:
• Hot and crispy Patty prepared using C-502 GRILL DUST.

LAYER 05 — TOPPINGS:
• 2 Tomato Slices
• 2 Cucumber/Onion Slices

TOP BUN:
• Apply C-503 VELVET GLAZE on the inside surface of the top bun.

IMPORTANT:
• Maintain the same assembly sequence for every burger.
• Do not randomly change the layer order.


==================================================
2. COOKING & ASSEMBLY STEPS
BANANE KA TARIKA
==================================================

1. BUN TOASTING:

• Cut the burger bun horizontally into two halves.
• Apply a light layer of butter to the inner side.
• Toast on a tawa or griddle for approximately 15–20 seconds.
• The bun should remain soft and lightly toasted.
• Do NOT burn or over-toast the bun.

2. BASE SAUCE:

• Apply 1 teaspoon C-503 VELVET GLAZE evenly on the inside of the
  Bottom Bun.

3. VEGETABLE PLACEMENT:

• Add a small layer of finely shredded Lettuce or Cabbage over the sauce.
• This creates a barrier between the hot patty and the bottom bun and
  helps reduce sogginess.

4. PATTY & CHEESE:

• Place the freshly cooked, hot and crispy patty prepared using
  C-502 GRILL DUST.
• For a Cheese Burger, immediately place 1 Cheese Slice over the hot
  patty so that it melts slightly.

5. TOP TOPPINGS:

• Place the tomato and onion/cucumber slices evenly over the patty.

6. TOP SAUCE & CLOSE:

• Apply 1 teaspoon C-503 VELVET GLAZE to the inside of the Top Bun.
• Place the Top Bun over the assembled burger.
• Press very lightly.
• Wrap immediately for service.


==================================================
3. MENU VARIATION CHART
ONE PREMIX, MULTIPLE BURGERS
==================================================

BURGER NAME:
Classic Aloo Tikki

PATTY:
Standard Aloo Patty prepared using C-502 GRILL DUST

SAUCE:
Mayo + Ketchup + C-503 VELVET GLAZE


BURGER NAME:
Crispy Veggie Crunch

PATTY:
Mixed Vegetable Patty + Crunchy Coating prepared using C-502 GRILL DUST

SAUCE:
Mayo + Ketchup + C-503 VELVET GLAZE


BURGER NAME:
Tandoori Paneer Burger

PATTY:
Fried Coated Paneer Slab

SAUCE:
Mayo + C-503 VELVET GLAZE + Chilli Powder

IMPORTANT:
• No Ketchup.


BURGER NAME:
Spicy Chicken Zinger

PATTY:
Coated Chicken Mince Patty prepared using C-502 GRILL DUST

SAUCE:
Mayo + Chilli Sauce + C-503 VELVET GLAZE


==================================================
4. HELPER SPECIAL ADVICE
CHEF-LESS TIPS
==================================================

THE CRUNCH RULE:

• Fry the patty only when the order is received.
• Do not keep fried patties sitting for long periods.
• Pre-fried patties lose their crispness and can negatively affect the
  burger texture.

SAUCE BALANCE:

• Spread the sauce evenly across the bun surface.
• Do not use excessive sauce.
• Maintain the approved 1-teaspoon portion for consistent taste.

VEGETABLE FRESHNESS:

• Prepare tomato, onion and other vegetables in advance using approved
  food-safe preparation procedures.
• Keep prepared vegetables refrigerated.
• Drain excess moisture from tomatoes before assembly.
• Fresh, chilled and crunchy vegetables provide better contrast with the
  hot patty.


==================================================
5. TROUBLESHOOTING
PROBLEMS & SOLUTIONS
==================================================

PROBLEM:
BURGER IS SLIPPING / FALLING APART

REASON:
• Excess sauce.
• Tomato contains excessive moisture.
• Layers are not aligned properly.

SOLUTION:
• Drain excess tomato moisture.
• Maintain the standard 1-teaspoon sauce portion.
• Centre each layer properly before closing the burger.


PROBLEM:
BOTTOM BUN IS SOGGY

REASON:
• Hot patty was placed directly on the bun.
• Excess moisture from vegetables or sauce.

SOLUTION:
• Always place a Lettuce/Cabbage layer between the bun and patty.
• Control sauce quantity.
• Drain excess moisture from vegetables.


PROBLEM:
BUN IS DRY AND HARD

REASON:
• Bun is old or stale.
• Bun was over-toasted.

SOLUTION:
• Use fresh buns.
• Apply a light amount of butter.
• Toast only until lightly warm and golden.
• Do not over-toast.


==================================================
6. FINAL QUALITY CHECK
==================================================

[ ] Bun is fresh, soft and lightly toasted.

[ ] Bottom sauce quantity is standardized.

[ ] Lettuce/Cabbage layer is present.

[ ] Patty is freshly cooked and crispy.

[ ] Cheese is properly melted when applicable.

[ ] Tomato and onion/cucumber are fresh and properly drained.

[ ] Top sauce is evenly applied.

[ ] Burger layers are aligned and stable.

[ ] Burger is wrapped immediately after assembly.

[ ] Final burger is served hot and fresh.


==================================================

==================================================
1. 6-LAYER ASSEMBLY
BURGER ASSEMBLY SYSTEM
==================================================

Burger को नीचे से ऊपर की तरफ बिल्कुल इसी sequence में assemble करना है:

BOTTOM BUN:
• अंदर की तरफ C-503 VELVET GLAZE की base sauce layer लगाएं।

LAYER 02 — BOTTOM VEGETABLES:
• हल्का बारीक कटा हुआ Lettuce या Patta Gobhi।

LAYER 03 — CHEESE (OPTIONAL):
• 1 Cheese Slice, केवल customer के order के अनुसार।

LAYER 04 — THE HERO:
• C-502 GRILL DUST से तैयार की गई गरम और crispy Patty।

LAYER 05 — TOPPINGS:
• 2 Tomato Slices
• 2 Kheera/Onion Slices

TOP BUN:
• Top Bun की अंदर वाली तरफ C-503 VELVET GLAZE लगाएं।

IMPORTANT:
• हर burger में यही assembly sequence maintain करें।
• Layer order को बिना कारण change न करें।


==================================================
2. COOKING & ASSEMBLY STEPS
BANANE KA TARIKA
==================================================

1. BUN TOASTING:

• Burger Bun को बीच से horizontal तरीके से दो हिस्सों में काटें।
• अंदर की तरफ हल्का butter लगाएं।
• Tawa या griddle पर लगभग 15–20 seconds तक toast करें।
• Bun soft और हल्का toasted रहना चाहिए।
• Bun को जलाना या ज्यादा hard toast नहीं करना है।

2. BASE SAUCE:

• Bottom Bun की अंदर वाली तरफ 1 teaspoon C-503 VELVET GLAZE evenly
  लगाएं।

3. VEGETABLE PLACEMENT:

• Sauce के ऊपर थोड़ा बारीक कटा हुआ Lettuce या Patta Gobhi रखें।
• इससे hot patty और bottom bun के बीच एक protective layer बनती है और
  bun के soggy होने की संभावना कम होती है।

4. PATTY & CHEESE:

• C-502 GRILL DUST से तैयार की गई freshly cooked, hot और crispy Patty रखें।
• अगर Cheese Burger है, तो hot patty के ऊपर तुरंत 1 Cheese Slice रखें
  ताकि cheese हल्की melt हो जाए।

5. TOP TOPPINGS:

• Patty के ऊपर Tomato और Onion/Kheera slices को evenly रखें।

6. TOP SAUCE & CLOSE:

• Top Bun की अंदर वाली तरफ 1 teaspoon C-503 VELVET GLAZE लगाएं।
• Top Bun को burger के ऊपर रखें।
• बहुत हल्के हाथ से press करें।
• तुरंत wrap करके serve करें।

4. HELPER KE LIYE KHAS ADVICE
CHEF-LESS TIPS
==================================================

THE CRUNCH RULE:

• Patty को केवल order आने पर fry करें।
• Fried patty को लंबे समय तक पहले से रखकर न रखें।
• पहले से fried patty अपनी crispiness खो देती है और burger का texture
  खराब हो सकता है।

SAUCE BALANCE:

• Sauce को bun की surface पर evenly spread करें।
• बहुत ज्यादा sauce नहीं लगाना है।
• Consistent taste के लिए approved 1-teaspoon portion maintain करें।

VEGETABLE FRESHNESS:

• Tomato, onion और बाकी vegetables को approved food-safe preparation
  procedure के अनुसार पहले से तैयार करें।
• Prepared vegetables को refrigerator में रखें।
• Assembly से पहले tomato का excess पानी निकाल दें।
• Fresh, chilled और crunchy vegetables hot patty के साथ बेहतर texture
  देती हैं।


==================================================
5. TROUBLESHOOTING
PROBLEMS & SOLUTIONS
==================================================

PROBLEM:
BURGER DHELAA / SLIP HO RAHA HAI

REASON:
• Sauce बहुत ज्यादा लग गई।
• Tomato में excess पानी था।
• Layers सही तरीके से aligned नहीं थीं।

SOLUTION:
• Tomato का extra पानी निकालें।
• Standard 1-teaspoon sauce quantity maintain करें।
• Burger बंद करने से पहले हर layer को properly centre करें।


PROBLEM:
BOTTOM BUN SOGGY HO GAYA

REASON:
• Hot patty को सीधे bun पर रख दिया गया।
• Vegetables या sauce में excess moisture था।

SOLUTION:
• Bun और patty के बीच हमेशा Lettuce/Patta Gobhi की layer रखें।
• Sauce की quantity control करें।
• Vegetables का excess पानी निकालें।


PROBLEM:
BUN DRY AUR HARD LAG RAHA HAI

REASON:
• Bun पुराना या stale था।
• Bun को बहुत ज्यादा toast कर दिया गया।

SOLUTION:
• Fresh bun का इस्तेमाल करें।
• हल्का butter लगाएं।
• केवल हल्का warm और golden होने तक toast करें।
• Bun को over-toast न करें।

• Apply C-503 VELVET GLAZE on the inside surface of the top bun.

IMPORTANT:
• Maintain the same assembly sequence for every burger.
• Do not randomly change the layer order.


==================================================
2. COOKING & ASSEMBLY STEPS
BANANE KA TARIKA
==================================================

1. BUN TOASTING:

• Cut the burger bun horizontally into two halves.
• Apply a light layer of butter to the inner side.
• Toast on a tawa or griddle for approximately 15–20 seconds.
• The bun should remain soft and lightly toasted.
• Do NOT burn or over-toast the bun.

2. BASE SAUCE:

• Apply 1 teaspoon C-503 VELVET GLAZE evenly on the inside of the
  Bottom Bun.

3. VEGETABLE PLACEMENT:

• Add a small layer of finely shredded Lettuce or Cabbage over the sauce.
• This creates a barrier between the hot patty and the bottom bun and
  helps reduce sogginess.

4. PATTY & CHEESE:

• Place the freshly cooked, hot and crispy patty prepared using
  C-502 GRILL DUST.
• For a Cheese Burger, immediately place 1 Cheese Slice over the hot
  patty so that it melts slightly.

5. TOP TOPPINGS:

• Place the tomato and onion/cucumber slices evenly over the patty.

6. TOP SAUCE & CLOSE:

• Apply 1 teaspoon C-503 VELVET GLAZE to the inside of the Top Bun.
• Place the Top Bun over the assembled burger.
• Press very lightly.
• Wrap immediately for service.

==================================================
4. HELPER SPECIAL ADVICE
CHEF-LESS TIPS
==================================================

THE CRUNCH RULE:

• Fry the patty only when the order is received.
• Do not keep fried patties sitting for long periods.
• Pre-fried patties lose their crispness and can negatively affect the
  burger texture.

SAUCE BALANCE:

• Spread the sauce evenly across the bun surface.
• Do not use excessive sauce.
• Maintain the approved 1-teaspoon portion for consistent taste.

VEGETABLE FRESHNESS:

• Prepare tomato, onion and other vegetables in advance using approved
  food-safe preparation procedures.
• Keep prepared vegetables refrigerated.
• Drain excess moisture from tomatoes before assembly.
• Fresh, chilled and crunchy vegetables provide better contrast with the
  hot patty.


==================================================
5. TROUBLESHOOTING
PROBLEMS & SOLUTIONS
==================================================

PROBLEM:
BURGER IS SLIPPING / FALLING APART

REASON:
• Excess sauce.
• Tomato contains excessive moisture.
• Layers are not aligned properly.

SOLUTION:
• Drain excess tomato moisture.
• Maintain the standard 1-teaspoon sauce portion.
• Centre each layer properly before closing the burger.


PROBLEM:
BOTTOM BUN IS SOGGY

REASON:
• Hot patty was placed directly on the bun.
• Excess moisture from vegetables or sauce.

SOLUTION:
• Always place a Lettuce/Cabbage layer between the bun and patty.
• Control sauce quantity.
• Drain excess moisture from vegetables.


PROBLEM:
BUN IS DRY AND HARD

REASON:
• Bun is old or stale.
• Bun was over-toasted.

SOLUTION:
• Use fresh buns.
• Apply a light amount of butter.
• Toast only until lightly warm and golden.
• Do not over-toast.


==================================================
6. FINAL QUALITY CHECK
==================================================

[ ] Bun is fresh, soft and lightly toasted.

[ ] Bottom sauce quantity is standardized.

[ ] Lettuce/Cabbage layer is present.

[ ] Patty is freshly cooked and crispy.

[ ] Cheese is properly melted when applicable.

[ ] Tomato and onion/cucumber are fresh and properly drained.

[ ] Top sauce is evenly applied.

[ ] Burger layers are aligned and stable.

[ ] Burger is wrapped immediately after assembly.

[ ] Final burger is served hot and fresh.

BANANE KA TARIKA

  bun के soggy होने की संभावना कम होती है।

  ताकि cheese हल्की melt हो जाए।

• Patty के ऊपर Tomato और Onion/Kheera slices को evenly रखें।

6. TOP SAUCE & CLOSE:

TITLE: MASTER PIZZA ASSEMBLY & BAKING (C-500 SERIES)
CATEGORY: Cafe
CONTENT (EN): 1. RAW MATERIAL MEASUREMENT (PER 10-INCH MEDIUM PIZZA)

Pizza Base: C-501 DOUGH MASTER prepared 10-inch pizza base
Pizza Sauce: C-506 MARINARA CORE sauce | Quantity: 50g
Cheese: Mozzarella + Cheddar diced blend | Quantity: 80g–100g
Vegetables: Capsicum, Onion, Sweet Corn, Mushroom | Quantity: 40g
Seasoning: C-509 FIRE DUST | For final topping

--------------------------------------------------

2. PIZZA ASSEMBLY STEPS

Step 1: Base Docking
Take the prepared pizza base.
If the base is not pre-baked, prick small holes across the surface using a fork.
This prevents the pizza from puffing in the center during baking.

Step 2: Sauce Layering
Add 50g pizza sauce in the center.
Spread evenly in circular motion.
Leave approximately 1/2 inch crust edge uncovered.

Step 3: First Cheese Layer
Add 30% of total cheese over the sauce.
This acts as a locking layer and helps toppings stay in place.

Step 4: Toppings Placement
Spread vegetables evenly across the pizza.
Do not overload one section.

Step 5: Final Cheese Layer
Add remaining 70% cheese evenly over toppings.
Toppings should be lightly covered.

--------------------------------------------------

3. BAKING STANDARDS

CRITICAL RULE: Preheat oven at least 15 minutes before baking. Cold oven will produce hard pizza.

Commercial Deck Oven:
Top Temperature: 280°C
Bottom Temperature: 260°C

Conveyor Pizza Oven:
Temperature: 250°C
Speed: 5 to 5.5 minutes

Baking Time: 5 to 6 minutes
Bake until: Cheese develops light brown spots and Crust becomes golden brown

--------------------------------------------------

4. HELPER TIPS

No Soggy Base: Ensure vegetables are dry. Wet vegetables can make pizza soggy.
Golden Edge Finish: After baking, lightly brush butter or olive oil on crust edges. Improves shine and premium appearance.
Cutting Rule: Cut immediately after baking using pizza cutter. Cut into 4 or 6 equal slices. Late cutting causes cheese stretching issues.

--------------------------------------------------

5. TROUBLESHOOTING

Problem: Cheese burned but base raw
Reason: Top heat too high
Solution: Reduce top heat by 10–20°C and increase bottom heat

Problem: Pizza puffed in center
Reason: Base not docked properly
Solution: Always prick holes before baking

Problem: Cheese melted but no stretch
Reason: Low oven temperature or underbaked
Solution: Maintain 260°C+ and bake till brown spots appear

--------------------------------------------------

6. PRESENTATION

Place pizza in pizza box or wooden platter.
Provide 1 small pouch of C-509 FIRE DUST alongside.
Serve hot.

Kyroz+ Systems | Accuracy. Consistency. Growth.
Perfect Crust. Perfect Melt.
CONTENT (HI): 1. कच्चे माल की मात्रा (10 इंच मीडियम पिज्जा)

पिज्जा बेस: C-501 DOUGH MASTER से बना 10 इंच बेस
पिज्जा सॉस: C-506 MARINARA CORE | मात्रा: 50 ग्राम
चीज: Mozzarella + Cheddar blend | मात्रा: 80–100 ग्राम
सब्जियां: शिमला मिर्च, प्याज, स्वीट कॉर्न, मशरूम | मात्रा: 40 ग्राम
सीज़निंग: C-509 FIRE DUST

--------------------------------------------------

2. पिज्जा असेंबली स्टेप्स

स्टेप 1: बेस डॉकिंग
पिज्जा बेस लें।
अगर बेस प्री-बेक्ड नहीं है तो फोर्क से छोटे-छोटे छेद करें।
इससे बीच में फूलने से बचता है।

स्टेप 2: सॉस लेयरिंग
बीच में 50 ग्राम सॉस डालें।
गोल घुमाते हुए फैलाएं।
किनारों पर आधा इंच जगह छोड़ें।

स्टेप 3: पहली चीज लेयर
कुल चीज का 30% डालें।
इससे टॉपिंग्स अपनी जगह रहती हैं।

स्टेप 4: टॉपिंग्स रखें
सब्जियां बराबर फैलाएं।
एक जगह ज्यादा न डालें।

स्टेप 5: अंतिम चीज लेयर
बाकी 70% चीज ऊपर डालें।
टॉपिंग्स हल्की ढकी रहें।

--------------------------------------------------

3. बेकिंग स्टैंडर्ड

महत्वपूर्ण नियम: ओवन 15 मिनट पहले प्रीहीट करें। ठंडे ओवन में पिज्जा हार्ड बनेगा।

कमर्शियल डेक ओवन:
ऊपर तापमान: 280°C
नीचे तापमान: 260°C

कन्वेयर ओवन:
तापमान: 250°C
स्पीड: 5–5.5 मिनट

बेकिंग समय: 5–6 मिनट
चेक: चीज पर हल्के ब्राउन स्पॉट और क्रस्ट गोल्डन ब्राउन

TITLE: PREMIUM CAFE-STYLE WRAPS & ROLLS (C-500 SERIES)
CATEGORY: Cafe
CONTENT (EN): 1. WRAP STRUCTURE (LAYERING SYSTEM)

The wrap should be assembled from inside to outside in this exact structure:
Base: 8-inch or 10-inch Tortilla / Lachha Paratha
Moisture Barrier: Light layer of lettuce or cabbage
Purpose: Prevents sauce from making the wrap soggy
Main Filling: Fried Patty (C-502) / Paneer / OR Crispy Fried Chicken (C-510 ZING MASTER)
Flavor Layer: Long sliced onions + tomatoes + light sprinkle of C-509 FIRE DUST
Creamy Finish: 2 tablespoons C-503 VELVET GLAZE sauce

--------------------------------------------------

2. COOKING STEPS

Step 1: Base Heating
Warm tortilla or paratha lightly on tawa without oil or butter.
Heat for 10–15 seconds on both sides.
Base should remain soft and foldable.

Step 2: Sauce Application
Apply 1 tablespoon C-503 VELVET GLAZE sauce in center line.

Step 3: Vegetable Layer
Add shredded lettuce or cabbage over sauce.

Step 4: Filling Placement
Veg Version: Place sliced/crushed C-502 veg patty
Non-Veg Version: Place crispy fried chicken strips prepared using C-510 ZING MASTER

Step 5: Flavor Toppings
Add long sliced onions and tomatoes.
Sprinkle C-509 FIRE DUST lightly.

Step 6: Final Sauce Layer
Add 1 additional spoon of C-503 VELVET GLAZE over filling.

Step 7: Folding & Grilling
Fold bottom edge slightly upward.
Fold both sides inward.
Roll tightly.
Apply light butter on tawa or griller.
Toast for approximately 30 seconds until golden grill marks appear.

--------------------------------------------------

3. MENU VARIATIONS

Classic Veggie Wrap
Base: 8-inch Tortilla | Filling: C-502 Veg Patty (Crushed) | Seasoning: Mild C-509 FIRE DUST

Peri-Peri Paneer Wrap
Base: 8-inch Tortilla | Filling: Grilled Paneer Strips | Seasoning: Extra spicy C-509 FIRE DUST

Zing Crunchy Roll
Base: 8-inch Tortilla | Filling: C-510 ZING MASTER Fried Chicken | Special Sauce: C-503 mixed with mint

Crispy Chicken Wrap
Base: 8-inch Tortilla | Filling: C-510 Chicken Strips | Sauce: Standard C-503 VELVET GLAZE

--------------------------------------------------

4. HELPER TIPS

Tight Folding Rule: Always roll tightly. Loose wraps leak sauce while eating.
Crunch Rule: Chicken strips must be served hot and crispy.
Wrapping Presentation: Wrap half portion using butter paper or aluminum foil. Cut diagonally from center. This improves premium presentation.

--------------------------------------------------

5. TROUBLESHOOTING

Problem: Wrap tearing from bottom
Reason: Dry tortilla or excessive filling
Solution: Use fresh tortilla and avoid overfilling

Problem: Wrap feels dry
Reason: Less sauce or overcooked filling
Solution: Increase sauce quantity

Problem: Wrap becomes soggy
Reason: Wet vegetables or delayed serving
Solution: Grill immediately and serve fresh

--------------------------------------------------

6. PRESENTATION

Wrap half in butter paper or foil.
Cut diagonally.
Serve hot.
Optional: Serve with fries or dip.

CONTENT (HI): 1. रैप स्ट्रक्चर (लेयरिंग सिस्टम)

रैप को अंदर से बाहर इस क्रम में बनाना है:
बेस: 8 या 10 इंच टॉर्टिला / लच्छा पराठा

2. कुकिंग स्टेप्स

नॉन-वेज: क्रिस्पी चिकन स्ट्रिप्स रखें

TITLE: SHAHI LUCKNOWI BIRYANI
CATEGORY: Biryani
CONTENT (EN): KYROZ+ OPERATIONAL MANUAL
SOP: SHAHI LUCKNOWI BIRYANI
MASTER METHOD

Batch Size: 1 KG Chicken + 1 KG Rice
For 15 KG production, multiply all ingredients proportionately.

STANDARD FORMULA:
150 G Curd + 250 G Ghee/Oil + 50 ML Milk


==================================================
1. PREPARATION
==================================================

RICE:

• Clean 1 KG Long Grain Basmati Rice properly.
• Soak the rice in water for 30 minutes.
• Drain the rice properly before use.

CHICKEN:

• Take 1 KG Chicken in large pieces.
• Wash properly and place in a colander so that excess water drains out.

BROWN ONION / BIRISTA:

• Finely slice 200 G Onion.
• Fry until golden brown.
• Remove and keep aside.

CURD:

• 150 G Curd
• Use curd that is not excessively sour.

GINGER-GARLIC PASTE:

• 40 G Fresh Ginger-Garlic Paste

KYROZ PREMIX:

• 1 Full Packet B-401 ROYAL AWADH


==================================================
2. YAKHNI PREPARATION
THE BASE
==================================================

1. GHEE/OIL:

• Heat 250 G Ghee/Oil in a large cooking vessel.

2. SAUTÉING:

• Add 40 G Ginger-Garlic Paste to the hot oil.
• Sauté for approximately 30 seconds on medium heat.
• Add 1 full packet of B-401 ROYAL AWADH.
• Sauté the premix for approximately 30 seconds.

• Add:
  - 1 KG Chicken
  - 150 G Curd
  - 50% of the prepared Brown Onion

• Cook on high heat for approximately 3–4 minutes.
• Continue cooking until the Ghee/Oil starts becoming visible on top.

3. COOKING / GALAWAT:

• Add 100–150 ML Water.
• Cover the vessel.
• Cook on low heat until the chicken reaches approximately 80% cooked.

CHECK:

• The meat should become tender.
• The meat should NOT completely separate from the bone at this stage.

4. FINAL YAKHNI:

• Before starting the final Dum, check that a small quantity of Shorba/
  Gravy remains at the bottom.
• Extract approximately 70–100 ML Rogan (the Ghee/Oil visible on top)
  and keep it separately for the Dum stage.

IMPORTANT:

• The Yakhni should not become completely dry.
• Some gravy/moisture must remain for the final Dum.


==================================================
3. RICE BOILING
THE RICE
==================================================

1. WATER:

• In a large vessel, boil approximately 5–6 Litres of water.

2. SEASONING:

Add to the boiling water:

• 40 G Salt
• 2 Bay Leaves
• 1 Black Cardamom
• 4 Green Cardamoms
• 7–8 Cloves
• 10–15 Black Peppercorns
• 2 pieces of 1-inch Cinnamon
• 15 ML Oil
• Juice of 1 Lemon

3. KANI CHECK:

• Add the soaked and drained rice.
• Cook until the rice reaches approximately 70% doneness.
• When pressed, the grain should be partially cooked and break into
  approximately 3 sections.
• Immediately drain the rice.


==================================================
4. DUM
THE FINAL TOUCH
==================================================

1. LAYERING:

• Spread the partially cooked rice evenly over the prepared Yakhni.

2. AROMA MIX:

In a separate bowl, mix:

• 50 ML Milk
• Saffron/Food Colour as approved
• 3 Drops Meetha Attar
• 1 Teaspoon Kewra

• Pour this aroma mixture evenly over the rice.
• Add the reserved Rogan over the rice at the same time.

3. GARNISH:

• Sprinkle the remaining Brown Onion evenly over the top.

4. DUM TIMING:

• Seal the cooking vessel properly using dough or a suitable sealing
  method.

• First cook for 5 Minutes on high heat.
• Then place the vessel on a Tawa.
• Reduce to very low heat and cook on Dum for 15–20 Minutes.

• After Dum, allow the vessel to rest briefly before opening.


==================================================
5. TROUBLESHOOTING
HELPER SAFETY & QUALITY CHECKS
==================================================

PROBLEM: SALT / SEASONING IS LOW

• Taste the Yakhni before adding the rice.
• The Yakhni should taste slightly more seasoned than the final dish,
  because the rice will absorb and dilute the seasoning.

• Do NOT add extra salt blindly.
• Adjust only after tasting and according to the approved batch standard.


PROBLEM: BURNING SMELL

• If a burning smell is noticed, immediately reduce/turn off the heat.
• Do NOT pour cold water onto a hot cooking vessel or hot oil.
• Move the vessel away from direct heat only when it is safe to do so.
• Check the bottom and transfer the usable biryani to a clean vessel if
  required.


PROBLEM: BIRYANI IS TOO WET

• After Dum, carefully open the lid.
• If excess moisture is present, allow the biryani to rest uncovered for
  approximately 5 minutes so that excess steam can escape.
• Do not aggressively mix the rice, as this can break the grains.


==================================================
6. FINAL QUALITY CHECK
==================================================

[ ] Rice is approximately 70% cooked before Dum.

[ ] Rice grains remain separate after Dum.

[ ] Chicken is tender and properly cooked.

[ ] Yakhni is not completely dry before layering.

[ ] Rogan is extracted and used during the Dum stage.

[ ] Brown Onion is evenly distributed.

[ ] Aroma of Kewra and Meetha Attar is balanced.

[ ] Final biryani has a rich Awadhi aroma and appearance.


==================================================
BATCH STANDARD
==================================================

Batch:
1 KG Chicken + 1 KG Rice

For 15 KG production:
Multiply the complete recipe proportionately according to the required
production quantity.

Primary Premix:
B-401 ROYAL AWADH

KYROZ+ Systems
Shahi Lucknowi Biryani
Master Production SOP",
CONTENT (HI): KYROZ+ OPERATIONAL MANUAL
SOP: SHAHI LUCKNOWI BIRYANI
MASTER METHOD

Batch Size: 1 KG Chicken + 1 KG Rice
15 KG production के लिए सभी ingredients को इसी ratio में proportionately
multiply करें।

STANDARD FORMULA:
150 ग्राम दही + 250 ग्राम Ghee/Oil + 50 ML Milk


==================================================
1. TAIYARI
PREPARATION
==================================================

CHAWAL:

• 1 KG Long Grain Basmati Rice को अच्छी तरह साफ करें।
• Chawal को 30 मिनट के लिए पानी में भिगो दें।
• इस्तेमाल करने से पहले पानी पूरी तरह drain कर दें।

CHICKEN:

• 1 KG Chicken बड़े pieces में लें।
• Chicken को अच्छी तरह धोकर channi/colander में रखें ताकि excess पानी
  पूरी तरह निकल जाए।

PYAAZ / BIRISTA:

• 200 ग्राम प्याज को बारीक काटें।
• इसे golden brown होने तक fry करें।
• निकालकर अलग रख दें।

DAHI:

• 150 ग्राम दही लें।
• दही बहुत ज्यादा खट्टी नहीं होनी चाहिए।

ADRAK-LAHSUN PASTE:

• 40 ग्राम ताजा Ginger-Garlic Paste

KYROZ PREMIX:

• 1 पूरा Packet B-401 ROYAL AWADH


==================================================
2. YAKHNI PAKANA
THE BASE
==================================================

1. GHEE/OIL:

• एक बड़े भगोने में 250 ग्राम Ghee/Oil गर्म करें।

2. BHUNAI:

• गर्म तेल में 40 ग्राम Ginger-Garlic Paste डालें।
• Medium Aanch पर लगभग 30 seconds तक भूनें।
• अब 1 पूरा Packet B-401 ROYAL AWADH डालें।
• Premix को लगभग 30 seconds तक हल्का भूनें।

• अब डालें:
  - 1 KG Chicken
  - 150 ग्राम दही
  - तैयार Brown Onion का 50%

• तेज आंच पर लगभग 3–4 मिनट तक भूनें।
• तब तक भूनें जब तक ऊपर Ghee/Oil दिखाई देने न लगे।

3. GALAWAT:

• अब इसमें 100–150 ML पानी डालें।
• भगोने को ढक दें।
• धीमी आंच पर Chicken को लगभग 80% तक पकाएं।

CHECK:

• Chicken नरम होना चाहिए।
• इस stage पर meat पूरी तरह हड्डी से अलग नहीं होना चाहिए।

4. FINAL YAKHNI:

• Final Dum शुरू करने से पहले check करें कि नीचे थोड़ी Shorba/Gravy
  बची हुई हो।
• ऊपर दिखाई देने वाला लगभग 70–100 ML Rogan (Ghee/Oil) निकालकर अलग रख लें।
• इसे बाद में Dum के समय इस्तेमाल करना है।

IMPORTANT:

• Yakhni पूरी तरह सूखनी नहीं चाहिए।
• Final Dum के लिए थोड़ी gravy/moisture बची रहनी चाहिए।


==================================================
3. CHAWAL UBALNA
THE RICE
==================================================

1. PAANI:

• एक बड़े भगोने में लगभग 5–6 Litres पानी उबालें।

2. SEASONING:

उबलते पानी में डालें:

• 40 ग्राम नमक
• 2 तेज पत्ते
• 1 बड़ी इलायची
• 4 छोटी इलायची
• 7–8 लौंग
• 10–15 काली मिर्च
• 1-inch दालचीनी के 2 टुकड़े
• 15 ML Oil
• 1 नींबू का रस

3. KANI CHECK:

• Soaked और drained rice को उबलते पानी में डालें।
• Chawal को लगभग 70% तक पकाएं।
• हाथ से दबाने पर चावल का दाना partially cooked होना चाहिए और लगभग
  3 हिस्सों में टूटना चाहिए।
• तुरंत चावल को छान लें।


==================================================
4. DUM DENA
THE FINAL TOUCH
==================================================

1. LAYERING:

• तैयार Yakhni के ऊपर 70% cooked rice की एक समान layer लगाएं।

2. AROMA MIX:

एक अलग कटोरी में मिलाएं:

• 50 ML Milk
• Approved Saffron/Food Colour
• 3 बूंद Meetha Attar
• 1 चम्मच Kewra

• इस aroma mixture को rice के ऊपर evenly डालें।
• इसी समय पहले निकाला हुआ Rogan भी rice के ऊपर डालें।

3. GARNISH:

• बचा हुआ Brown Onion ऊपर से evenly sprinkle करें।

4. DUM TIMING:

• भगोने को आटे या suitable sealing method से अच्छी तरह seal करें।

• पहले 5 मिनट तेज आंच पर पकाएं।
• इसके बाद नीचे Tawa रखें।
• आंच को बिल्कुल धीमी करके 15–20 मिनट तक Dum दें।

• Dum पूरा होने के बाद भगोने को थोड़ी देर rest दें और फिर खोलें।


==================================================
5. TROUBLESHOOTING
HELPER के लिए सावधानी
==================================================

PROBLEM: NAMAK / SEASONING KAM HAI

• Rice डालने से पहले Yakhni को taste करें।
• Yakhni का taste final dish से थोड़ा ज्यादा seasoned होना चाहिए क्योंकि
  rice seasoning को absorb और dilute करेगा।

• बिना taste किए extra salt नहीं डालना है।
• केवल taste check और approved batch standard के अनुसार ही adjustment करें।


PROBLEM: JALNE KI MEHAK

• अगर जलने की smell आए तो तुरंत heat कम करें या gas बंद करें।
• गर्म cooking vessel या hot oil पर cold water बिल्कुल न डालें।
• अगर safe हो तो vessel को direct heat से हटाएं।
• जरूरत पड़ने पर usable biryani को clean vessel में transfer करें।


PROBLEM: BIRYANI GILI HAI

• Dum के बाद सावधानी से lid खोलें।
• अगर excess moisture है तो biryani को लगभग 5 मिनट बिना ढके rest दें ताकि
  extra steam निकल सके।
• Rice को जोर से mix न करें, वरना grains टूट सकते हैं।


==================================================
6. FINAL QUALITY CHECK
==================================================

[ ] Dum से पहले Rice लगभग 70% cooked है।

[ ] Dum के बाद Rice के grains अलग-अलग हैं।

[ ] Chicken tender और properly cooked है।

[ ] Layering से पहले Yakhni पूरी तरह dry नहीं है।

[ ] Rogan निकालकर Dum के दौरान इस्तेमाल किया गया है।

[ ] Brown Onion evenly distributed है।

[ ] Kewra और Meetha Attar की aroma balanced है।

[ ] Final biryani में rich Awadhi aroma और premium appearance है।


==================================================
BATCH STANDARD
==================================================

Batch:
1 KG Chicken + 1 KG Rice

15 KG Production:
पूरी recipe को required production quantity के अनुसार proportionately
multiply करें।

Primary Premix:
B-401 ROYAL AWADH

CHAWAL:

• 1 KG Long Grain Basmati Rice को अच्छी तरह साफ करें।
• Chawal को 30 मिनट के लिए पानी में भिगो दें।
• इस्तेमाल करने से पहले पानी पूरी तरह drain कर दें।

CHICKEN:

• 1 KG Chicken बड़े pieces में लें।
• Chicken को अच्छी तरह धोकर channi/colander में रखें ताकि excess पानी
  पूरी तरह निकल जाए।

PYAAZ / BIRISTA:

• 200 ग्राम प्याज को बारीक काटें।
• इसे golden brown होने तक fry करें।
• निकालकर अलग रख दें।

DAHI:

• 150 ग्राम दही लें।
• दही बहुत ज्यादा खट्टी नहीं होनी चाहिए।

ADRAK-LAHSUN PASTE:

• 40 ग्राम ताजा Ginger-Garlic Paste

KYROZ PREMIX:

• 1 पूरा Packet B-401 ROYAL AWADH


==================================================
2. YAKHNI PAKANA
THE BASE
==================================================

1. GHEE/OIL:

• एक बड़े भगोने में 250 ग्राम Ghee/Oil गर्म करें।

2. BHUNAI:

• गर्म तेल में 40 ग्राम Ginger-Garlic Paste डालें।
• Medium Aanch पर लगभग 30 seconds तक भूनें।
• अब 1 पूरा Packet B-401 ROYAL AWADH डालें।
• Premix को लगभग 30 seconds तक हल्का भूनें।

• अब डालें:
  - 1 KG Chicken
  - 150 ग्राम दही
  - तैयार Brown Onion का 50%

• तेज आंच पर लगभग 3–4 मिनट तक भूनें।
• तब तक भूनें जब तक ऊपर Ghee/Oil दिखाई देने न लगे।

3. GALAWAT:

• अब इसमें 100–150 ML पानी डालें।
• भगोने को ढक दें।
• धीमी आंच पर Chicken को लगभग 80% तक पकाएं।

CHECK:

• Chicken नरम होना चाहिए।
• इस stage पर meat पूरी तरह हड्डी से अलग नहीं होना चाहिए।

4. FINAL YAKHNI:

• Final Dum शुरू करने से पहले check करें कि नीचे थोड़ी Shorba/Gravy
  बची हुई हो।
• ऊपर दिखाई देने वाला लगभग 70–100 ML Rogan (Ghee/Oil) निकालकर अलग रख लें।
• इसे बाद में Dum के समय इस्तेमाल करना है।

IMPORTANT:

• Yakhni पूरी तरह सूखनी नहीं चाहिए।
• Final Dum के लिए थोड़ी gravy/moisture बची रहनी चाहिए।


==================================================
3. CHAWAL UBALNA
THE RICE
==================================================

1. PAANI:

• एक बड़े भगोने में लगभग 5–6 Litres पानी उबालें।

2. SEASONING:

उबलते पानी में डालें:

• 40 ग्राम नमक
• 2 तेज पत्ते
• 1 बड़ी इलायची
• 4 छोटी इलायची
• 7–8 लौंग
• 10–15 काली मिर्च
• 1-inch दालचीनी के 2 टुकड़े
• 15 ML Oil
• 1 नींबू का रस

3. KANI CHECK:

• Soaked और drained rice को उबलते पानी में डालें।
• Chawal को लगभग 70% तक पकाएं।
• हाथ से दबाने पर चावल का दाना partially cooked होना चाहिए और लगभग
  3 हिस्सों में टूटना चाहिए।
• तुरंत चावल को छान लें।


==================================================
4. DUM DENA
THE FINAL TOUCH
==================================================

1. LAYERING:

• तैयार Yakhni के ऊपर 70% cooked rice की एक समान layer लगाएं।

2. AROMA MIX:

एक अलग कटोरी में मिलाएं:

• 50 ML Milk
• Approved Saffron/Food Colour
• 3 बूंद Meetha Attar
• 1 चम्मच Kewra

• इस aroma mixture को rice के ऊपर evenly डालें।
• इसी समय पहले निकाला हुआ Rogan भी rice के ऊपर डालें।

3. GARNISH:

• बचा हुआ Brown Onion ऊपर से evenly sprinkle करें।

4. DUM TIMING:

• भगोने को आटे या suitable sealing method से अच्छी तरह seal करें।

• पहले 5 मिनट तेज आंच पर पकाएं।
• इसके बाद नीचे Tawa रखें।
• आंच को बिल्कुल धीमी करके 15–20 मिनट तक Dum दें।

• Dum पूरा होने के बाद भगोने को थोड़ी देर rest दें और फिर खोलें।


==================================================
5. TROUBLESHOOTING
HELPER के लिए सावधानी
==================================================

PROBLEM: NAMAK / SEASONING KAM HAI

• Rice डालने से पहले Yakhni को taste करें।
• Yakhni का taste final dish से थोड़ा ज्यादा seasoned होना चाहिए क्योंकि
  rice seasoning को absorb और dilute करेगा।

• बिना taste किए extra salt नहीं डालना है।
• केवल taste check और approved batch standard के अनुसार ही adjustment करें।


PROBLEM: JALNE KI MEHAK

• अगर जलने की smell आए तो तुरंत heat कम करें या gas बंद करें।
• गर्म cooking vessel या hot oil पर cold water बिल्कुल न डालें।
• अगर safe हो तो vessel को direct heat से हटाएं।
• जरूरत पड़ने पर usable biryani को clean vessel में transfer करें।


PROBLEM: BIRYANI GILI HAI

• Dum के बाद सावधानी से lid खोलें।
• अगर excess moisture है तो biryani को लगभग 5 मिनट बिना ढके rest दें ताकि
  extra steam निकल सके।
• Rice को जोर से mix न करें, वरना grains टूट सकते हैं।


==================================================
6. FINAL QUALITY CHECK
==================================================

[ ] Dum से पहले Rice लगभग 70% cooked है।

[ ] Dum के बाद Rice के grains अलग-अलग हैं।

[ ] Chicken tender और properly cooked है।

[ ] Layering से पहले Yakhni पूरी तरह dry नहीं है।

[ ] Rogan निकालकर Dum के दौरान इस्तेमाल किया गया है।

[ ] Brown Onion evenly distributed है।

[ ] Kewra और Meetha Attar की aroma balanced है।

[ ] Final biryani में rich Awadhi aroma और premium appearance है।


==================================================
BATCH STANDARD
==================================================

Batch:
1 KG Chicken + 1 KG Rice

15 KG Production:
पूरी recipe को required production quantity के अनुसार proportionately
multiply करें।

Primary Premix:
B-401 ROYAL AWADH

7. COSTING LOGIC

÷

=
Cost Per Biryani Portion


SELLING MARGIN

Selling Price
−
Cost Per Portion
=
Gross Contribution Per Portion


==================================================
8. SOFTWARE ENGINE
BATCH PRODUCTION ENGINE
==================================================

Core Concept:

एक Production Batch Raw Materials को consume करके Finished Biryani Stock
create करेगा।

PROCESS:

RAW MATERIALS
    ↓
B-401 + Chicken + Rice + Other Ingredients
    ↓
PRODUCTION BATCH
    ↓
FINISHED BIRYANI
    ↓
X SALEABLE PORTIONS
    ↓
POS SALE
    ↓
PORTION STOCK DEDUCTION


हर Production Batch में निम्नलिखित information store होनी चाहिए:

• Batch ID
• Product ID
• Production Date
• Production Time
• Raw Material Consumption
• SFG Consumption
• Total Batch Quantity
• Total Saleable Portions
• Production Cost
• Cost Per Portion
• Wastage / Loss
• Prepared By
• Batch Status


==================================================
9. INVENTORY TRANSACTION LOGIC
इन्वेंटरी ट्रांजैक्शन
==================================================

हर Inventory Movement के लिए एक Transaction Record बनना चाहिए।

TRANSACTION TYPES:

1. PURCHASE
   → Raw Material Stock IN

2. PRODUCTION
   → Raw Material Stock OUT
   → SFG / Finished Product Stock IN

3. PORTIONING
   → Finished Batch को Saleable Portions में Convert करना

4. BILLING
   → Saleable Portion Stock OUT

5. WASTAGE
   → Inventory Stock OUT

6. STOCK ADJUSTMENT
   → Manual Correction
   → Correction का Reason और Authorization Record होना चाहिए

Product:
SHAHI LUCKNOWI BIRYANI

• Chicken

• B-401 ROYAL AWADH
• Curd
• Ghee/Oil

• Milk

PROCESS:

Raw Materials
→ Yakhni Chicken
→ Boiled Rice
→ Dum
→ Finished Biryani

OUTPUT:

Finished Biryani Stock
→ Portioning
→ 350 GM Saleable Portions


==================================================
11. POS DEDUCTION LOGIC
==================================================

जब Customer Order करता है:

1 × Shahi Lucknowi Biryani

System सबसे पहले check करेगा:

Finished Biryani Stock >= 350 GM

IF YES:

• 350 GM Finished Biryani deduct करें
• 1 Packaging Set deduct करें
• POS Transaction create करें
• Available Portion Count update करें
• Inventory Ledger update करें

IF NO:

• "Insufficient Finished Stock" दिखाएं
• Automatic deduction complete न करें


IMPORTANT:

Raw Chicken, Rice और Premix को POS Sale के समय अलग-अलग deduct नहीं
करना है।

ये ingredients Production Batch बनाते समय ही consume हो चुके हैं।

Y KG

Variance:
X − Y KG


System में निम्नलिखित track करें:

• Overproduction
• Unsold Finished Stock

TITLE: KFC-STYLE CRISPY CHICKEN
CATEGORY: Cafe Dishes
CONTENT (EN): KYROZ+ | STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE (SOP)

PRODUCT: KFC-STYLE CRISPY CHICKEN
PRODUCT CODE: C-510 ZING MASTER

==================================================
1. MARINATION STANDARD
24-HOUR PROCESS
==================================================

CHICKEN CUTS:

• Popcorn: 10–12 G per piece
• Strips: 40 G per piece
• Wings
• Leg Pieces

Total Chicken Batch: 1 KG

Chicken must be fresh, clean and properly cut.

MARINADE:

• C-510 ZING MASTER: 40 G per 1 KG Chicken

MARINATION TIME:

• 24 Hours — Compulsory
• Store inside the refrigerator/chiller zone.

MARINATION METHOD:

1. Take 1 KG fresh chicken pieces.
2. Add 40 G C-510 ZING MASTER.
3. Mix thoroughly so that the seasoning coats every piece evenly.
4. Transfer to an airtight food-grade container.
5. Keep refrigerated for 24 hours.

This allows the seasoning to penetrate the chicken properly.

BULK STOCK OPTION:

• For monthly stock preparation, chicken may be seasoned in bulk.
• Divide the marinated chicken into small service-size portions.
• Pack each portion in airtight freezer-safe pouches.
• Freeze and use portions after controlled thawing under refrigeration.
• Never refreeze chicken after it has been completely thawed.

IMPORTANT:
Follow approved food-safety and freezer-storage standards for frozen
chicken. Do not keep frozen stock indefinitely.


==================================================
2. DRY COATING STATION SETUP
THE CRUNCH SYSTEM
==================================================

Prepare two dedicated containers at the coating station:

TUB 1 — DRY MIX

• Maida / Refined Flour

TUB 2 — CHILLED WATER

• Completely chilled/ice-cold water


==================================================
3. STEP-BY-STEP COATING METHOD
DOUBLE DIPPING
==================================================

STEP 1 — FIRST COATING

• Remove one 24-hour marinated chicken piece from refrigeration.
• Place it into Tub 1 containing dry Maida.
• Lightly roll and coat the piece with Maida.
• Do NOT press the chicken aggressively into the flour.


STEP 2 — WATER DIP

• Lift the coated piece.
• Dip it into Tub 2 containing chilled water.
• Keep it submerged for only approximately 2–3 seconds.


STEP 3 — SECOND COATING
THE FLAKING STEP

• Remove the piece from the water.
• Immediately place it back into Tub 1.
• Gently roll the piece through the Maida approximately 10–12 times.
• Use a light hand to create irregular flour flakes.
• Do NOT compress the coating.


STEP 4 — SHAKE

• Hold the coated piece carefully.
• Shake gently to remove excess loose flour.
• The surface should show visible irregular flakes.


STEP 5 — FRY

• Transfer the coated chicken immediately into the preheated oil.


==================================================
4. FRYING TEMPERATURE & TIME CHART
==================================================

CRITICAL RULE:

Oil must be properly preheated before chicken is added.

Do NOT place coated chicken into cold or insufficiently heated oil.
Low oil temperature can cause excessive oil absorption and a soft coating.

VARIANT          OIL TEMP.       APPROX. TIME       CHECK

IMPORTANT:

chicken. Do not keep frozen stock indefinitely.


==================================================
2. DRY COATING STATION SETUP
THE CRUNCH SYSTEM
==================================================

Prepare two dedicated containers at the coating station:

TUB 1 — DRY MIX

• Maida / Refined Flour

TUB 2 — CHILLED WATER

• Completely chilled/ice-cold water


==================================================
3. STEP-BY-STEP COATING METHOD
DOUBLE DIPPING
==================================================

STEP 1 — FIRST COATING

• Remove one 24-hour marinated chicken piece from refrigeration.
• Place it into Tub 1 containing dry Maida.
• Lightly roll and coat the piece with Maida.
• Do NOT press the chicken aggressively into the flour.


STEP 2 — WATER DIP

• Lift the coated piece.
• Dip it into Tub 2 containing chilled water.
• Keep it submerged for only approximately 2–3 seconds.


STEP 3 — SECOND COATING
THE FLAKING STEP

• Remove the piece from the water.
• Immediately place it back into Tub 1.
• Gently roll the piece through the Maida approximately 10–12 times.
• Use a light hand to create irregular flour flakes.
• Do NOT compress the coating.


STEP 4 — SHAKE

• Hold the coated piece carefully.
• Shake gently to remove excess loose flour.
• The surface should show visible irregular flakes.


STEP 5 — FRY

• Transfer the coated chicken immediately into the preheated oil.


==================================================
4. FRYING TEMPERATURE & TIME CHART
==================================================

CRITICAL RULE:

Oil must be properly preheated before chicken is added.

Do NOT place coated chicken into cold or insufficiently heated oil.
Low oil temperature can cause excessive oil absorption and a soft coating.

VARIANT          OIL TEMP.       APPROX. TIME       CHECK
--------------------------------------------------------------
Popcorn          180°C           3–4 Minutes        Golden brown
Strips           180°C           4–5 Minutes        Crunchy coating
Wings            170°C           6–7 Minutes        Fully cooked near bone
Leg Piece        160°C           10–12 Minutes      Deeply cooked


IMPORTANT:

Cooking time is only a guideline. Actual cooking depends on piece size,
oil recovery, fryer load and equipment.

Chicken must reach the required safe internal cooking temperature before
serving.


==================================================
5. HELPER SPECIAL ADVICE
CHEF-LESS TIPS
==================================================

NO EXTRA SALT:

• C-510 ZING MASTER contains the standardized seasoning.
• Do not add additional salt to the Maida or water unless specifically
  instructed by the approved recipe.

ICE-COLD WATER:

• Use properly chilled water for the dipping stage.
• Maintain the required temperature so the coating structure remains stable.

AVOID OVERCROWDING:

• Do not add too many chicken pieces to the fryer at once.
• Overloading can sharply reduce oil temperature.
• Low oil temperature results in excessive oil absorption and reduced
  crispiness.

BATCH CONTROL:

• Maintain consistent piece sizes.
• Fry similar-sized pieces together whenever possible.


==================================================
6. TROUBLESHOOTING
PROBLEMS & SOLUTIONS
==================================================

PROBLEM:
CRUNCH IS TOO HARD / ROCK-LIKE

REASON:
• Chicken was pressed too aggressively into the Maida during coating.
• Coating became excessively compact.

SOLUTION:
• Keep the hand light.
• Roll the chicken gently.
• Do not press or compress the flour coating.


PROBLEM:
COATING IS FALLING OFF

REASON:
• Water was not sufficiently chilled.
• Coating was not properly formed.
• Excess loose flour was not shaken off before frying.

SOLUTION:
• Use properly chilled water.
• Follow the first-coat → water-dip → second-coat sequence.
• Gently shake off excess flour before frying.
• Fry immediately after coating.


PROBLEM:
LEG PIECE IS RAW / UNDERCOOKED INSIDE

REASON:
• Oil temperature was too high.
• Outside cooked faster than the centre.
• Piece size may have been too large.

SOLUTION:
• Maintain controlled frying temperature.
• Cook the leg piece slowly and verify internal doneness before serving.
• Never rely only on outside colour to determine doneness.


PROBLEM:
CHICKEN IS OILY / COATING IS SOFT

REASON:
• Oil temperature dropped because of overcrowding.
• Chicken was added before oil reached the required temperature.

SOLUTION:
• Preheat oil properly.
• Fry in smaller batches.
• Allow the fryer to recover to the required temperature between batches.


==================================================
7. PRESENTATION
==================================================

1. Remove fried chicken from the oil using a suitable strainer.

2. Allow it to drain for approximately 1 minute.

3. Do not stack freshly fried pieces tightly while they are steaming, as
   trapped steam can soften the coating.

4. Transfer to the approved serving bucket or plate.

5. Before serving, lightly sprinkle C-509 FIRE DUST over the chicken for
   an additional spicy finishing punch.

IMPORTANT:

• Apply seasoning evenly.
• Do not over-season the finished product.


==================================================
8. FINAL QUALITY CHECK
==================================================

[ ] Chicken is fully cooked.

[ ] Coating is crisp and visibly flaky.

[ ] Coating is not excessively hard or compact.

[ ] Chicken is not excessively oily.

[ ] Outside colour is evenly golden brown.

[ ] Piece size follows the standard.

[ ] No raw or undercooked centre.

[ ] C-509 FIRE DUST is applied as per serving standard.

[ ] Product is served immediately after finishing.


==================================================

PROBLEMS & SOLUTIONS

COATING उतर रही है

PRODUCT SERIES: C-500 SERIES


==================================================
1. RAW MATERIAL MEASUREMENT
PER 10-INCH MEDIUM PIZZA
==================================================

ITEM              SPECIFICATION                         ROLE
CONTENT: KYROZ+ | STANDARD OPERATING PROCEDURE (SOP)

PRODUCT: MASTER PIZZA ASSEMBLY & BAKING
PRODUCT SERIES: C-500 SERIES


==================================================
1. RAW MATERIAL MEASUREMENT
PER 10-INCH MEDIUM PIZZA
==================================================

ITEM              SPECIFICATION                         ROLE
---------------------------------------------------------------------------
Pizza Base        10-inch base prepared using           Master Base
                  C-501 DOUGH MASTER

Pizza Sauce       Sauce prepared using C-506            Base Spread
                  MARINARA CORE — 50 G

Cheese            Diced Mozzarella + Cheddar             Fresh Cheese Pull
                  Blend — 80–100 G

Vegetables        Capsicum, Onion, Sweet Corn,           Toppings
                  Mushroom — 40 G

Seasoning         C-509 FIRE DUST                         Finishing Zing


==================================================
2. ASSEMBLY STEPS
PIZZA BANANE KA TARIKA
==================================================

1. BASE DOCKING / PRICKING:

• Take the 10-inch pizza base prepared using C-501 DOUGH MASTER.
• If the base is not pre-baked, prick the entire surface with a fork.
• Make small, evenly distributed holes across the base.
• This prevents the centre of the pizza from puffing excessively during
  baking.


2. SAUCE LAYERING:

• Place 50 G C-506 MARINARA CORE sauce in the centre of the pizza base.
• Spread the sauce in a circular motion from the centre towards the edges.
• Leave approximately 1/2 inch of the outer edge uncovered for the crust.


3. FIRST CHEESE LAYER
THE BASE LOCK:

• Take approximately 30% of the total cheese quantity.
• Sprinkle it lightly over the sauce.
• This first cheese layer helps hold the toppings in place during baking.


4. TOPPINGS PLACEMENT:

• Spread Onion, Capsicum, Sweet Corn and Mushroom evenly across the pizza.
• Do not create large piles of toppings in one area.
• Maintain even distribution from centre to edge.


5. FINAL CHEESE LAYER:

• Add the remaining 70% of the diced cheese over the toppings.
• Distribute evenly so that the toppings are lightly covered.


==================================================
3. BAKING STANDARDS
OVEN SETTINGS
==================================================

CRITICAL RULE:

• Preheat the oven for at least 15 minutes before baking pizza.
• Never place the pizza into a cold or insufficiently preheated oven.

COMMERCIAL DECK OVEN:

• Top Temperature: 280°C
• Bottom Temperature: 260°C

CONVEYOR PIZZA OVEN:

• Temperature: 250°C
• Conveyor Time/Speed Setting: Approximately 5–5.5 minutes

STANDARD BAKING TIME:

• Approximately 5–6 minutes.

FINAL CHECK:

Pizza is ready when:

• Cheese is completely melted.
• Light golden-brown spots appear on the cheese.
• Crust is evenly golden brown.
• Base is properly cooked and firm enough to hold the toppings.


IMPORTANT:

Actual baking time may vary depending on oven type, dough thickness,
topping load and oven recovery. Use the visual doneness check along with
the approved equipment setting.


==================================================
4. HELPER SPECIAL ADVICE
CHEF-LESS TIPS
==================================================

NO SOGGY BASE:

• Excess moisture from vegetables can make the pizza base soggy.
• Drain and properly dry vegetables before use.
• Frozen corn and washed vegetables should not be used while excessively
  wet.


THE GOLDEN EDGE:

• After removing the pizza from the oven, lightly brush the crust edges
  with Butter or Olive Oil.
• This gives the crust a glossy and premium appearance.


CUTTING RULE:

• Cut the pizza immediately after removing it from the oven.
• Use a Pizza Cutter.
• Cut into 4 or 6 equal slices according to the serving standard.
• Delayed cutting can cause the cheese to cool and become difficult to
  cut cleanly.


==================================================
5. TROUBLESHOOTING
PROBLEMS & SOLUTIONS
==================================================

PROBLEM:
CHEESE IS BURNT BUT BASE IS UNDERCOOKED

REASON:
• Top heat is too high compared with bottom heat.
• Pizza may be positioned too close to the top heating element.

SOLUTION:
• Reduce the top temperature by approximately 10–20°C.
• Increase bottom heat only within the approved oven specification.
• Recheck the pizza position inside the oven.


PROBLEM:
PIZZA PUFFED UP IN THE CENTRE

REASON:
• Base was not properly docked.
• Too much air remained trapped under the dough.

SOLUTION:
• Prick/dock the base evenly before sauce is added.
• Ensure the docking covers the centre area properly.


PROBLEM:
CHEESE IS MELTED BUT HAS NO CHEESE STRETCH

REASON:
• Oven temperature was too low.
• Pizza was removed before the cheese reached the required melt stage.
• Cheese blend or storage condition may also affect stretch.

SOLUTION:
• Maintain the approved oven temperature.
• Bake until the cheese is fully melted with light golden-brown spots.
• Use properly stored, approved Mozzarella/Cheddar cheese blend.


PROBLEM:
PIZZA BASE IS SOGGY

REASON:
• Vegetables contained excess water.
• Too much sauce or topping moisture was used.

SOLUTION:
• Drain and dry vegetables before assembly.
• Maintain the standard 50 G sauce quantity.
• Do not overload the pizza with wet toppings.


==================================================
6. PRESENTATION & SERVING
==================================================

• Place the finished pizza in an approved pizza box or on a wooden
  serving platter.

• Cut into 4 or 6 equal slices immediately after baking.

• Serve with 1 small portion/pouch of C-509 FIRE DUST on the side so the
  customer can add additional seasoning according to preference.

FINAL PRESENTATION:

[ ] Crust is golden brown.

[ ] Cheese is fully melted with light brown spots.

[ ] Toppings are evenly distributed.

[ ] Base is properly cooked and not soggy.

[ ] Crust edges have a light premium glaze.

[ ] Pizza is evenly cut.

[ ] C-509 FIRE DUST is provided as required.

TITLE: SAUCE MAKING
CATEGORY: Cafe Dishes
CONTENT (EN): KYROZ+ | BURGER SAUCE & DIP MAKING

SOP: SAUCE MAKING
MIXING RATIOS FOR RESTAURANT


==================================================
1. CLASSIC BURGER SAUCE
HAR BURGER KI JAAN
==================================================

RATIO:

• Mayonnaise: 200 G
• Ketchup: 100 G
• C-503 VELVET GLAZE: 30 G

RESULT:

A smooth, creamy classic orange burger sauce with a familiar fast-food
style flavour profile.


==================================================
2. TANDOORI BURGER SAUCE
NORTH INDIAN SPECIAL
==================================================

RATIO:

• Mayonnaise: 300 G
• C-503 VELVET GLAZE: 50 G
• Red Chilli Powder: 10 G

IMPORTANT:

• Do NOT add ketchup.
• The finished sauce should have a rich tandoori colour and flavour,
  suitable for Tandoori Paneer Burger and similar products.


==================================================
3. CHEESY-GARLIC DIP
FOR GARLIC BREAD
==================================================

RATIO:

• Mayonnaise: 250 G
• C-503 VELVET GLAZE: 30 G
• Liquid Cheese: 50 G

RESULT:

Creamy, cheesy and garlic-forward dip suitable for Garlic Bread and
similar snacks.


==================================================
4. PREPARATION METHOD
KAISE BANAYEIN
==================================================

1. Take a clean food-grade plastic or glass mixing bowl.

2. Measure the required quantity of Mayonnaise and Ketchup according to
   the selected sauce recipe.

3. Add the required quantity of C-503 VELVET GLAZE.

4. For Tandoori Burger Sauce, add the specified Red Chilli Powder.

5. For Cheesy-Garlic Dip, add the specified Liquid Cheese.

6. Mix thoroughly using a clean whisk or spoon.

7. Continue mixing until the sauce becomes completely smooth and no
   visible lumps remain.

8. Cover the prepared sauce and refrigerate for approximately 20 minutes
   before service.

WHY REST?

The resting period allows the seasoning to hydrate and the flavour and
colour to develop properly.


==================================================
5. STORAGE & HYGIENE
==================================================

• After preparation, always keep the sauce refrigerated.

• Store the sauce in a clean, covered, food-grade container.

• Do NOT repeatedly insert dirty or used spoons into the container.

• Always use a clean and dry serving spoon.

• Avoid cross-contamination between different sauces.

• Prepare sauce in controlled batches according to expected service
  demand to maintain freshness.


==================================================
6. TROUBLESHOOTING
==================================================

PROBLEM: SAUCE TASTES TOO SALTY

SOLUTION:

• Add a small quantity of Mayonnaise.
• Mix thoroughly and re-check the taste.


PROBLEM: SAUCE IS TOO THIN

CAUSE:

• Mayonnaise may have low viscosity or excess liquid ingredients were
  used.

SOLUTION:

• Use approved Veg Extra Thick Mayonnaise.
• Maintain the standard recipe ratio.
• Do not add unnecessary liquid.


PROBLEM: SAUCE COLOUR IS TOO LIGHT

SOLUTION:

• First verify that the correct quantity of C-503 VELVET GLAZE was used.
• For the next batch, adjust the premix only within the approved recipe
  specification.
• For Classic Burger Sauce, Ketchup may be adjusted only according to
  the approved recipe standard.


==================================================
7. FINAL QUALITY CHECK
==================================================

[ ] Sauce is smooth and lump-free.

[ ] Correct colour is achieved.

[ ] Sauce has the required thickness.

[ ] Taste is balanced.

[ ] Sauce has rested for approximately 20 minutes.

[ ] Sauce is stored covered and refrigerated.

[ ] Clean serving spoon is being used.

[ ] No cross-contamination is visible.
