TITLE: INDO-ARABIC WHITE MANDI
CATEGORY: Indo Arabic
CONTENT (EN): KYROZ+ OPERATIONAL MANUAL
SOP: INDO-ARABIC WHITE MANDI
MASTER METHOD

Batch Size: 1 KG Chicken/Mutton + 1 KG Rice
Kit: B-404 A (Meat Marination) + B-404 B (White Rice Mix)
Category: Indo-Arabic


1. PREPARATION

MEAT PREPARATION

• Clean 1 KG Chicken/Mutton properly and make deep cuts on the meat.
• Cuts should be deep enough for the marinade to penetrate properly.

RICE PREPARATION

• Soak 1 KG Long Grain Basmati Rice for 30 minutes.
• If using Sella Rice, soak it for 1–1.5 hours.
• After soaking, drain the rice properly and keep it ready.

FRESH INGREDIENTS

• Ginger-Garlic Paste: 40 G
• Fresh Lemon: 2
• Green Chillies: 5–6
• Onion: 2, finely chopped
• Cooking Oil: As required


2. MEAT MARINATION
B-404 A

1. In a clean mixing bowl, add:
   • B-404 A
   • 40 G Ginger-Garlic Paste
   • Juice of 2 Fresh Lemons
   • 30 ML Cooking Oil

2. Mix all ingredients properly to make a smooth marinade.

3. Rub the marinade evenly over the prepared meat.

4. Make sure the marinade reaches inside the deep cuts.

5. Cover and marinate under refrigeration:

   • Chicken: Minimum 1 Hour
   • Mutton: Minimum 2 Hours


3. STEAM & STOCK
MEAT COOKING METHOD

1. Boil approximately 2–3 Litres of water in a large cooking vessel.

2. Place a suitable steamer/channi over the vessel.

3. Place the marinated meat inside the steamer.

4. Cover properly and cook on low heat.

5. Steam until the meat becomes tender:

   • Chicken: Approximately 30–45 Minutes
   • Mutton: Approximately 1–1.5 Hours

6. Check the meat periodically during cooking.

7. CRITICAL STOCK RULE:

   Do NOT discard the liquid/juices collected from the meat during
   steaming.

   This liquid is the primary STOCK for cooking the Mandi Rice.

8. If the collected stock is insufficient, use hot RO water to complete
   the required rice-cooking quantity.


4. RICE COOKING
B-404 B

1. Heat 150 ML cooking oil in a separate large vessel.

2. Add finely chopped onions.

3. Cook the onions only until soft and lightly pink.

IMPORTANT:
Do NOT brown or burn the onions.

4. Add B-404 B WHITE RICE MIX.

5. Lightly sauté for only 10–15 seconds.

6. Immediately add the measured meat STOCK.

WATER/STOCK RATIO:

• For 1 KG Rice, use approximately 2 Litres total water/stock.
• Measure the available meat stock first.
• Complete the remaining quantity with hot RO water if required.

7. Once the stock begins to boil, add:

   • 5–6 Split Green Chillies
   • Soaked and drained Rice

8. Cook until most of the liquid is absorbed.

9. Once the liquid is almost completely absorbed, reduce the heat.

10. Cover and give approximately 15 Minutes Dum.

11. After dum, gently fluff the rice.

IMPORTANT:
Do not aggressively mix the rice as this can break the grains.


5. FINISHING & PRESENTATION
ROYAL LOOK

MEAT FRY

1. Transfer the steamed and tender meat to a suitable pan.

2. Add a small quantity of oil.

3. Fry for approximately 2 Minutes.

4. The outside should become lightly crispy with the desired orange finish.

IMPORTANT:
Do not over-fry the meat, otherwise the inside may become dry.


SERVING

1. Place the prepared White Mandi Rice on the serving platter.

2. Arrange the Orange Meat on top of the rice.

3. Maintain a clean and premium presentation.


DHUNGAR / SMOKE FINISH

1. Place a small piece of burning charcoal in a heat-safe container.

2. Add a small quantity of ghee over the charcoal.

3. Carefully place the smoking setup in the serving dish.

4. Cover the dish for approximately 5 Minutes.

5. Carefully remove the cover and serve immediately.

IMPORTANT:
Keep burning charcoal safely contained and away from direct customer
contact. Follow proper ventilation and fire-safety practices.


SIDES & GARNISH

Serve with:

• Red Chutney / Sahawek
• Fresh Kachumbar Salad
• Roasted Almonds
• Raisins
• Barista / Crispy Fried Onion
• Dried Lemon / Black Lemon aroma as per approved presentation standard


6. TROUBLESHOOTING
HELPER TIPS

PROBLEM: RICE COLOUR IS YELLOW OR DULL

CAUSE:
• Onion was browned too much.
• Stock contains excessive colour or impurities.

SOLUTION:
• Cook onions only until soft/light pink.
• Strain the stock before using.
• If required, adjust the final cooking quantity with clear hot RO water.


PROBLEM: MEAT IS HARD

CAUSE:
• Meat was not steamed for sufficient time.
• Meat tenderness was not checked.

SOLUTION:
• Give additional steaming time until the meat becomes properly tender.
• Follow separate cooking times for Chicken and Mutton.


PROBLEM: RICE SEASONING IS NOT BALANCED

CHECK:
• Taste the cooking liquid/stock before adding rice.
• The cooking liquid should have a sufficiently seasoned profile because
  the rice will absorb and dilute the flavour.

IMPORTANT:
• Do not automatically add extra salt.
• If additional salt is required according to the approved B-404 product
  specification, adjust only in the approved quantity.


7. MANDI DISH PRESENTATION
QUALITY CHECKLIST

[ ] RICE:
    Are the rice grains separate and maintaining the required white colour?

[ ] MEAT:
    Is the meat lightly crispy outside and juicy/tender inside?

[ ] AROMA:
    Is the desired charcoal smoke and dried lemon aroma present?

[ ] SIDES:
    Is the Red Chutney/Sahawek fresh and appropriately spicy?

[ ] GARNISH:
    Are roasted almonds, raisins and barista evenly presented?

[ ] PRESENTATION:
    Is the Orange Meat cleanly and neatly arranged over the White Rice?


8. KEY OPERATIONAL STANDARDS

• Batch Size: 1 KG Meat + 1 KG Rice
• Meat Premix: B-404 A
• Rice Premix: B-404 B
• Ginger-Garlic Paste: 40 G
• Lemon: 2
• Green Chillies: 5–6
• Onion: 2
• Cooking Oil for Marinade: 30 ML
• Rice Cooking Oil: 150 ML

MARINATION:
• Chicken — Minimum 1 Hour
• Mutton — Minimum 2 Hours

STEAMING:
• Chicken — 30–45 Minutes
• Mutton — 1–1.5 Hours

RICE:
• Approximately 2 Litres total water/stock per 1 KG Rice
• Dum — 15 Minutes

MEAT FINISHING:
• Fry — Approximately 2 Minutes

DHUNGAR:
• Approximately 5 Minutes

RICE STANDARD:
• White
• Separate grains
• Properly cooked

MEAT STANDARD:
• Tender and juicy inside
• Lightly crispy outside
• Desired orange finish

SERVICE:
White Mandi Rice + Orange Meat + Sahawek + Kachumbar +
Roasted Almonds + Raisins + Barista


Approved By:
KYROZ+ Systems
Indo-Arabic Kitchen Operations",
CONTENT (HI): KYROZ+ OPERATIONAL MANUAL
SOP: INDO-ARABIC WHITE MANDI
MASTER METHOD

Batch Size: 1 KG Chicken/Mutton + 1 KG Rice
Kit: B-404 A (Meat Marination) + B-404 B (White Rice Mix)
Category: Indo-Arabic


1. PREPARATION
तैयारी

MEAT PREPARATION

• 1 KG Chicken/Mutton को अच्छी तरह साफ करें और meat पर deep cuts
  (गहरे चीरे) लगाएं।
• Cuts इतने गहरे होने चाहिए कि marinade meat के अंदर तक अच्छी तरह
  पहुंच सके।

RICE PREPARATION

• 1 KG Long Grain Basmati Rice को 30 मिनट के लिए भिगोएं।
• अगर Sella Rice इस्तेमाल कर रहे हैं तो इसे 1–1.5 घंटे के लिए भिगोएं।
• Soaking के बाद rice को अच्छी तरह drain करके ready रखें।

FRESH INGREDIENTS

• Ginger-Garlic Paste: 40 ग्राम
• Fresh Lemon: 2
• Green Chilli: 5–6
• Onion: 2, बारीक कटी हुई
• Cooking Oil: आवश्यकतानुसार


2. MEAT MARINATION
B-404 A

1. एक साफ mixing bowl में डालें:

   • B-404 A
   • 40 ग्राम Ginger-Garlic Paste
   • 2 Fresh Lemon का रस
   • 30 ML Cooking Oil

2. सभी ingredients को अच्छी तरह mix करके smooth marinade तैयार करें।

3. तैयार marinade को पूरे meat पर evenly लगाएं।

4. ध्यान रखें कि marinade deep cuts के अंदर तक अच्छी तरह पहुंचे।

5. Container को cover करके refrigeration में marinate करें:

   • Chicken: Minimum 1 घंटा
   • Mutton: Minimum 2 घंटे


3. STEAM & STOCK
MEAT GALANE की विधि

1. एक बड़े cooking vessel में लगभग 2–3 Litres पानी उबालें।

2. Vessel के ऊपर suitable steamer/channi रखें।

3. Marinated meat को steamer के अंदर रखें।

4. Vessel को अच्छी तरह ढककर low heat पर पकाएं।

5. Meat को tender होने तक steam करें:

   • Chicken: लगभग 30–45 मिनट
   • Mutton: लगभग 1–1.5 घंटे

6. Cooking के दौरान meat को बीच-बीच में check करते रहें।

7. CRITICAL STOCK RULE:

   Meat से steaming के दौरान जो liquid/juice नीचे पानी में collect होता है,
   उसे बिल्कुल discard नहीं करना है।

   यही liquid Mandi Rice के लिए primary STOCK है।

8. अगर collected stock कम हो तो required rice-cooking quantity पूरी करने के
   लिए गरम RO water का इस्तेमाल करें।


4. RICE COOKING
B-404 B

1. एक अलग बड़े vessel में **150 ML cooking oil** गर्म करें।

2. इसमें बारीक कटा हुआ प्याज डालें।

3. प्याज को केवल soft और हल्का pink होने तक पकाएं।

IMPORTANT:
प्याज को brown या burn नहीं करना है।

4. अब **B-404 B WHITE RICE MIX** डालें।

5. केवल **10–15 seconds** तक हल्का भूनें।

6. तुरंत measured meat STOCK डालें।

WATER/STOCK RATIO:

• 1 KG Rice के लिए लगभग 2 Litres total water/stock इस्तेमाल करें।
• पहले उपलब्ध meat stock को measure करें।
• अगर stock कम है तो remaining quantity hot RO water से पूरी करें।

7. जब stock/water उबलने लगे तो इसमें डालें:

   • 5–6 Split Green Chillies
   • Soaked और drained Rice

8. Rice को पकाएं जब तक अधिकांश liquid absorb न हो जाए।

9. जब liquid लगभग पूरी तरह absorb हो जाए तो heat low कर दें।

10. Vessel को cover करके लगभग **15 मिनट Dum** दें।

11. Dum पूरा होने के बाद rice को हल्के हाथ से fluff करें।

IMPORTANT:
Rice को जोर से mix नहीं करना है, वरना rice grains टूट सकते हैं।


5. FINISHING & PRESENTATION
ROYAL LOOK

MEAT FRY

1. Steamed और tender meat को एक suitable pan में transfer करें।

2. थोड़ी मात्रा में oil डालें।

3. लगभग **2 मिनट** तक fry करें।

4. Meat बाहर से हल्का crispy और desired orange colour का होना चाहिए।

IMPORTANT:
Meat को over-fry नहीं करना है, वरना अंदर का meat dry हो सकता है।


SERVING

1. Serving platter पर पहले तैयार White Mandi Rice रखें।

2. Rice के ऊपर Orange Meat को neatly arrange करें।

3. पूरी presentation clean और premium रखनी है।


DHUNGAR / SMOKE FINISH

1. एक छोटे heat-safe container में जलता हुआ charcoal रखें।

2. Charcoal के ऊपर थोड़ी मात्रा में ghee डालें।

3. Smoking setup को सावधानी से serving dish में रखें।

4. Dish को लगभग **5 मिनट** के लिए cover करें।

5. Cover सावधानी से हटाकर तुरंत serve करें।

IMPORTANT:
जलते हुए charcoal को सुरक्षित तरीके से contained रखें और customer के
direct contact से दूर रखें। Proper ventilation और fire-safety practices
का पालन करें।


SIDES & GARNISH

साथ में serve करें:

• Red Chutney / Sahawek
• Fresh Kachumbar Salad
• Roasted Almonds
• Raisins
• Barista / Crispy Fried Onion
• Approved presentation standard के अनुसार Dried Lemon / Black Lemon aroma


6. TROUBLESHOOTING
HELPER TIPS

PROBLEM: CHAWAL KA COLOUR PEELA YA DULL HAI

CAUSE:
• प्याज जरूरत से ज्यादा brown हो गया।
• Stock में ज्यादा colour या impurities हैं।

SOLUTION:
• अगली बार प्याज को केवल soft/light pink होने तक पकाएं।
• Stock को इस्तेमाल करने से पहले strain करें।
• जरूरत पड़ने पर final cooking quantity को clear hot RO water से adjust करें।


PROBLEM: MEAT SAKHT HAI

CAUSE:
• Meat को पर्याप्त समय तक steam नहीं किया गया।
• Meat की tenderness check नहीं की गई।

SOLUTION:
• Meat को properly tender होने तक additional steaming time दें।
• Chicken और Mutton के लिए अलग-अलग cooking times follow करें।


PROBLEM: RICE KA SEASONING BALANCED NAHI HAI

CHECK:

• Rice डालने से पहले cooking liquid/stock को taste करें।
• Cooking liquid sufficiently seasoned होना चाहिए क्योंकि rice इसे absorb
  करेगा और flavour dilute होगा।

IMPORTANT:

• Automatically extra salt नहीं डालना है।
• अगर approved B-404 product specification के अनुसार additional salt की
  आवश्यकता हो तभी approved quantity में adjustment करें।


7. MANDI DISH PRESENTATION
QUALITY CHECKLIST

[ ] RICE:
    क्या rice grains अलग-अलग हैं और required white colour maintain कर रहे हैं?

[ ] MEAT:
    क्या meat बाहर से हल्का crispy और अंदर से juicy/tender है?

[ ] AROMA:
    क्या desired charcoal smoke और dried lemon की aroma आ रही है?

[ ] SIDES:
    क्या Red Chutney/Sahawek fresh और appropriately spicy है?

[ ] GARNISH:
    क्या roasted almonds, raisins और barista evenly presented हैं?

[ ] PRESENTATION:
    क्या Orange Meat को White Rice के ऊपर clean और neatly arrange किया गया है?

• Green Chilli: 5–6

MARINATION:
• Chicken — Minimum 1 घंटा
• Mutton — Minimum 2 घंटे

STEAMING:
• Chicken — 30–45 मिनट
• Mutton — 1–1.5 घंटे

RICE:
• 1 KG Rice के लिए लगभग 2 Litres total water/stock
• Dum — 15 मिनट

MEAT FINISHING:
• Fry — लगभग 2 मिनट

DHUNGAR:
• लगभग 5 मिनट

RICE STANDARD:
• White
• Separate grains
• Properly cooked

MEAT STANDARD:
• अंदर से tender और juicy
• बाहर से lightly crispy
• Desired orange finish

SERVICE:
White Mandi Rice + Orange Meat + Sahawek + Kachumbar +
Roasted Almonds + Raisins + Barista

CONTENT: KYROZ+ OPERATIONAL MANUAL
SOP: INDO-ARABIC WHITE MANDI
MASTER METHOD

Batch Size: 1 KG Chicken/Mutton + 1 KG Rice
Kit: B-404 A (Meat Marination) + B-404 B (White Rice Mix)
Category: Indo-Arabic


1. PREPARATION

MEAT PREPARATION

• Clean 1 KG Chicken/Mutton properly and make deep cuts on the meat.
• Cuts should be deep enough for the marinade to penetrate properly.

RICE PREPARATION

• Soak 1 KG Long Grain Basmati Rice for 30 minutes.
• If using Sella Rice, soak it for 1–1.5 hours.
• After soaking, drain the rice properly and keep it ready.

FRESH INGREDIENTS

• Ginger-Garlic Paste: 40 G
• Fresh Lemon: 2
• Green Chillies: 5–6
• Onion: 2, finely chopped
• Cooking Oil: As required


2. MEAT MARINATION
B-404 A

1. In a clean mixing bowl, add:
   • B-404 A
   • 40 G Ginger-Garlic Paste
   • Juice of 2 Fresh Lemons
   • 30 ML Cooking Oil

2. Mix all ingredients properly to make a smooth marinade.

3. Rub the marinade evenly over the prepared meat.

4. Make sure the marinade reaches inside the deep cuts.

5. Cover and marinate under refrigeration:

   • Chicken: Minimum 1 Hour
   • Mutton: Minimum 2 Hours


3. STEAM & STOCK
MEAT COOKING METHOD

1. Boil approximately 2–3 Litres of water in a large cooking vessel.

2. Place a suitable steamer/channi over the vessel.

3. Place the marinated meat inside the steamer.

4. Cover properly and cook on low heat.

5. Steam until the meat becomes tender:

   • Chicken: Approximately 30–45 Minutes
   • Mutton: Approximately 1–1.5 Hours

6. Check the meat periodically during cooking.

7. CRITICAL STOCK RULE:

   Do NOT discard the liquid/juices collected from the meat during
   steaming.

   This liquid is the primary STOCK for cooking the Mandi Rice.

8. If the collected stock is insufficient, use hot RO water to complete
   the required rice-cooking quantity.


4. RICE COOKING
B-404 B

1. Heat 150 ML cooking oil in a separate large vessel.

2. Add finely chopped onions.

3. Cook the onions only until soft and lightly pink.

IMPORTANT:
Do NOT brown or burn the onions.

4. Add B-404 B WHITE RICE MIX.

5. Lightly sauté for only 10–15 seconds.

6. Immediately add the measured meat STOCK.

WATER/STOCK RATIO:

• For 1 KG Rice, use approximately 2 Litres total water/stock.
• Measure the available meat stock first.
• Complete the remaining quantity with hot RO water if required.

7. Once the stock begins to boil, add:

   • 5–6 Split Green Chillies
   • Soaked and drained Rice

8. Cook until most of the liquid is absorbed.

9. Once the liquid is almost completely absorbed, reduce the heat.

10. Cover and give approximately 15 Minutes Dum.

11. After dum, gently fluff the rice.

IMPORTANT:
Do not aggressively mix the rice as this can break the grains.


5. FINISHING & PRESENTATION
ROYAL LOOK

MEAT FRY

1. Transfer the steamed and tender meat to a suitable pan.

2. Add a small quantity of oil.

3. Fry for approximately 2 Minutes.

4. The outside should become lightly crispy with the desired orange finish.

IMPORTANT:
Do not over-fry the meat, otherwise the inside may become dry.


SERVING

1. Place the prepared White Mandi Rice on the serving platter.

2. Arrange the Orange Meat on top of the rice.

3. Maintain a clean and premium presentation.


DHUNGAR / SMOKE FINISH

1. Place a small piece of burning charcoal in a heat-safe container.

2. Add a small quantity of ghee over the charcoal.

3. Carefully place the smoking setup in the serving dish.

4. Cover the dish for approximately 5 Minutes.

5. Carefully remove the cover and serve immediately.

IMPORTANT:
Keep burning charcoal safely contained and away from direct customer
contact. Follow proper ventilation and fire-safety practices.


SIDES & GARNISH

Serve with:

• Red Chutney / Sahawek
• Fresh Kachumbar Salad
• Roasted Almonds
• Raisins
• Barista / Crispy Fried Onion
• Dried Lemon / Black Lemon aroma as per approved presentation standard


6. TROUBLESHOOTING
HELPER TIPS

PROBLEM: RICE COLOUR IS YELLOW OR DULL

CAUSE:
• Onion was browned too much.
• Stock contains excessive colour or impurities.

SOLUTION:
• Cook onions only until soft/light pink.
• Strain the stock before using.
• If required, adjust the final cooking quantity with clear hot RO water.


PROBLEM: MEAT IS HARD

CAUSE:
• Meat was not steamed for sufficient time.
• Meat tenderness was not checked.

SOLUTION:
• Give additional steaming time until the meat becomes properly tender.
• Follow separate cooking times for Chicken and Mutton.


PROBLEM: RICE SEASONING IS NOT BALANCED

CHECK:
• Taste the cooking liquid/stock before adding rice.
• The cooking liquid should have a sufficiently seasoned profile because
  the rice will absorb and dilute the flavour.

IMPORTANT:
• Do not automatically add extra salt.
• If additional salt is required according to the approved B-404 product
  specification, adjust only in the approved quantity.


7. MANDI DISH PRESENTATION
QUALITY CHECKLIST

[ ] RICE:
    Are the rice grains separate and maintaining the required white colour?

[ ] MEAT:
    Is the meat lightly crispy outside and juicy/tender inside?

[ ] AROMA:
    Is the desired charcoal smoke and dried lemon aroma present?

[ ] SIDES:
    Is the Red Chutney/Sahawek fresh and appropriately spicy?

[ ] GARNISH:
    Are roasted almonds, raisins and barista evenly presented?

[ ] PRESENTATION:
    Is the Orange Meat cleanly and neatly arranged over the White Rice?


8. KEY OPERATIONAL STANDARDS

• Batch Size: 1 KG Meat + 1 KG Rice
• Meat Premix: B-404 A
• Rice Premix: B-404 B
• Ginger-Garlic Paste: 40 G
• Lemon: 2
• Green Chillies: 5–6
• Onion: 2
• Cooking Oil for Marinade: 30 ML
• Rice Cooking Oil: 150 ML

MARINATION:
• Chicken — Minimum 1 Hour
• Mutton — Minimum 2 Hours

STEAMING:
• Chicken — 30–45 Minutes
• Mutton — 1–1.5 Hours

RICE:
• Approximately 2 Litres total water/stock per 1 KG Rice
• Dum — 15 Minutes

MEAT FINISHING:
• Fry — Approximately 2 Minutes

DHUNGAR:
• Approximately 5 Minutes

RICE STANDARD:
• White
• Separate grains
• Properly cooked

MEAT STANDARD:
• Tender and juicy inside
• Lightly crispy outside
• Desired orange finish

SERVICE:
White Mandi Rice + Orange Meat + Sahawek + Kachumbar +
Roasted Almonds + Raisins + Barista


Approved By:
KYROZ+ Systems
Indo-Arabic Kitchen Operations",

## 1. MORNING SETUP & PRE-PREP

### 8:00 AM – 10:00 AM

As soon as the helper enters the kitchen, the following three activities must be completed first.

---

## A. BATTER HYDRATION

### Dosa & Idli

* Prepare the batter according to the respective SOP.
* Allow the prepared batter to rest for **20 minutes** before service or further preparation.

### Chutneys

* Prepare **Coconut Chutney** and **Red Kara Chutney** according to their respective SOPs.
* Keep prepared chutneys refrigerated until required for service.

### Medu Vada

* Prepare the Medu Vada batter according to the approved SOP.
* Whisk/beat the batter properly.
* Keep the prepared batter refrigerated.
* **Cold batter helps the Medu Vada maintain better shape during preparation.**

---

# B. VEGETABLE CUTTING

## STANDARD SIZES

In a chef-less kitchen, vegetable preparation should be completed in one organized batch instead of repeated cutting throughout the day.

### Sambhar

* Cut **Bottle Gourd (Lauki)**, **Drumstick (Sahjan)**, and **Onion** into large pieces of approximately **2 inches**.
* Boil the vegetables according to the Sambhar SOP.
* Cool appropriately and store under refrigeration in clean, covered containers.

### Aloo Masala

* Boil the potatoes.
* Peel and lightly mash them.
* Keep them ready for Aloo Masala preparation.

### Toppings — Uttapam / Rava Dosa

Prepare one **Mix-Veg Topping Bowl** containing:

* Finely chopped Onion
* Finely chopped Tomato
* Finely chopped Green Chilli
* Finely chopped Fresh Coriander

Keep covered and refrigerated until required.

---

# C. THE TADKA STATION

Maintain one dedicated tadka station containing the following items:

* **Rai / Mustard Seeds**
* **Whole Red Chillies**
* **Fresh Curry Leaves**
* **Cooking Oil / Ghee**
* **Split Urad Dal**

All essential tadka ingredients must be replenished before service.

# 3. STANDARD DAILY SCHEDULE

### 10:30 AM — QUALITY CHECK

Perform:

* Batter **Salt Check**
* Batter **Consistency Check**
* Chutney **Salt Check**
* Chutney **Consistency Check**

**Important:** No additional salt should be added where the respective premix SOP specifies that salt is already included in the premix.

### 11:30 AM — PRE-LUNCH PREPARATION

Before the lunch rush:

* Prepare the first fresh batch of **Sambhar**.
* Prepare the first fresh batch of **Aloo Masala**.
* Ensure all service stations are fully stocked.

### 4:00 PM — EVENING SNACK PREPARATION

* Prepare fresh **Medu Vada batter** as required.
* Refill dosa/idli batter stations.
* Check chutney and topping quantities.
* Replenish tadka ingredients.

### 9:30 PM — CLOSING PROCEDURE

At closing:

1. Transfer remaining approved batter to refrigeration promptly.
2. Perform **deep cleaning of the dosa tawa and surrounding station**.
3. Clean and sanitize work surfaces and utensils.
4. Check premix inventory for the following day's operation.
5. Record low-stock items for replenishment.

---

# 4. OWNER'S QUALITY AUDIT

## CHEF-LESS KITCHEN CHECKLIST

Kitchen performance can be audited through four simple checks.

### 1. THE SOUND TEST — TAWA HEAT

* Sprinkle a small amount of water on the tawa.
* Listen for the characteristic **"shhh"** sound.
* Use this as a quick indication that the tawa has reached the required cooking temperature.

### 2. THE VISUAL TEST — PRODUCT QUALITY

Check:

* Sambhar should have a consistent, appetizing colour.
* Coconut Chutney should retain its expected light/white appearance.
* Red Kara Chutney should retain its expected red colour.
* Dosa, Rava Dosa and Uttapam should have their specified colour and texture.

### 3. THE SMELL TEST — FRESHNESS

* Fresh **curry leaves and mustard tadka** should produce a noticeable aroma during service.
* Unusual sour, stale, burnt or off-odours should be investigated immediately.

### 4. WASTE CHECK — PORTION CONTROL

At the end of the day, check:

* Quantity of unused batter
* Quantity of unused chutney
* Vegetable waste
* Other discarded food

Excessive waste indicates that production quantities or portion control need adjustment.

---

# 5. SPECIAL CHEF-LESS HACK

## THE MEASUREMENT CUP SYSTEM

Helpers should **never rely on अंदाज़ / guesswork** for water measurement.

Keep standardized measuring cups/jugs in the kitchen:

* **250 ml**
* **500 ml**
* **1 Litre**

## STANDARD RULE

**1 Premix Packet = Standardized Quantity of Water**

The exact water quantity must always be taken from the **respective product SOP**.

### Example

If a particular SOP specifies:

**1 KG Premix = 2.5 Litres Water**

then use:

**2 × 1 Litre + 2 × 250 ml = 2.5 Litres**

This ensures the same water-to-premix ratio every time.

---

# DAILY GOLDEN RULES

1. **Measure — Don't Guess.**
2. **Follow the individual product SOP.**
3. **Do not add extra salt when salt is already included in the premix.**
4. **Keep prepared food covered and refrigerated when required.**
5. **Use fixed ladle sizes for portion control.**
6. **Keep every station stocked before rush hours.**
7. **Record waste and low-stock items every day.**
8. **Clean as you work and deep-clean at closing.**

CONTENT: # KYROZ+ OPERATIONAL MANUAL

## ALOO MASALA (STUFFING)

**Document Code:** KY/SOP/ALU-03
**Category:** South Indian

---

# 1. PRE-COOKING PREPARATION

## POTATO PREPARATION

* Boil **1 KG potatoes**, peel them, and keep them ready for preparation.
* Ensure the potatoes are properly cooked but not excessively watery.

## MASHING

* Lightly break/mash the boiled potatoes by hand.
* Do **not** turn the potatoes into a completely smooth paste.

### CRITICAL RULE

* Small potato pieces should remain in the mixture.
* This provides the required texture when the dosa is eaten.

## NO-SALT RULE

**DO NOT ADD SALT while boiling the potatoes.**

* All required salt is already included in **Kyroz S-302 YELLOW TEMPER**.
* No additional salt should be added during preparation.

---

# 2. QUANTITY CHART

## MEASUREMENT

Always follow the standardized ratio to maintain consistent taste and texture.

| Boiled Potatoes | S-302 YELLOW TEMPER |   RO Water |         Cooking Oil |
| --------------: | ------------------: | ---------: | ------------------: |
|        **1 KG** |       **120 Grams** | **150 ml** | **2–3 Tablespoons** |
|   **500 Grams** |        **60 Grams** |  **75 ml** | **1.5 Tablespoons** |
|   **250 Grams** |        **30 Grams** |  **40 ml** |    **1 Tablespoon** |

---

# 3. COOKING STEPS

## 1. HEAT OIL

* Heat the required quantity of cooking oil in a clean kadai according to the measurement chart.

## 2. SAUTÉ S-302 YELLOW TEMPER

* Add **S-302 YELLOW TEMPER** to the hot oil.
* Stir for only **30–40 seconds**.

### Important

* Do not burn the seasoning.
* The mustard seeds should begin to splutter and the dal should become lightly golden brown.

## 3. ADD WATER

* Immediately add the required quantity of RO water.
* Once water is added, the dehydrated onion and curry leaves will hydrate and the mixture will develop into a thick masala base.

## 4. ADD POTATOES

* Add the lightly mashed boiled potatoes.
* Mix thoroughly so that the seasoning and masala coat the potatoes evenly.

## 5. FINISHING

* Cook on **low heat for approximately 2 minutes**.
* Switch off the heat after the mixture reaches the required semi-solid stuffing consistency.

**Optional:**
If fresh coriander is available, finely chop and add a small quantity before finishing.

---

# 4. TROUBLESHOOTING MATRIX

| Issue                                       | Cause                                                              | Solution                                                                                                            |
| ------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Masala is too dry**                       | Insufficient water remained in the mixture.                        | Add **2–3 teaspoons warm RO water** and adjust to the required soft consistency.                                    |
| **Masala tastes too salty**                 | Potato quantity was insufficient for the amount of seasoning used. | Add **1–2 additional boiled potatoes**, lightly mash them, and mix thoroughly.                                      |
| **Masala has burnt**                        | Oil was excessively hot or the seasoning was cooked for too long.  | In the next batch, add the seasoning as soon as the oil is hot and add water promptly after the 30–40 second sauté. |
| **Masala does not spread properly on dosa** | Stuffing is too firm/thick.                                        | Add a small amount of water and mash/mix until the stuffing becomes **semi-solid and easily spreadable**.           |

---

# 5. HELPER ADVICE

## CHEF-LESS KITCHEN

## FRESHNESS

* Prepare only the quantity of Aloo Masala expected to be consumed within approximately **2–3 hours**.
* Older potato masala may lose its desired taste and texture.

## STORAGE

* If any masala remains, transfer it to a clean **airtight food-grade container** and refrigerate promptly.
* Follow the restaurant's approved food-safety holding period.

## CONSISTENCY

* The stuffing should be **soft and semi-solid**.
* It must spread easily over the dosa without tearing or damaging the dosa surface.

---

# KEY OPERATIONAL STANDARDS

* **Product:** S-302 YELLOW TEMPER
* **Additional Salt:** **NONE**
* **1 KG Potatoes:** 120 G S-302 + 150 ml RO Water + 2–3 tbsp Oil
* **500 G Potatoes:** 60 G S-302 + 75 ml RO Water + 1.5 tbsp Oil
* **250 G Potatoes:** 30 G S-302 + 40 ml RO Water + 1 tbsp Oil
* **Seasoning Sauté Time:** 30–40 seconds
* **Final Cooking:** Approximately 2 minutes on low heat
* **Texture:** Semi-solid and easily spreadable
* **Potato Texture:** Lightly mashed with small pieces remaining

| **Masala नमकीन ज्यादा लग रहा है**            | Seasoning की मात्रा के हिसाब से potato quantity कम है।       | **1–2 उबले हुए आलू** और डालकर हल्का mash करें और अच्छी तरह mix करें।                                            |
| **Masala जल गया**                            | Oil बहुत ज्यादा गर्म था या seasoning को ज्यादा देर भुना गया। | अगली बार oil गर्म होते ही seasoning डालें और 30–40 seconds के बाद तुरंत पानी डालें।                             |
| **Masala dosa पर ठीक से spread नहीं हो रहा** | Stuffing बहुत ज्यादा thick/hard है।                          | थोड़ी मात्रा में पानी डालकर mash/mix करें जब तक stuffing **semi-solid और आसानी से spread होने योग्य** न हो जाए। |

---

# 5. HELPER ADVICE

## CHEF-LESS KITCHEN

### FRESHNESS

* Aloo Masala उतनी ही मात्रा में तैयार करें जितनी लगभग **2–3 घंटे** में consume हो जाए।
* पुराना potato masala अपना desired taste और texture खो सकता है।

### STORAGE

* अगर masala बच जाए तो उसे clean **airtight food-grade container** में transfer करके तुरंत refrigerator में रखें।
* Restaurant के approved food-safety holding period को follow करें।

### CONSISTENCY

* Stuffing **soft और semi-solid** होनी चाहिए।
* इसे dosa के ऊपर आसानी से spread किया जा सके और dosa फटे या damage न हो।

---

# KEY OPERATIONAL STANDARDS

* **Product:** S-302 YELLOW TEMPER
* **Additional Salt:** **बिल्कुल नहीं**
* **1 KG Potatoes:** 120 G S-302 + 150 ml RO Water + 2–3 tbsp Oil
* **500 G Potatoes:** 60 G S-302 + 75 ml RO Water + 1.5 tbsp Oil
* **250 G Potatoes:** 30 G S-302 + 40 ml RO Water + 1 tbsp Oil
* **Seasoning Sauté Time:** 30–40 seconds
* **Final Cooking:** Low heat पर लगभग 2 मिनट
* **Texture:** Semi-solid और आसानी से spread होने वाली
* **Potato Texture:** हल्का mashed, छोटे pieces के साथ

CONTENT: # KYROZ+ OPERATIONAL MANUAL

## INSTANT COCONUT CHUTNEY

**Document Code:** KY/SOP/CHT-04
**Category:** South Indian

---

# 1. PREPARATION

## WATER QUALITY

* Always use **cold RO water** for preparing the chutney.
* Cold water helps maintain a fresh coconut flavour and appearance.

## CRITICAL RULE — NO ADDITIONAL SALT

**DO NOT ADD SALT while preparing the chutney or during tadka preparation.**

* **100% of the required salt is already included in S-307 KERALA KERNEL.**
* No additional salt should be added during preparation or finishing.

---

# 2. MIXING RATIO

## MEASUREMENT CHART

| Approx. Chutney Quantity | S-307 KERALA KERNEL |   Cold RO Water |
| -----------------------: | ------------------: | --------------: |
|       **Approx. 3.5 KG** |            **1 KG** |  **2.5 Litres** |
|       **Approx. 1.7 KG** |       **500 Grams** | **1.25 Litres** |
|    **Approx. 350 Grams** |       **100 Grams** |      **250 ml** |

**Important:** Always follow the standardized measurement ratio for consistent taste and texture.

---

# 3. MIXING STEPS

## 1. BLENDING

* Measure the required quantity of **S-307 KERALA KERNEL** according to the chart.
* Transfer the powder into a clean mixing vessel.

## 2. ADDING WATER

* Slowly add **cold RO water** in portions.
* Continuously mix using a whisk or clean spoon.
* Ensure the powder hydrates evenly without dry pockets or lumps.

## 3. RESTING PERIOD — MUST

* After mixing, cover the chutney and allow it to rest for **10–15 minutes**.

### Reason

The desiccated coconut component absorbs water and hydrates during resting. This improves the texture and gives the chutney a fresh coconut-like appearance and mouthfeel.

## 4. CONSISTENCY CHECK

After 15 minutes:

* Check the chutney consistency.
* If the chutney is too thick, gradually add a small amount of cold RO water.
* Mix thoroughly and adjust to the required serving consistency.

---

# 4. FRESH TADKA

## THE KYROZ SIGNATURE

Fresh tadka should be prepared after the chutney has completed its resting period.

### TADKA PREPARATION

* Heat **1–2 teaspoons oil** in a small pan.
* Add:

  * **Mustard Seeds (Rai)**
  * **1–2 Whole Red Chillies**
  * **8–10 Fresh Curry Leaves**
* Allow the mustard seeds to splutter properly.
* Pour the fresh tadka over the prepared chutney.
* Lightly mix so that the tempering is distributed without disturbing the chutney's texture.

---

# 5. TROUBLESHOOTING MATRIX

| Issue                     | Cause                                                 | Solution                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Chutney is too thin**   | Excess water was added.                               | Add a small quantity of **S-307 KERALA KERNEL powder**, mix well, and allow it to rest for **5 minutes**. |
| **Flavour is weak**       | Excess water diluted the standardized formulation.    | Follow the measurement chart strictly in the next batch.                                                  |
| **Colour is yellow/dark** | Hot water was used or the chutney was left uncovered. | Always use **cold RO water** and refrigerate the prepared chutney in a covered container.                 |
| **Texture is dry**        | The required resting time was not given.              | Allow the chutney to rest for at least **10 minutes** before final consistency adjustment and service.    |

---

# 6. HELPER ADVICE

## CHEF-LESS KITCHEN

## SMALL BATCHES

* Do not prepare unnecessarily large quantities at one time.
* Prepare **2–3 smaller batches throughout the day** to maintain freshness and quality.

## COLD STORAGE

* After preparation, always store the chutney in the **refrigerator**.
* Coconut-based chutney can spoil quickly if left unrefrigerated.

## SERVICE

* During plating/service, ensure that a small amount of the fresh tadka is visible and distributed across each serving.

---

# KEY OPERATIONAL STANDARDS

* **Product:** S-307 KERALA KERNEL
* **Water:** Cold RO Water only
* **Additional Salt:** **NONE**
* **Resting Time:** 10–15 minutes
* **Small Batch:** 100 G Powder + 250 ml Water
* **Medium Batch:** 500 G Powder + 1.25 L Water
* **Large Batch:** 1 KG Powder + 2.5 L Water
* **Tadka Oil:** 1–2 teaspoons
* **Whole Red Chillies:** 1–2
* **Fresh Curry Leaves:** 8–10
* **Storage:** Refrigerated and covered

### WATER QUALITY

* Cold water से coconut का flavour और appearance ज्यादा fresh बना रहता है।

### CRITICAL RULE — NAMAK बिल्कुल नहीं डालना है

**Chutney बनाते समय या tadka लगाते समय NAMAK/SALT बिल्कुल नहीं डालना है।**

* **S-307 KERALA KERNEL में 100% required salt पहले से शामिल है।**
* Preparation या finishing के दौरान extra salt नहीं डालना है।

# 2. MIXING RATIO

## MEASUREMENT CHART

| Approx. Chutney Quantity | S-307 KERALA KERNEL |   Cold RO Water |
| -----------------------: | ------------------: | --------------: |
|          **लगभग 3.5 KG** |            **1 KG** |  **2.5 Litres** |

# 3. MIXING STEPS

## Chutney बनाने की विधि

### 1. BLENDING

* Measurement chart के अनुसार required quantity में **S-307 KERALA KERNEL** लें।
* Powder को एक साफ mixing vessel में डालें।

### 2. WATER ADD करना

* **Cold RO Water** को धीरे-धीरे portions में डालें।
* Whisk या साफ spoon से लगातार mix करते रहें।
* Powder पूरी तरह hydrate होना चाहिए और कोई dry portion या lumps नहीं रहने चाहिए।

### 3. RESTING PERIOD — MUST

* Mixing के बाद chutney को ढककर **10–15 मिनट** के लिए rest दें।

### क्यों?

Desiccated coconut वाला हिस्सा पानी को absorb करके hydrate होता है। इससे chutney की texture बेहतर होती है और इसका appearance और mouthfeel fresh coconut जैसा बनता है।

### 4. CONSISTENCY CHECK

15 मिनट बाद:

* Chutney की consistency check करें।
* अगर chutney बहुत गाढ़ी है तो थोड़ी मात्रा में cold RO water धीरे-धीरे डालें।
* अच्छी तरह mix करके required serving consistency तक adjust करें।

---

* इसमें डालें:

  * **Rai / Mustard Seeds**
  * **1–2 Sabut Laal Mirch**
  * **8–10 Fresh Curry Leaves**
* Rai को अच्छी तरह चटकने दें।
* तैयार fresh tadka को chutney के ऊपर डालें।
* हल्के हाथ से mix करें ताकि tadka evenly distribute हो जाए और chutney की texture खराब न हो।

## INSTANT DOSA

**Document Code:** KY/SOP/DOSA-01
**Category:** South Indian
CONTENT (HI): # 1. DOSA BATTER PREPARATION

## S-301 COASTAL CRUST TO WATER RATIO

* **1 KG S-301 COASTAL CRUST:** 1.5–1.6 Litres RO Water

## MIXING METHOD

* Take the required quantity of **S-301 COASTAL CRUST** in a large, clean mixing vessel.
* Slowly add RO water while continuously whisking.
* Mix thoroughly until a smooth batter is formed.

## ZERO-LUMPS RULE

* The batter must be completely smooth.
* **No lumps should remain in the batter.**

## RESTING PERIOD

* Cover the prepared batter and allow it to rest for **15–20 minutes**.
* This resting period allows the semolina and rice flour components to properly absorb the water.

## FINAL CONSISTENCY CHECK

After 20 minutes:

* Check the batter consistency.
* If the batter has become too thick, add approximately **50 ml water** and mix again.
* Final consistency should be **pourable** — neither excessively thin nor excessively thick.
CONTENT: # KYROZ+ OPERATIONAL MANUAL

## INSTANT DOSA

**Document Code:** KY/SOP/DOSA-01
**Category:** South Indian

---

# 1. DOSA BATTER PREPARATION

## S-301 COASTAL CRUST TO WATER RATIO

* **1 KG S-301 COASTAL CRUST:** 1.5–1.6 Litres RO Water

## MIXING METHOD

* Take the required quantity of **S-301 COASTAL CRUST** in a large, clean mixing vessel.
* Slowly add RO water while continuously whisking.
* Mix thoroughly until a smooth batter is formed.

## ZERO-LUMPS RULE

* The batter must be completely smooth.
* **No lumps should remain in the batter.**

## RESTING PERIOD

* Cover the prepared batter and allow it to rest for **15–20 minutes**.
* This resting period allows the semolina and rice flour components to properly absorb the water.

## FINAL CONSISTENCY CHECK

After 20 minutes:

* Check the batter consistency.
* If the batter has become too thick, add approximately **50 ml water** and mix again.
* Final consistency should be **pourable** — neither excessively thin nor excessively thick.

---

# 2. COOKING STEPS

## 1. TAWA TEMPERATURE

* Heat the dosa tawa properly.
* To check the temperature, sprinkle a small amount of water on the surface.
* If the water evaporates immediately with a **"shhh" sound**, the tawa is ready.

## 2. SURFACE CLEANING & TEMPERATURE CONTROL

* Before preparing each dosa, wipe the tawa with a **clean damp cloth**.
* This helps control the surface temperature and prepares the tawa for even spreading.

## 3. BATTER SPREADING

* Pour one standard ladle of batter into the centre of the tawa.
* Using light pressure, spread the batter in a circular motion from the centre outward.
* Maintain an even thickness throughout the dosa.

## 4. OILING

* Once the dosa begins to dry slightly:

  * Add approximately **1 teaspoon oil or butter** around the edges.
  * Add a small amount over the centre as required.

## 5. FLASHING / FINAL COOKING

* Cook on **medium heat**.
* Continue cooking until the dosa naturally starts releasing from the edges.
* The bottom should develop an even **golden-brown colour**.
* Remove and serve immediately.

---

# 3. TROUBLESHOOTING MATRIX

| Issue                               | Cause                                                       | Solution                                                                                                              |
| ----------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Dosa is sticking to the tawa**    | Tawa temperature is too high.                               | Sprinkle a small amount of water on the tawa to bring the surface temperature down, then wipe clean before spreading. |
| **Dosa is not spreading properly**  | Batter is too thick.                                        | Add **2–3 tablespoons RO water**, mix thoroughly, and check the consistency again.                                    |
| **Dosa is not crispy**              | Tawa is too cool or dosa was removed too early.             | Maintain medium heat and allow the dosa to cook slightly longer before removing.                                      |
| **Dosa is tearing from the centre** | Batter is old or the required resting period was not given. | Allow fresh batter to rest for **15 minutes** and ensure proper mixing during preparation.                            |
| **Dosa is not developing colour**   | Heat distribution across the tawa is uneven.                | Adjust the tawa position and flame so that heat is distributed evenly across the cooking surface.                     |

---

# 4. HELPER & CHEF-LESS KITCHEN ADVICE

## FIRST IN, FIRST OUT — FIFO

* Always use the **oldest prepared batter first**.
* Follow FIFO strictly for prepared batter batches.

## PORTION CONTROL

* Keep a **fixed-size ladle** for dosa preparation.
* Use the same ladle size for every order to maintain consistent dosa size and portion control.

## CLEAN TAWA, BETTER DOSA

* After every **5–10 dosas**, lightly sprinkle salt water on the tawa and clean the surface.
* This helps maintain a consistent cooking surface.

## NO CORNSTARCH RULE

* S-301 COASTAL CRUST does not contain cornstarch.
* Proper tawa temperature control is essential for preventing sticking and achieving consistent dosa release.

## HYGIENE

* Always use a **clean and dry ladle/spoon** when taking batter from the storage container.
* Keep the batter container covered whenever it is not being used.

---

# 5. STORAGE INSTRUCTIONS

## S-301 COASTAL CRUST — DRY PREMIX

* Store in a **cool, dry place**.
* After opening the packet, transfer the remaining premix to an **airtight container**.
* Protect the powder from moisture.

## PREPARED BATTER

* If batter remains after service, store it in the **refrigerator**.
* Before using refrigerated batter again, mix it thoroughly to restore an even consistency.
* Follow the restaurant's approved food-safety holding period for prepared batter.

---

# KEY OPERATIONAL STANDARDS

* **Product:** S-301 COASTAL CRUST
* **Water Ratio:** 1 KG premix : 1.5–1.6 L RO water
* **Resting Time:** 15–20 minutes
* **Additional Water if Thick:** Approximately 50 ml
* **Cooking Heat:** Medium
* **Dosa Finish:** Golden Brown
* **Tawa Cleaning:** Every 5–10 dosas
* **Portion Control:** Fixed-size ladle
* **Storage:** Dry premix in airtight container; prepared batter refrigerated

# KYROZ+ OPERATIONAL MANUAL

## INSTANT DOSA

**Document Code:** KY/SOP/DOSA-01
**Category:** South Indian

---

# 1. DOSA BATTER PREPARATION

## घोल बनाने का तरीका

### S-301 COASTAL CRUST TO WATER RATIO

* **1 KG S-301 COASTAL CRUST:** 1.5–1.6 Litres RO Water

### MIXING METHOD

* एक बड़े और साफ mixing vessel में required quantity में **S-301 COASTAL CRUST** लें।
* धीरे-धीरे RO water डालते हुए लगातार whisk/fentni से मिलाएं।
* अच्छी तरह mix करें जब तक एक smooth batter तैयार न हो जाए।

### ZERO-LUMPS RULE

* Batter बिल्कुल smooth होना चाहिए।
* **Batter में एक भी गांठ/lump नहीं रहना चाहिए।**

### RESTING PERIOD

* तैयार batter को ढककर **15–20 मिनट** के लिए rest करने दें।
* यह resting period जरूरी है ताकि batter में मौजूद semolina और rice flour पानी को अच्छी तरह absorb कर सकें।

### FINAL CONSISTENCY CHECK

20 मिनट बाद:

* Batter की consistency check करें।
* अगर batter ज्यादा गाढ़ा हो गया हो तो लगभग **50 ml पानी** डालकर दोबारा mix करें।
* Final consistency **pourable** होनी चाहिए — न बहुत पतली और न बहुत गाढ़ी।

---

# 2. COOKING STEPS

## Dosa बनाने की विधि

### 1. TAWA TEMPERATURE

* Dosa tawa को अच्छी तरह गर्म करें।
* Temperature check करने के लिए tawa पर थोड़ा पानी छिड़कें।
* अगर पानी तुरंत सूखकर **"shhh" sound** करे, तो tawa तैयार है।

### 2. SURFACE CLEANING & TEMPERATURE CONTROL

* हर dosa बनाने से पहले tawa को **साफ गीले कपड़े** से हल्के हाथ से पोंछें।
* इससे surface temperature control होता है और अगला dosa evenly spread होता है।

### 3. BATTER SPREADING

* Tawa के बीच में एक standard ladle batter डालें।
* हल्के हाथ से centre से बाहर की तरफ गोल-गोल घुमाते हुए batter फैलाएं।
* पूरे dosa की thickness लगभग समान रखें।

### 4. OILING

जब dosa हल्का सूखने लगे:

* किनारों पर लगभग **1 teaspoon oil या butter** डालें।
* जरूरत के अनुसार centre पर भी थोड़ी मात्रा डालें।

### 5. FLASHING / FINAL COOKING

* Dosa को **medium heat** पर पकाएं।
* तब तक पकाएं जब तक dosa अपने आप किनारों से tawa छोड़ने न लगे।
* नीचे की तरफ **golden-brown colour** आ जाना चाहिए।
* तुरंत निकालकर serve करें।

---

# 3. TROUBLESHOOTING MATRIX

## समस्या आने पर क्या करें

| समस्या                           | कारण                                                   | समाधान                                                                                  |
| -------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Dosa tawa पर चिपक रहा है**     | Tawa का temperature बहुत ज्यादा है।                    | Tawa पर थोड़ा पानी छिड़ककर surface temperature कम करें और spreading से पहले साफ करें।   |
| **Dosa फैल नहीं रहा है**         | Batter बहुत गाढ़ा है।                                  | **2–3 tablespoon RO water** डालें, अच्छी तरह mix करें और consistency दोबारा check करें। |
| **Dosa crispy नहीं है**          | Tawa ठंडा है या dosa जल्दी निकाल लिया गया।             | Medium heat बनाए रखें और dosa को थोड़ा अधिक समय तक पकाएं।                               |
| **Dosa बीच से फट रहा है**        | Batter पुराना है या proper resting time नहीं दिया गया। | Batter को कम से कम **15 मिनट rest** दें और preparation के समय अच्छी तरह mix करें।       |
| **Dosa का colour नहीं आ रहा है** | Tawa पर heat distribution समान नहीं है।                | Tawa की position और flame को adjust करें ताकि पूरी cooking surface पर heat evenly मिले। |

---

# 4. HELPER & CHEF-LESS KITCHEN ADVICE

## FIRST IN, FIRST OUT — FIFO

* हमेशा **सबसे पहले तैयार किया गया batter पहले इस्तेमाल करें**।
* Prepared batter के लिए FIFO system strictly follow करें।

## PORTION CONTROL

* Dosa बनाने के लिए एक **fixed-size ladle** रखें।
* हर order में उसी ladle का उपयोग करें ताकि सभी customers को consistent size और portion का dosa मिले।

## CLEAN TAWA, BETTER DOSA

* हर **5–10 dosas** के बाद tawa पर हल्का नमक वाला पानी छिड़ककर surface साफ करें।
* इससे cooking surface की consistency बनाए रखने में मदद मिलती है।

## NO CORNSTARCH RULE

* **S-301 COASTAL CRUST में cornstarch नहीं है।**
* Dosa को tawa पर चिपकने से रोकने और proper release के लिए सही temperature control सबसे महत्वपूर्ण है।

## HYGIENE

* Batter निकालने के लिए हमेशा **साफ और सूखे ladle/spoon** का इस्तेमाल करें।
* Batter container को इस्तेमाल न होने पर हमेशा ढककर रखें।

---

# 5. STORAGE INSTRUCTIONS

## Storage का तरीका

### S-301 COASTAL CRUST — DRY PREMIX

* इसे **ठंडी और सूखी जगह** पर रखें।
* Packet खोलने के बाद बचे हुए premix को **airtight container** में transfer करें।
* Powder को moisture से बचाकर रखें।

### PREPARED BATTER

* अगर service के बाद batter बच जाए तो उसे **refrigerator** में रखें।
* अगले दिन इस्तेमाल करने से पहले batter को अच्छी तरह mix करें ताकि consistency दोबारा even हो जाए।
* Prepared batter के लिए restaurant के approved food-safety holding period को follow करें।

---

# KEY OPERATIONAL STANDARDS

* **Water Ratio:** 1 KG premix : 1.5–1.6 L RO water
* **Resting Time:** 15–20 मिनट

* **Cooking Heat:** Medium
* **Dosa Finish:** Golden Brown
* **Tawa Cleaning:** हर 5–10 dosas

# 1. PREPARATION

## तैयारी

### WATER QUALITY

* Batter बनाने के लिए हमेशा **ताजा RO Water** का इस्तेमाल करें।

### OIL

* Fry करने के लिए हमेशा **fresh refined oil** का इस्तेमाल करें।

### CRITICAL RULE — NAMAK बिल्कुल नहीं डालना है

**Batter बनाते समय NAMAK/SALT बिल्कुल नहीं डालना है।**

* **S-304 CRUNCH CORE में 100% required salt पहले से शामिल है।**
* कोई अतिरिक्त salt नहीं डालना है।

---

# 2. MIXING RATIO

## MEASUREMENT CHART

Medu Vada का batter dosa और idli batter से **ज्यादा thick और stiff** होना चाहिए ताकि frying के दौरान vada अपनी shape बनाए रखे।

| -----------------------: | -------------: | ------------------------------ |

**महत्वपूर्ण:** पानी की मात्रा carefully measure करें। Batter को बहुत पतला नहीं करना है।

---

# 3. COOKING STEPS

## Vada बनाने की विधि

### 1. MIXING

* Required quantity में **S-304 CRUNCH CORE** लें।
* इसमें पानी डालकर अच्छी तरह mix करें।
* एक **गाढ़ा और stiff batter** तैयार करें।

### 2. RESTING PERIOD — MUST

* Batter को ढककर **20 मिनट** के लिए rest दें।
* इससे urad dal flour पानी को अच्छी तरह absorb करके properly hydrate हो जाता है।

### 3. WHISKING / BEATING

* Fry करने से ठीक पहले batter को **2–3 मिनट तक एक ही direction में** अच्छी तरह beat/whisk करें।
* Proper beating से batter में हवा शामिल होती है, जिससे vada अंदर से हल्का और spongy बनता है।

### 4. SHAPING

* हाथों को साफ पानी से गीला करें।
* Batter का एक portion लें।
* उसे round vada shape दें और बीच में एक hole बनाएं।
* इसे सावधानी से गरम oil में छोड़ें।

**Machine Option:**
Standard shape और fast production के लिए **Medu Vada Maker machine** का इस्तेमाल किया जा सकता है।

### 5. FRYING

* **Medium heat** पर fry करें।
* Vada को तब तक fry करें जब तक बाहर से even **golden-brown colour** न आ जाए।
* निकालने से पहले यह सुनिश्चित करें कि अंदर का हिस्सा पूरी तरह cooked हो।

CONTENT: # KYROZ+ OPERATIONAL MANUAL

## INSTANT RICE IDLI

**Document Code:** KY/SOP/IDL-06
**Category:** South Indian

---

# 1. PRE-COOKING PREPARATION

## WATER QUALITY

* Always use **fresh RO water** for batter preparation.

## IDLI TRAYS / MOULDS

* Lightly grease the idli moulds with oil before filling.
* Ensure all mould cavities are evenly coated to prevent sticking.

## CRITICAL RULE — NO ADDITIONAL SALT

**DO NOT ADD SALT while preparing the batter.**

* **100% of the required salt is already included in S-305 STEAM CLOUD.**
* Adding additional salt will disturb the standardized product formulation.

---

# 2. MIXING RATIO

## MEASUREMENT CHART

| S-305 STEAM CLOUD Powder |           RO Water | Approx. Idli Yield |
| -----------------------: | -----------------: | -----------------: |
|                 **1 KG** | **1.2–1.3 Litres** |    **45–50 Idlis** |
|            **500 Grams** |     **600–650 ml** |    **22–25 Idlis** |
|            **200 Grams** |         **250 ml** |     **8–10 Idlis** |

**Critical:** Batter consistency is essential for achieving soft and spongy rice idlis.

---

# 3. MIXING & STEAMING STEPS

## 1. MIXING

* Transfer the required quantity of **S-305 STEAM CLOUD** into a large, clean vessel.
* Slowly add RO water while continuously mixing.
* The batter should be **thick and smooth**.
* The consistency must be noticeably thicker than dosa batter.

## 2. RESTING PERIOD — MUST

* Cover the prepared batter.
* Allow it to rest for **15 minutes**.

### Reason

The rice flour and poha powder need sufficient time to absorb water. Proper hydration is essential for achieving a soft and spongy idli texture.

## 3. FILLING THE MOULDS

* Lightly oil the idli moulds.
* Fill each mould with the prepared batter.
* **Do not fill the moulds completely to the top**, as the idli will expand during steaming.

## 4. STEAMING

* Bring water to a boil in the steamer.
* Once sufficient steam is generated, carefully place the filled idli stand inside the steamer.

## 5. STEAMING TIME

* Steam at **medium-high heat for 10–12 minutes**.
* Do not exceed the standardized cooking time unnecessarily.

## 6. COOLING & DEMOULDING

* After switching off the gas, do not remove the idli stand immediately.
* Allow it to rest for approximately **2 minutes**.
* Remove the stand after the 2-minute cooling period.
* Dip the spoon in water before removing each idli to help release it cleanly from the mould.

---

# 4. TROUBLESHOOTING MATRIX

| Issue                                | Cause                                                             | Solution                                                                                               |
| ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Idli is hard**                     | Insufficient water or batter was not rested properly.             | Ensure the batter rests for **15 minutes** and maintain the recommended soft/thick consistency.        |
| **Idli has collapsed / become flat** | Excess water was added to the batter.                             | Reduce the water quantity by approximately **50–100 ml** in the next batch and check consistency.      |
| **Idli is sticking to the mould**    | Mould was not properly greased or idli was removed while too hot. | Lightly oil the moulds before filling and allow the stand to cool for **2 minutes** before demoulding. |
| **Idli is not properly white**       | Water quality was poor or idli was over-steamed.                  | Always use **fresh RO water** and do not steam beyond the recommended **12-minute maximum**.           |

---

# 5. HELPER ADVICE

## CHEF-LESS KITCHEN

## FRESHNESS

* Prepare only the quantity of idlis expected to be consumed within approximately **1–2 hours**.
* If required, refrigerated/cold idlis may be reheated using the restaurant's approved steaming procedure before serving.

## THE TOOTHPICK TEST

To check whether the idli is cooked:

* Insert a clean toothpick or knife into the centre of the idli.
* If it comes out **clean without wet batter sticking to it**, the idli is ready.

## STORAGE OF S-305 STEAM CLOUD

* Keep the S-305 STEAM CLOUD packet tightly sealed.
* After opening, transfer the remaining powder to an **airtight container**.
* Protect the powder from moisture to preserve the performance of the raising/leavening system.

---

# KEY OPERATIONAL STANDARDS

* **Product:** S-305 STEAM CLOUD
* **1 KG Water Ratio:** 1.2–1.3 Litres RO Water
* **500 G Water Ratio:** 600–650 ml RO Water
* **200 G Water Ratio:** 250 ml RO Water
* **Resting Time:** 15 minutes
* **Steaming Temperature:** Medium-high heat
* **Steaming Time:** 10–12 minutes
* **Cooling Before Demoulding:** 2 minutes
* **Additional Salt:** **NONE**
* **1 KG Yield:** Approximately 45–50 Idlis
* **500 G Yield:** Approximately 22–25 Idlis
* **200 G Yield:** Approximately 8–10 Idlis

# 1. PRE-COOKING PREPARATION

## तैयारी

### WATER QUALITY

### IDLI TRAYS / MOULDS

* Idli के सांचों/moulds पर भरने से पहले हल्का सा oil लगाएं।
* सभी mould cavities पर oil की even coating होनी चाहिए ताकि idli चिपके नहीं।

### CRITICAL RULE — NAMAK बिल्कुल नहीं डालना है

**Batter बनाते समय NAMAK/SALT बिल्कुल नहीं डालना है।**

* **S-305 STEAM CLOUD में 100% required salt पहले से शामिल है।**

## MEASUREMENT CHART

| S-305 STEAM CLOUD Powder |           RO Water | Approx. Idli Yield |
| -----------------------: | -----------------: | -----------------: |

# 3. MIXING & STEAMING STEPS

## Idli बनाने की विधि

### 1. MIXING

* Required quantity में **S-305 STEAM CLOUD** को एक बड़े और साफ बर्तन में निकालें।
* धीरे-धीरे RO water डालते हुए लगातार mix करें।
* Batter **thick और smooth** होना चाहिए।
* इसकी consistency dosa batter से स्पष्ट रूप से ज्यादा गाढ़ी होनी चाहिए।

### 2. RESTING PERIOD — MUST

* तैयार batter को ढककर **15 मिनट** के लिए rest दें।

### क्यों?

Rice flour और poha powder को पानी absorb करने के लिए समय चाहिए। Proper hydration से idli soft और spongy बनती है।

### 3. MOULDS FILL करना

* Idli moulds पर हल्का oil लगाएं।
* तैयार batter को moulds में भरें।
* **Mould को पूरा ऊपर तक नहीं भरना है**, क्योंकि steaming के दौरान idli फूलती है।

### 4. STEAMING

* Steamer में पानी को अच्छी तरह उबालें।
* जब पर्याप्त steam बनने लगे, तब filled idli stand को सावधानी से steamer के अंदर रखें।

### 5. STEAMING TIME

* **Medium-high heat पर 10–12 मिनट** steam करें।
* Standard cooking time से अनावश्यक रूप से ज्यादा steam नहीं करना है।

### 6. COOLING & DEMOULDING

* Gas बंद करने के तुरंत बाद idli stand को बाहर नहीं निकालना है।
* लगभग **2 मिनट** तक अंदर ही rest करने दें।
* 2 मिनट बाद stand बाहर निकालें।
* Idli निकालने से पहले spoon को पानी में dip करें, फिर mould से idli को निकालें ताकि वह आसानी से release हो जाए।

CONTENT (EN): # KYROZ+ OPERATIONAL MANUAL

## MIX-VEG UTTAPAM

**Document Code:** KY/SOP/UTP-09
**Category:** South Indian
CONTENT (HI): # 1. PRE-COOKING PREPARATION

## BATTER SOURCE

* Use **Kyroz S-305 STEAM CLOUD** for preparing the Uttapam batter.

## VEGETABLE TOPPINGS

Prepare the following toppings separately in a clean bowl:

* Finely chopped **Onion**
* Finely chopped **Tomato**
* Finely chopped **Green Chilli**
* Finely chopped **Fresh Coriander**

Mix the toppings evenly and keep them ready for service.

## CRITICAL RULE — NO ADDITIONAL SALT

**DO NOT ADD SALT to the batter or vegetable toppings.**

* **100% of the required salt is already included in S-305 STEAM CLOUD.**
* No additional salt should be added during preparation or cooking.
CONTENT: # KYROZ+ OPERATIONAL MANUAL

## MIX-VEG UTTAPAM

**Document Code:** KY/SOP/UTP-09
**Category:** South Indian

---

# 1. PRE-COOKING PREPARATION

## BATTER SOURCE

* Use **Kyroz S-305 STEAM CLOUD** for preparing the Uttapam batter.

## VEGETABLE TOPPINGS

Prepare the following toppings separately in a clean bowl:

* Finely chopped **Onion**
* Finely chopped **Tomato**
* Finely chopped **Green Chilli**
* Finely chopped **Fresh Coriander**

Mix the toppings evenly and keep them ready for service.

## CRITICAL RULE — NO ADDITIONAL SALT

**DO NOT ADD SALT to the batter or vegetable toppings.**

* **100% of the required salt is already included in S-305 STEAM CLOUD.**
* No additional salt should be added during preparation or cooking.

---

# 2. MIXING RATIO

## MEASUREMENT CHART

Uttapam batter should be:

* Slightly softer than Idli batter
* Slightly thicker than Dosa batter

| S-305 STEAM CLOUD Powder |           RO Water | Required Consistency |
| -----------------------: | -----------------: | -------------------- |
|                 **1 KG** | **1.4–1.5 Litres** | Thick but Pourable   |
|            **500 Grams** |     **700–750 ml** | Semi-thick           |

---

# 3. COOKING STEPS

## THE "PIZZA" TECHNIQUE

### 1. MIXING & RESTING

* Mix the required quantity of **S-305 STEAM CLOUD** with RO water.
* Cover and allow the batter to rest for **15 minutes**.
* Do not skip the resting period.

### 2. TAWA TEMPERATURE

* Heat the tawa to **medium temperature**.
* The tawa should be slightly cooler than the temperature used for regular dosa.

### 3. POURING

* Lightly grease the tawa with oil.
* Pour one standard ladle of batter into the centre.
* Do **not** spread it as thin as a dosa.
* Maintain a moderately thick Uttapam layer.

### 4. TOPPING

* Immediately spread the prepared mixed-vegetable toppings over the batter.
* Lightly press the toppings into the batter so that they adhere properly.

### 5. OILING

* Apply a small amount of oil or butter around the edges and lightly over the toppings.

### 6. FLIPPING

* Once the bottom surface becomes **golden brown**, carefully flip the Uttapam.
* Cook the topping side for approximately **1 minute**.
* Allow the onion and tomato to lightly roast without burning.

### 7. FINAL TOUCH

* Flip once more if required.
* Serve immediately while hot.

---

# 4. TROUBLESHOOTING MATRIX

| Issue                               | Cause                                                                                             | Solution                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Uttapam is raw inside**           | Batter was too thick or cooking heat was too high.                                                | Add a small amount of water to adjust the batter and cook on lower heat for longer.       |
| **Toppings are falling off**        | Toppings were not pressed into the batter or the batter surface dried before toppings were added. | Add toppings immediately after pouring the batter and gently press them into the surface. |
| **Uttapam is not spongy**           | Required resting period was skipped.                                                              | Always allow the batter to rest for **15 minutes** before cooking.                        |
| **Uttapam is sticking to the tawa** | Tawa temperature is too low or insufficient oil was used.                                         | Check the tawa temperature and apply an appropriate amount of oil or butter.              |

---

# 5. HELPER ADVICE

## CHEF-LESS KITCHEN

## COLOUR CHECK

* A proper **golden-brown colour** is an important visual quality indicator.
* An excessively pale Uttapam may indicate insufficient cooking.

## UNIFORMITY

* Use the same fixed-size bowl or ladle for every Uttapam.
* This maintains consistent size, thickness, and portion control.

## COMBO IDEA

* For North Indian customer preferences, serve **Red Kara Chutney** along with **Coconut Chutney** as the standard accompaniment.

---

# KEY OPERATIONAL STANDARDS

* **Product:** S-305 STEAM CLOUD
* **Additional Salt:** **NONE**
* **1 KG Powder:** 1.4–1.5 Litres RO Water
* **500 G Powder:** 700–750 ml RO Water
* **Resting Time:** 15 minutes
* **Tawa:** Medium heat
* **Batter:** Thick but pourable
* **Topping:** Onion + Tomato + Green Chilli + Coriander
* **Topping-Side Cooking:** Approximately 1 minute
* **Finish:** Golden Brown and Spongy
* **Service:** Hot with Red Kara Chutney + Coconut Chutney

---

**Mohd Arif Kamal**

# KYROZ+ OPERATIONAL MANUAL

## MIX-VEG UTTAPAM

**Document Code:** KY/SOP/UTP-09
**Category:** South Indian

---

# 1. PRE-COOKING PREPARATION

## तैयारी

### BATTER SOURCE

* Uttapam batter बनाने के लिए **Kyroz S-305 STEAM CLOUD** का इस्तेमाल करें।

### VEGETABLE TOPPINGS

एक साफ bowl में निम्न toppings को बारीक काटकर पहले से तैयार रखें:

* बारीक कटा हुआ **प्याज**
* बारीक कटा हुआ **टमाटर**
* बारीक कटी हुई **हरी मिर्च**
* बारीक कटा हुआ **हरा धनिया**

सभी toppings को अच्छी तरह mix करके service के लिए ready रखें।

### CRITICAL RULE — NAMAK बिल्कुल नहीं डालना है

**Batter या vegetable toppings में NAMAK/SALT बिल्कुल नहीं डालना है।**

* **S-305 STEAM CLOUD में 100% required salt पहले से शामिल है।**
* Preparation या cooking के दौरान कोई additional salt नहीं डालना है।

---

# 2. MIXING RATIO

## MEASUREMENT CHART

Uttapam का batter:

* Idli batter से थोड़ा नरम
* Dosa batter से थोड़ा गाढ़ा

होना चाहिए।

| S-305 STEAM CLOUD Powder |           RO Water | Required Consistency |
| -----------------------: | -----------------: | -------------------- |
|                 **1 KG** | **1.4–1.5 Litres** | Thick but Pourable   |
|            **500 ग्राम** |     **700–750 ml** | Semi-thick           |

---

# 3. COOKING STEPS

## THE "PIZZA" TECHNIQUE

### 1. MIXING & RESTING

* Required quantity में **S-305 STEAM CLOUD** को RO water के साथ mix करें।
* Batter को ढककर **15 मिनट** के लिए rest दें।
* Resting period को skip नहीं करना है।

### 2. TAWA TEMPERATURE

* Tawa को **medium heat** पर गर्म करें।
* Tawa regular dosa बनाने वाले temperature से थोड़ा कम गर्म होना चाहिए।

### 3. POURING

* Tawa पर हल्का oil लगाएं।
* Centre में एक standard ladle batter डालें।
* इसे dosa की तरह बहुत पतला **spread नहीं करना है**।
* Uttapam की layer moderately thick रखें।

### 4. TOPPING

* Batter डालने के तुरंत बाद उसके ऊपर तैयार mixed-vegetable toppings डालें।
* Toppings को हल्के हाथ से batter में press करें ताकि वे surface पर अच्छी तरह stick हो जाएं।

### 5. OILING

* किनारों पर और toppings के ऊपर थोड़ी मात्रा में oil या butter लगाएं।

### 6. FLIPPING

* जब नीचे की surface **golden brown** हो जाए तो Uttapam को सावधानी से flip करें।
* Toppings वाली side को लगभग **1 मिनट** तक पकाएं।
* Onion और tomato को हल्का roast होने दें, लेकिन जलने न दें।

### 7. FINAL TOUCH

* जरूरत पड़ने पर एक बार फिर flip करें।
* गरमा-गरम तुरंत serve करें।

---

# 4. TROUBLESHOOTING MATRIX

## गलती होने पर क्या करें?

| समस्या                       | कारण                                                                                           | समाधान                                                                            |
| ---------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Uttapam अंदर से कच्चा है** | Batter बहुत ज्यादा गाढ़ा था या cooking heat बहुत तेज थी।                                       | थोड़ी मात्रा में पानी डालकर batter adjust करें और कम heat पर ज्यादा समय तक पकाएं। |
| **Toppings गिर रही हैं**     | Toppings को batter में press नहीं किया गया या toppings डालने से पहले batter की surface सूख गई। | Batter डालते ही toppings डालें और हल्के हाथ से surface में press करें।            |
| **Uttapam spongy नहीं है**   | Required resting period skip किया गया।                                                         | Batter को cooking से पहले हमेशा **15 मिनट rest** दें।                             |
| **Uttapam tawa पर चिपक गया** | Tawa का temperature बहुत कम है या oil पर्याप्त नहीं लगाया गया।                                 | Tawa का temperature check करें और उचित मात्रा में oil या butter लगाएं।            |

---

# 5. HELPER ADVICE

## CHEF-LESS KITCHEN

### COLOUR CHECK

* Proper **golden-brown colour** Uttapam की quality का महत्वपूर्ण visual indicator है।
* बहुत ज्यादा सफेद/pale Uttapam insufficient cooking का संकेत हो सकता है।

### UNIFORMITY

* हर Uttapam के लिए एक ही fixed-size bowl या ladle का इस्तेमाल करें।
* इससे size, thickness और portion सभी consistent रहते हैं।

### COMBO IDEA

* North Indian customer preference के अनुसार **Red Kara Chutney** के साथ **Coconut Chutney** भी standard accompaniment के रूप में serve करें।

---

# KEY OPERATIONAL STANDARDS

* **Product:** S-305 STEAM CLOUD
* **Additional Salt:** **बिल्कुल नहीं**
* **1 KG Powder:** 1.4–1.5 Litres RO Water
* **500 ग्राम Powder:** 700–750 ml RO Water
* **Resting Time:** 15 मिनट
* **Tawa:** Medium heat
* **Batter:** Thick but Pourable
* **Toppings:** Onion + Tomato + Green Chilli + Coriander
* **Topping-Side Cooking:** लगभग 1 मिनट
* **Finish:** Golden Brown और Spongy
* **Service:** Red Kara Chutney + Coconut Chutney के साथ गरमा-गरम

---

TITLE: PREMIUM SAMBHAR
CATEGORY: South Indian
CONTENT (EN): # KYROZ+ OPERATIONAL MANUAL

## PREMIUM SAMBHAR

**Document Code:** KY/SOP/SAM-02
**Category:** South Indian
CONTENT (HI): # 1. PRE-COOKING PREPARATION

## FRESH VEGETABLE PREPARATION

* Cut **Bottle Gourd (Lauki)**, **Drumstick (Sahjan)**, and **Onion (Pyaaz)** into large, uniform pieces.
* Keep the vegetable pieces reasonably consistent in size for even cooking.

## BOILING RULE

* Boil the vegetables separately in a clean vessel using **RO water**.
* Cook until the vegetables are tender but still retain their shape.

## CRITICAL RULE — NO ADDITIONAL SALT

**DO NOT ADD SALT while boiling the vegetables.**

* All required salt is already included in **S-308 LENTIL LAVA**.
* Do not add additional salt during vegetable preparation.
CONTENT: # KYROZ+ OPERATIONAL MANUAL

## PREMIUM SAMBHAR

**Document Code:** KY/SOP/SAM-02
**Category:** South Indian

---

# 1. PRE-COOKING PREPARATION

## FRESH VEGETABLE PREPARATION

* Cut **Bottle Gourd (Lauki)**, **Drumstick (Sahjan)**, and **Onion (Pyaaz)** into large, uniform pieces.
* Keep the vegetable pieces reasonably consistent in size for even cooking.

## BOILING RULE

* Boil the vegetables separately in a clean vessel using **RO water**.
* Cook until the vegetables are tender but still retain their shape.

## CRITICAL RULE — NO ADDITIONAL SALT

**DO NOT ADD SALT while boiling the vegetables.**

* All required salt is already included in **S-308 LENTIL LAVA**.
* Do not add additional salt during vegetable preparation.

---

# 2. MIXING & QUANTITY CHART

Helpers must strictly follow the standardized measurement chart below.

| Sambhar Quantity | S-308 LENTIL LAVA |       RO Water | Fresh Boiled Vegetables |
| ---------------: | ----------------: | -------------: | ----------------------: |
|    **10 Litres** |          **1 KG** |   **9 Litres** |              **1.5 KG** |
|     **5 Litres** |     **500 Grams** | **4.5 Litres** |           **750 Grams** |
|      **1 Litre** |     **100 Grams** |     **900 ml** |           **150 Grams** |

---

# 3. COOKING STEPS

## 1. WATER HEATING

* Transfer the required quantity of RO water into a large cooking vessel.
* Heat the water until it is **warm/hot**, but avoid unnecessary vigorous boiling at this stage.

## 2. S-308 LENTIL LAVA BLENDING

* Slowly add **S-308 LENTIL LAVA** to the warm water.
* Whisk continuously until the powder is fully dispersed.
* Ensure there are **no visible lumps**.

## 3. VEGETABLE ADDITION

* Add the previously boiled fresh vegetables to the prepared sambhar base.
* Mix gently to distribute the vegetables evenly.

## 4. SIMMERING

* Simmer the sambhar on **medium heat for 10–12 minutes**.
* Stir periodically to prevent settling and ensure the lentil powder and spices are evenly integrated.

## 5. CONSISTENCY CHECK

* If the sambhar becomes too thick, add a small quantity of **boiling/hot RO water** and mix thoroughly.
* **Never add cold water directly to hot sambhar.**

---

# 4. FRESH TADKA

## MANDATORY STEP

Fresh tadka must be added after the sambhar has completed simmering.

### TADKA PREPARATION

* Heat **2 teaspoons oil or ghee** in a small pan.
* Add:

  * **Mustard Seeds (Rai)**
  * **2–3 Whole Red Chillies**
  * **10–12 Fresh Curry Leaves**
* Allow the mustard seeds to splutter.
* Pour the hot tadka into the prepared sambhar.
* Immediately cover the vessel with a lid to help retain the aroma.

---

# 5. TROUBLESHOOTING MATRIX

| Issue                                        | Cause                                                                       | Solution                                                                                                                  |
| -------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Sambhar is too salty**                     | Too little water was used or salt was accidentally added to the vegetables. | Add a controlled quantity of **boiling RO water** and, if required, a small amount of **jaggery** to balance the flavour. |
| **Sambhar tastes too weak / under-seasoned** | Excess water was added.                                                     | Simmer for an additional **5–7 minutes** to reduce the liquid and concentrate the flavour.                                |
| **Lumps are present**                        | S-308 LENTIL LAVA was added to cold water or was not whisked properly.      | Use a suitable hand blender to smooth the mixture, or strain the sambhar if required.                                     |
| **Taste is bland / not developed**           | Insufficient simmering time.                                                | Simmer for at least **10 minutes** and allow the lentil and spice profile to integrate properly.                          |

---

# 6. HELPER ADVICE

## CHEF-LESS KITCHEN

## PORTIONING

* Maintain a consistent **vegetable-to-sambhar ratio** for every customer.
* Vegetables should be distributed evenly rather than settling at the bottom of the vessel.

## HYGIENE

* Keep sambhar **covered whenever it is not being actively served or prepared**.
* Use clean ladles and utensils during service.

## NO EXTRA SALT

* Do not keep an open salt container on the kitchen counter.
* This reduces the risk of accidental additional salt being added during service.

---

# KEY OPERATIONAL STANDARDS

* **Product:** S-308 LENTIL LAVA
* **Additional Salt:** **NONE**
* **10 L Sambhar:** 1 KG S-308 + 9 L RO Water + 1.5 KG Boiled Vegetables
* **5 L Sambhar:** 500 G S-308 + 4.5 L RO Water + 750 G Boiled Vegetables
* **1 L Sambhar:** 100 G S-308 + 900 ml RO Water + 150 G Boiled Vegetables
* **Simmering Time:** 10–12 minutes
* **Tadka Oil/Ghee:** 2 teaspoons
* **Whole Red Chillies:** 2–3
* **Fresh Curry Leaves:** 10–12
* **Storage/Service:** Keep covered

---

**Mohd Arif Kamal**

# KYROZ+ OPERATIONAL MANUAL

## PREMIUM SAMBHAR

**Document Code:** KY/SOP/SAM-02
**Category:** South Indian

---

# 1. PRE-COOKING PREPARATION

## तैयारी

### FRESH VEGETABLE PREPARATION

* **लौकी (Lauki)**, **सहजन/Drumstick**, और **प्याज** को बड़े और लगभग समान आकार के टुकड़ों में काटें।
* सभी vegetables का size लगभग समान रखें ताकि वे evenly cook हों।

### BOILING RULE

* Vegetables को एक अलग साफ vessel में **RO Water** के साथ boil करें।
* Vegetables इतने soft होने चाहिए कि आसानी से पक जाएं लेकिन उनका shape पूरी तरह खत्म न हो।

### CRITICAL RULE — NAMAK बिल्कुल नहीं डालना है

**Vegetables boil करते समय NAMAK/SALT बिल्कुल नहीं डालना है।**

* Required salt पहले से **S-308 LENTIL LAVA** में मौजूद है।
* Vegetable preparation के दौरान कोई additional salt नहीं डालना है।

---

# 2. MIXING & QUANTITY CHART

## कितनी मात्रा और कैसे?

Helper को नीचे दिए गए standardized measurement chart को strictly follow करना है।

| Sambhar Quantity | S-308 LENTIL LAVA |       RO Water | Fresh Boiled Vegetables |
| ---------------: | ----------------: | -------------: | ----------------------: |
|    **10 Litres** |          **1 KG** |   **9 Litres** |              **1.5 KG** |
|     **5 Litres** |     **500 ग्राम** | **4.5 Litres** |           **750 ग्राम** |
|      **1 Litre** |     **100 ग्राम** |     **900 ml** |           **150 ग्राम** |

---

# 3. COOKING STEPS

## Sambhar बनाने की विधि

### 1. WATER HEATING

* Required quantity में RO water को एक बड़े cooking vessel में डालें।
* पानी को **हल्का गर्म/गरम** करें।
* इस stage पर जरूरत से ज्यादा तेज उबाल न दें।

### 2. S-308 LENTIL LAVA BLENDING

* Warm water में धीरे-धीरे **S-308 LENTIL LAVA** डालें।
* साथ-साथ whisk से लगातार mix करते रहें।
* Powder पूरी तरह पानी में disperse होना चाहिए।
* **कोई visible lumps नहीं रहनी चाहिए।**

### 3. VEGETABLE ADDITION

* पहले से boiled fresh vegetables को तैयार sambhar base में डालें।
* हल्के हाथ से mix करें ताकि vegetables evenly distribute हो जाएं।

### 4. SIMMERING

* Sambhar को **medium heat पर 10–12 मिनट** तक simmer करें।
* बीच-बीच में हल्के हाथ से चलाते रहें ताकि powder नीचे settle न हो और lentil तथा spices अच्छी तरह integrate हो जाएं।

### 5. CONSISTENCY CHECK

* अगर sambhar बहुत गाढ़ा हो जाए तो थोड़ी मात्रा में **उबलता/गरम RO water** डालकर mix करें।
* **Hot sambhar में cold water सीधे नहीं डालना है।**

---

# 4. FRESH TADKA

## MANDATORY STEP

Sambhar का simmering पूरा होने के बाद fresh tadka लगाना जरूरी है।

### TADKA PREPARATION

* एक छोटे pan में **2 teaspoon oil या ghee** गर्म करें।
* इसमें डालें:

  * **Rai / Mustard Seeds**
  * **2–3 Sabut Laal Mirch**
  * **10–12 Fresh Curry Leaves**
* Rai को अच्छी तरह चटकने दें।
* तैयार hot tadka को sambhar में डालें।
* तुरंत vessel को ढक्कन से cover कर दें ताकि tadka की aroma अंदर retain रहे।

---

# 5. TROUBLESHOOTING MATRIX

## गलती होने पर क्या करें?

| समस्या                                       | कारण                                                                     | समाधान                                                                                                                         |
| -------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| **Sambhar में नमक ज्यादा है**                | पानी कम डाला गया या vegetables में गलती से salt डाल दिया गया।            | Controlled quantity में **उबलता RO water** डालें और जरूरत होने पर flavour balance करने के लिए थोड़ी मात्रा में **गुड़** डालें। |
| **Sambhar का taste बहुत हल्का है**           | पानी की मात्रा ज्यादा हो गई।                                             | Sambhar को **5–7 मिनट** और simmer करें ताकि extra liquid reduce हो और flavour concentrate हो।                                  |
| **Lumps / गांठ हैं**                         | S-308 LENTIL LAVA को ठंडे पानी में डाला गया या proper whisking नहीं हुई। | Suitable hand blender का इस्तेमाल करें या जरूरत पड़ने पर sambhar को छान लें।                                                   |
| **Taste फीका है / flavour develop नहीं हुआ** | Sambhar को पर्याप्त समय तक simmer नहीं किया गया।                         | कम से कम **10 मिनट** simmer करें ताकि lentil और spices का flavour अच्छी तरह integrate हो।                                      |

---

# 6. HELPER ADVICE

## CHEF-LESS KITCHEN

### PORTIONING

* हर customer को consistent **vegetable-to-sambhar ratio** मिलना चाहिए।
* Vegetables vessel के नीचे जमा न हों; service के दौरान evenly distribute करें।

### HYGIENE

* Sambhar को जब serve या prepare न किया जा रहा हो तब हमेशा **ढककर रखें**।
* Service के दौरान clean ladle और utensils का इस्तेमाल करें।

### NO EXTRA SALT

* Kitchen counter पर खुला salt container न रखें।

## MIXING METHOD
